new_roles.description:
**Work Location** :

New York, New York, United States of America

**Hours:**

40

**Line of Business:**

TD Securities

**Pay Detail:**

$225,000 - $225,000 USD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

**Job Description:**

Conducts a range of comprehensive analysis and research on individual corporations, industries, financial markets and/or economic developments to support business needs and publish high quality research reports/presentations aligned to industries and various markets. Also provides critical insights and industry information to support advisory services.

 

**Depth & Scope:**

* Highly seasoned professional role requiring substantial knowledge / expertise in a complex field and knowledge of broader related areas
* Takes a lead role in modeling and interpretation of advanced insights within research reports
* Integrates knowledge of sub-function's overarching strategy in developing solutions across multiple functions or operations
* Interprets internal/external business challenges and the industry environment, recommends course of action and best practices to improve products, processes, or services
* Solves or may lead others to solve complex problems; leads efforts or partners with others to develop new solutions
* Uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgement and identify solutions
* Communicates difficult concepts; converts information to compelling business context and advice; influences and gains alignment across increasingly senior stakeholders
* Acts as a technical expert / lead integrating cross-functional knowledge, impacting the achievement of business objectives
* Work is guided by policies and industry standards/methods
Works autonomously as the lead and guide others within area of expertise 

 

**Education & Experience:**

* Undergraduate degree
* Masters or PhD preferred
* CFA designation preferred for publishing analysts and associates
5+ years related experience 

 

**Customer Accountabilities:**

* Works closely with the sales and trading group to develop new relationships, and with other analysts and associates to provide ongoing guidance
* Develops and maintains contacts and relationships in the community and with institutional clients
* Leads in the compilation and evaluation of multiple data inputs for:
 + Companies/industries and/or
 + Financial markets and economic analysis research reports (e.g., initiating coverage reports, thematic reports, quarterly reporting initiatives, and marketing packages)
* Publishes high quality, comprehensive analysis and research on industry sectors and companies and/or financial markets and economic development
* Develops business relationships and generates profits from producing and sharing regular research publications
Provides service to clients (internal and external) in the form of information, expertise, analysis, and opinions regarding market information, financial markets, economic outlook, and investment strategies 

 

**Shareholder Accountabilities:**

* Keeps abreast of market data, economic information, and key industry developments, as well as internal policies and regulatory standards (as communicated by Compliance) at all times to assist in maximizing profitability through sound and well-informed decisions; develop and maintain contacts with market participants
* Demonstrates governance, control, and risk management behaviors in alignment with TD policies and practices
* Adheres to enterprise frameworks or methodologies that relate to activities for our business area
* Ensures respective programs/policies/practices are well managed, meets business needs, complies with internal and external requirements, and aligns with business priorities
* Consistently exercises discretion in managing correspondence, information, and all matters of confidentiality; escalate issues where appropriate
* Participates in cross-functional/enterprise initiatives as a subject matter expert helping to identify risk/provide guidance for complex situations
* Conducts internal and external research projects; support the development/delivery of presentations and communications to management or broader audience
* Conducts meaningful analysis at the functional or enterprise level using results to draw conclusions, make recommendations, assess the effectiveness of programs/policies/practices
* Monitors service, productivity, and assess efficiency levels within own function and implement continuous process/performance improvements where opportunities exist
* Actively manages relationships within and across various business lines, corporate, and/or control functions and ensures alignment with enterprise and/or regulatory requirements
Maintains a culture of risk management and control, supported by effective processes in alignment with risk appetite 

 

**Employee/Team Accountabilities:**

* Participates fully as a member of the team, support a positive work environment that promotes service to the business, quality, innovation, and teamwork, and ensure timely communication of issues/points of interest
* Provides thought leadership and/or industry knowledge for own area of expertise and participate in knowledge transfer within the team and business unit
* Keeps current on emerging trends/developments and grow knowledge of the business, related tools, and techniques
* Participates in personal performance management and development activities, including cross training within own team
* Keeps others informed and up to date about the status/progress of projects and/or all relevant or useful information related to day-to-day activities
* Contributes to team development of skills and capabilities through mentorship of others, by sharing knowledge and experiences and leveraging best practices
* Leads, motivates, and develops relationships with internal and external business partners/stakeholders to develop productive working relationships
* Contributes to a fair, positive, and equitable environment that supports a diverse workforce
Acts as a brand ambassador for your business area/function and the bank, both internally and/or externally 

 

**Physical Requirements:**

Never: 0%; Occasional: 1-33%; Frequent: 34-66%; Continuous: 67-100%

* Domestic Travel – Occasional
* International Travel – Never
* Performing sedentary work – Continuous
* Performing multiple tasks – Continuous
* Operating standard office equipment - Continuous
* Responding quickly to sounds – Occasional
* Sitting – Continuous
* Standing – Occasional
* Walking – Occasional
* Moving safely in confined spaces – Occasional
* Lifting/Carrying (under 25 lbs.) – Occasional
* Lifting/Carrying (over 25 lbs.) – Never
* Squatting – Occasional
* Bending – Occasional
* Kneeling – Never
* Crawling – Never
* Climbing – Never
* Reaching overhead – Never
* Reaching forward – Occasional
* Pushing – Never
* Pulling – Never
* Twisting – Never
* Concentrating for long periods of time – Continuous
* Applying common sense to deal with problems involving standardized situations – Continuous
* Reading, writing, and comprehending instructions – Continuous
Adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing – Continuous 

 

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required. The listed or specified responsibilities & duties are considered essential functions for ADA purposes.

**Who We Are**

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

**Our Total Rewards Package** 
Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes base salary and variable compensation/incentive awards (e.g., eligibility for cash and/or equity incentive awards, generally through participation in an incentive plan) and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off (including Vacation PTO, Flex PTO, and Holiday PTO), banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition. Learn more

**Additional Information:** 
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.
 
 
**Colleague Development**

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

**Training & Onboarding** 
We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.
 
 
**Interview Process** 
We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

**Accommodation**

TD Bank is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you are an applicant with a disability and need accommodations to complete the application process, please email TD Bank US Workplace Accommodations Program at USWAPTDO@td.com . Include your full name, best way to reach you and the accommodation needed to assist you with the applicant process.

new_roles.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
 
 
Company Overview
 
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
 
 
Position Brand Description
 
How would you like a career where you get to apply your best technical and analytical skills to bring complex, high-potency biologic medicines to patients? We are seeking a scientific leader on our Parenteral Product Network Technical Services/Manufacturing Science (TS/MS) team to drive the commercialization of lyophilized drug products, with a focus on antibody drug conjugates (ADCs), and to provide technical support for commercial lyophilized product manufacturing.
 
In this role, you are critical to the success of Lilly’s oncology and biologics portfolio. As a Global Product Steward and lyophilization process expert, you will hold technical ownership of assigned lyophilized ADC and other parenteral products from late-stage development through the commercial lifecycle, serving as the technical link between Product Development and our commercial manufacturing sites. You will ensure these products are successfully launched, reliably supplied, and technically well controlled across internal and external sites.
 
 
Responsibilities
 
As an individual contributor, you will work side by side with colleagues in Product Development, Manufacturing Operations, Quality, EHS, and Supply Chain, as well as with external manufacturing organizations. You will be a visible technical presence in cross-functional teams, mentor junior technical associates, and escalate significant technical, quality, safety, and supply risks to management with clear assessments and recommended actions.
 
 
**Key responsibilities include:** 

* Serve as Global Product Steward and subject matter expert for lyophilized, ADC and parenteral products, holding end-to-end technical accountability for process performance, product quality, and supply across all manufacturing sites, and serving as the primary technical interface between Product Development and commercial manufacturing.
* Advance lyophilization technology in commercial manufacturing
* Maintain the product technical knowledge base and lifecycle strategy, including process history, critical material and supplier knowledge, a product technical risk register, and a roadmap for yield, robustness, capacity, and site-network improvements.
* Collaborate with product development and manufacturing site for technology transfer, scale-up, process performance qualification/validation, and comparability activities (including lyophilization cycle transfer between freeze-dryers of differing scale and design) to support commercial launch readiness.
* Escalate significant technical, quality, safety, compliance, and supply risks to TS/MS management in a timely manner, providing risk assessments, impact to patients and supply, and recommended mitigation plans.
* Own the commercial control strategy for lyophilization critical process parameters and critical quality attributes, and maintain process understanding through continued process verification, stability and batch trending, and global product assessment.
* Partner with Product Development to ensure manufacturability of new ADC and lyophilized products, and to provide commercial manufacturing feedback that informs formulation, cycle design, specifications, container closure selection, and site selection.
* Author and review technical sections of global regulatory submissions, post-approval changes, and responses to regulatory questions, and support inspection readiness at commercial sites.
* Lead process improvement and lifecycle management projects, including introduction of new lyophilization, filling, and containment technologies and qualification of vials, stoppers, and other critical materials.

Basic Qualifications
 
 

* A degree in a relevant area such as Pharmaceutical Science, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, or Chemistry with one of the following:
* PhD degree with 5 years of practical experience in parenteral, biologic, or antibody drug conjugate drug substance or drug product development and/or manufacturing, or
* Master’s degree with 10 years of practical experience in parenteral, biologic, or antibody drug conjugate drug substance or drug product development and/or manufacturing, or
* Bachelor’s degree with 15 years of practical experience in parenteral, biologic, or antibody drug conjugate drug substance or drug product development and/or manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience with lyophilization development or manufacturing (e.g., formulation and cycle development, scale-up, tech transfer, or commercial cycle support).
* Working knowledge of protein-based and ADC drug product formulation and aseptic fill/finish processes.
* Experience supporting GMP commercial manufacturing, including technology transfer, process validation, and/or deviation investigation and resolution.

Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. Lilly does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B or TN status) for this employment position.
 
 
Additional Skills/Preferences
 
We want you to bring your lyophilization and biologics expertise, commercial manufacturing experience, and technical influence to help launch and supply ADC and other lyophilized medicines.
 
 
**Preferred experience includes:** 

* Direct ADC drug product experience, including handling of cytotoxic or highly potent payloads and the stability and process sensitivities of conjugated antibodies.
* Background in lyophilized product development, including formulation and excipient selection, freeze-drying cycle design, and thermal characterization, and cycle scale-up.
* Analytical characterization of lyophilized biologics and ADCs
* Experience with container closure and critical material qualification, including vial and stopper selection, container closure integrity, and the interaction of materials with processing equipment.
* Product stewardship experience, such as serving as technical owner or product lead for a commercial or late-stage product, authoring annual product reviews or technical risk assessments, and managing multi-site process harmonization.
* Demonstrated leadership, influence, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret complex technical data, troubleshoot manufacturing issues, and clearly escalate risks and recommendations to management.
* Preparation, review, and response to global regulatory submissions (e.g., BLAs, NDAs, or equivalent), post-approval changes, and support of regulatory inspections.
* Working knowledge of statistical design of experiments and analysis, and of containment strategies and occupational exposure limits for potent compounds.
* Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Development, Operations, Quality, EHS, and external manufacturing partners.

We’re also excited if you bring an insatiable desire to learn, to innovate, and to challenge yourself for the benefit of patients.
 
 
Additional Information
 
 

* Recognition and future promotion on the Technical Ladder
* 10–20% domestic and international travel to commercial manufacturing sites and partners (to be confirmed by leadership)
* Lilly is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
 
 
Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
 
 
Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).
 
 
Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is
 
$130,500 - $211,200
 
 
Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.
 
 
#WeAreLilly

new_roles.title: Director, Manufacturing Supply Chain
new_roles.description:
The Director, Manufacturing Supply Chain will lead inventory planning, purchasing, supplier management, and production planning across a network of brands, manufacturing campuses, and interconnected sites. This leader will direct both the people and the processes for these functions. They will define, deploy, and enforce a standardized, multi-brand supply chain operating model that connects site-level execution to enterprise strategy, so that every campus operates to common planning standards, shared supplier strategies, and a single network view of demand, capacity, and inventory.

**The role combines two priorities: delivering excellence in execution of today's supply chain processes across the MSO manufacturing and supply network, and leading the transformation to standardized, simplified, and more efficient ways of working**
==========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Team Leadership and Talent Development**
------------------------------------------

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of planners, buyers, production schedulers, and inventory control professionals supporting multiple brands.

* Define the organizational structure, roles, and responsibilities needed to run a standardized multi-brand planning model.

* Set clear performance expectations, coach and develop leaders, and build succession for critical roles.

* Foster a culture of accountability, standard work, collaboration, and data-driven decision making.

**Standardized Multi-Brand Planning and Inventory Management**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* Design, deploy, and sustain a standardized planning and inventory management solution across brands and manufacturing locations.

* Establish common planning policies, including planning parameters, lot sizing, safety stock methodology, and inventory segmentation.

* Harmonize master data standards (items, BOMs, routings, lead times, vendors) to enable consistent planning output and reporting.

* Partner with IT and ERP owners to align system configuration with standardized processes.

**Inventory Planning**
----------------------

* Own inventory planning for raw materials, components, work-in-process, and finished goods.

* Lead the supply side of Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and run the Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) cadence.

* Balance service levels, inventory investment, and working capital against clear inventory targets.

* Manage excess, obsolete, and shelf-life inventory risk, and drive inventory accuracy through cycle counting and root cause analysis.

**Purchasing**
--------------

* Lead direct materials purchasing, including order placement, expediting, and delivery performance.

* Establish standardized purchasing processes and approval controls across brands.

* Partner with Strategic Sourcing on contracts, pricing, and lead-time commitments, and own tactical execution.

**Supplier Relationship Management**
------------------------------------

* Build and lead a supplier relationship management program, segmenting suppliers by spend, criticality, and risk.

* Run structured business reviews with key suppliers covering performance, capacity, cost, quality, and improvement plans.

* Drive collaborative planning with strategic suppliers, including forecast sharing, capacity reservations, and consignment or vendor-managed inventory where appropriate.

* Partner with Quality on supplier corrective actions and supplier development programs for underperforming suppliers.

* Resolve supply disruptions quickly through strong supplier relationships and clear escalation paths.

**Supplier Performance Metrics**
--------------------------------

* Define and deploy a standardized supplier scorecard used consistently across all brands and sites.

* Measure and report supplier on-time in-full (OTIF) delivery, lead-time adherence and lead-time trends, quality performance (defect rates and corrective actions), purchase price variance, and responsiveness.

* Use scorecard results to drive supplier reviews, improvement plans, and sourcing decisions.

* Provide leadership with clear visibility into supplier performance trends and supply risk.

**Alternate Sourcing and Supply Risk**
--------------------------------------

* Identify single-source, sole-source, long-lead-time, and capacity-constrained materials, and maintain a supply risk register.

* Lead alternate and dual sourcing strategies in partnership with Strategic Sourcing, Engineering, and Quality.

* Coordinate qualification of alternate suppliers and materials through supplier qualification and change control processes.

* Establish mitigation plans, including strategic buffers and safety stock, for high-risk materials.

**Production Floor Planning and Scheduling**
--------------------------------------------

* Own production planning and floor scheduling across multiple manufacturing processes.

* Build and maintain capacity plans for labor, equipment, and work centers, with a firm scheduling horizon that stabilizes the shop floor.

* Partner daily with site operations leaders to resolve constraints, sequence work, and improve schedule attainment.

* Reduce changeovers, expedites, and fragmented work orders to improve throughput.

* Support new product introductions, product transfers, and end-of-life transitions with integrated material and capacity plans.

**Business Partnership and Strategic Alignment**
------------------------------------------------

* Partner with brand leadership, Commercial, Finance, Quality, Engineering, Operations, and Distribution to align supply chain plans with business strategy.

* Translate business priorities into supply chain roadmaps and investment cases.

* Present risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to executive leadership.

* Collaborate with supply chain leaders at other manufacturing campuses to align processes and share best practices.

**Standardized Metrics and Visibility**
---------------------------------------

* Define and govern a standardized KPI framework for planning, inventory, purchasing, suppliers, and scheduling, aligned across brands and align with other manufacturing campuses.

* Align on common data definitions and a single source of truth for supply chain performance.

* Deliver tiered dashboards, from daily floor metrics to monthly executive reviews, that support forward-looking decisions.

* Key measures include inventory turns, days of supply, excess and obsolete inventory, customer fill rate, backorders, schedule attainment, forecast accuracy, supplier OTIF, purchase price variance, and inventory accuracy.

**Process Transformation and Simplification**
---------------------------------------------

* Lead network transformation for planning, purchasing, supplier management, and scheduling processes. Ensuring optimized inventory balancing and production scheduling across multiple manufacturing locations.

* Map current-state processes, remove waste and variation, and deploy standardized future-state processes with documented standard work and training.

* Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and change management methods to drive adoption and sustain results.

* Evaluate and implement planning, analytics, and scheduling tools that deliver measurable value.

**Quality and Regulatory Compliance**
-------------------------------------

* Ensure supply chain processes comply with the FDA Quality Management System Regulation (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485:2016, and EU MDR 2017/745, including purchasing controls, supplier controls, and traceability.

* Own supply chain procedures and records within the quality management system and support audits and inspections.

* Lead or support corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) and nonconformance investigations related to supply chain.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field.

* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing supply chain experience, including inventory planning, purchasing, supplier management, and production planning and scheduling.

* 5+ years leading managers and multi-functional teams.

* Proven success leading process standardization or transformation across multiple sites, brands, or business units.

* Demonstrated experience managing supplier relationships, supplier scorecards, and alternate sourcing programs.

* Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment; medical device strongly preferred.

* Strong knowledge of MRP/ERP planning, S&OP, inventory optimization, and capacity planning.

* Proven ability to define KPIs, build dashboards, and use data to drive decisions.

* Excellent communication skills with audiences from the shop floor to executive leadership.

**Preferred**
-------------

* ASCM certification (CPIM or CSCP) and/or Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt.

* Experience with Infor Distribution A+ or a comparable ERP, plus MES, WMS, and advanced planning systems.

* Working knowledge of FDA QMSR, ISO 13485:2016, and EU MDR requirements for purchasing, supplier controls, and traceability.

* Experience in multi-brand or post-acquisition integration environments.

* Proficiency with analytics tools such as Power BI, SQL, and advanced Excel.

**Working Conditions**
======================

Office and manufacturing environment with regular time on the production floor. Must follow site safety, gowning, and PPE requirements. Travel up to [25%] to manufacturing sites, suppliers, and peer campuses, including international travel.

 

Henry Schein, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, disability that can be reasonably accommodated without undue hardship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, citizenship, marital or veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

For more information about career opportunities at Henry Schein, please visit our website at: www.henryschein.com/careers

*Please be advised that Henry Schein's official U.S. website is* *www.henryschein.com* *. Any other format is not genuine. Any jobs posted by Henry Schein or its recruiters on the internet may be accessed through Henry Schein's on-line "career opportunities" portal through this official website. Applicants who wish to seek employment with Henry Schein are advised to verify the job posting through this portal.*

new_roles.title: Director - Digital Operations, Manufacturing Execution
new_roles.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

GE Aerospace is seeking a Director – Digital Operations, Manufacturing Execution to lead ongoing digital operations across our Manufacturing Execution ecosystem. This role is responsible for platform stewardship, operational support, service continuity, and steady-state ownership of critical manufacturing applications that enable factory performance across the enterprise.
 
 
The Director will provide cross-functional leadership across support, product, and architecture to ensure reliable, scalable, and well-governed operations for platforms including PlantApps, PFMD, Bluestreak, and the broader future digital manufacturing ecosystem. This leader will own the operating model for sustaining and improving these platforms over time, with accountability for uptime, service performance, support responsiveness, operational stability, platform health, and issue resolution.
 
 
This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can operate effectively across a complex enterprise, align multiple stakeholders, and build a durable future-state operating model for manufacturing digital operations. 
 
\*Eastern Time Zone Preferred for US Based Candidates\*

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**:

In this role, you will:

* Lead the digital operations function for Manufacturing Execution, with accountability for ongoing support, operational continuity, service performance, and platform stewardship.
* Provide continuous, steady-state ownership across a portfolio of manufacturing digital platforms, including PlantApps, PFMD, Bluestreak, and related applications in the future digital manufacturing ecosystem.
* Lead cross-functional teams spanning operations, support, product, and architecture to ensure stable and effective operation of business-critical manufacturing platforms.
* Establish and manage the support model, operating model, service governance, and platform ownership structure required to sustain and improve MES-related platforms.
* Drive uptime, operational stability, support responsiveness, platform health, and issue resolution across the ecosystem.
* Partner with operations teams, product owners, architects, support teams, and site users to ensure services are reliable, well-governed, and aligned to business needs.
* Govern service delivery through clear KPIs, operating cadences, escalation paths, and performance reporting.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement efforts to reduce repeat issues and strengthen operational reliability.
* Ensure operational readiness and service continuity for releases, upgrades, migrations, implementations, and platform transitions.
* Prioritize investment and attention across support needs, service risks, platform health, and business-critical operational demands.
* Drive adherence to compliance, controls, and cybersecurity requirements while simplifying and strengthening operational processes.
* Build and lead a culture grounded in FLIGHT DECK, with strong focus on respect for people, continuous improvement, customer value, and accountability.
* Shape and optimize a durable future-state operating model for enterprise manufacturing digital operations.

**Minimum Qualifications**:

 

* Bachelor’s degree from accredited university or college with minimum of 8 years of professional experience OR Associates degree with minimum of 11 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with minimum of 13 years of professional experience
* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Digital Operations.
* Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience
* Eligibility Requirement:
* Legal authorization to work in the U.S. or UK is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.

**Desired Characteristics:**

**Technical and Business Expertise:**

* Strong experience leading digital operations, service delivery, application support, or platform operations in a complex enterprise environment
* Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing applications, or other business-critical digital platforms
* Demonstrated success operating and improving platforms with accountability for service continuity, uptime, support responsiveness, and operational stability
* Experience working across multiple platforms and stakeholder groups to create effective operating models and governance structures
* Strong understanding of service management, incident/problem management, release readiness, operational controls, and platform lifecycle support
* Ability to make tradeoffs across platform health, support demand, business priorities, and technical constraints
* Familiarity with digital manufacturing environments and the role of technology in supporting safety, quality, delivery, and cost

**Leadership:**

* Demonstrated success leading enterprise or multi-platform operational ownership with broad cross-functional leadership
* Experience leading support, product, architecture, and engineering in a matrixed global organization
* Ability to create clarity in complex environments and align teams around a common operating model
* Strong judgment in prioritization, escalation management, governance, and service ownership decisions
* Experience coaching, developing, and optimizing teams in support of long-term organizational capability

**Personal Attributes:**

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage senior leaders and technical teams with confidence and clarity
* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate vision into a durable operating model and concrete action plans
* Strong analytical, organizational, and execution skills
* Comfortable working through ambiguity, scale, and organizational complexity
* Customer-focused and operationally disciplined, with a strong bias for action and continuous improvement

**Additional Information for candidates in US:**

The base pay range for this position is $152,000-$202,000 USD. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on November 10th, 2026.

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness.

GE Aerospace (General Electric Company or the Company) and its affiliates each sponsor certain employee benefit plans or programs (i.e., is a “Sponsor”). Each Sponsor reserves the right to terminate, amend, suspend, replace or modify its benefit plans and programs at any time and for any reason, in its sole discretion. No individual has a vested right to any benefit under a Sponsor’s welfare benefit plan or program. This document does not create a contract of employment with any individual.

**For Candidates in the UK:**

new_roles.title: Director of Engineering (Food Manufacturing Plants)
new_roles.description:
**Director of Engineering (Food Manufacturing)**

Dessert Holdings is the leading premium dessert company in the world. We craft artisanal, scratch-made desserts at scale, combining culinary innovation with the finest real ingredients. With a rich heritage spanning seven distinctive brands, we bring unmatched expertise and tailored solutions to our Retail and Foodservice partners.

Dessert Holdings is looking for a **Director of Engineering**to be based in **Aurora, CO** or ideally near one of our production facilities, who will travel as needed to sites for projects. Under the direction of the VP of Engineering & Reliability and in coordination with Corporate and Site Management teams, this individual will provide technical and professional leadership for project management and engineering across Dessert Holdings' tenFood Manufacturing Plants. This role is responsible for capital projects and for identifying, vetting, and championing new manufacturing opportunities and new or emerging technical advancements. This position requires strong personal initiative to identify opportunities, achieve engineering standardization, and implement asset and process best practices within the Dessert Holdings manufacturing facilities.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide engineering counsel and leadership for multiple facilities and internal and external project engineers.
* Manage and execute all facets of Dessert Holdings capital projects such as building expansions, and capacity expansion including brownfield and greenfield projects.
* Identify and champion cost reduction projects (capital and non-capital) through process or equipment improvements, capital automation, and robotic opportunities.
* Define technology and manufacturing capabilities to support new business and line extensions.
* Aid with developing 3/5-Year Capital Plan, including originating capital appropriation requests, developing project schedules and work teams, writing of contracts, coordinating project activities, controlling project funds, and implementing startup/training procedures as necessary.
* Write capital projects that include preparation of studies, proposals, estimates, technical reports, capital required, cash flow on approved CEA format.
* Assist in the development and implementation of new facility planning and construction. Includes developing packages, creating equipment and construction specifications, establishing and tracking project budgets, utility utilization, EPA and OSHA requirements, knowledge of GMP's, writing and justifying projects.
* Administer project bid documents and assist with rewarding contracts to outside vendors, architects, and engineers.
* Create and maintain the appropriate engineering records including equipment records and manuals, drawings and diagrams, inspection reports and legal records as required by the appropriate agencies.
* Maintain effective reporting and communication with the appropriate people both within and outside of the plant.
* Work closely with outside agencies in their respective fields, i.e., OSHA, EPA, FDA, etc., to ensure plant compliance with current regulations.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering required or equivalent technical degree. Substantial applicable experience will also be considered.
* 10-15 years of engineering leadership with progressive technical and/or management experience including project management and extensive food manufacturing experience
* Ability to travel up to 75%, throughout the US (8 sites) and Canada (2 sites)
* Hands on approach to problem solving with creative solutions and ability to handle ambiguity
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Understand business implications of decisions, align work with strategic goals
* Ability to prioritize and plan work activities, set goals, timelines, and objectives
* Display original thinking, creativity and resourcefulness to generate innovative approaches and ideas
* Ability to create and drive automation opportunities including robotic manufacturing capability
* Possess leadership skills and the ability to effectively manage and communicate with engineers, construction personnel, project managers, clients and executives
* Demonstrated proficiency in Word, Excel, Gantt, Power Point, AutoCAD, and project planners
* Familiarity with controls, process, packaging, electrical, mechanical, refrigeration systems
* Knowledge of six sigma and Lean Manufacturing principles

**About Dessert Holdings**

Dssert Holdings is a collection of premium dessert companies and brands: The Original Cakerie, Lawler's Desserts, Atlanta Cheesecake Company, Steven Charles, Dianne's Fine Desserts, Kenny's Great Pies, and Willamette Valley Pie Company. Dessert Holdings is owned by Bain Capital, is headquartered in St. Paul, Minnesota, employs more than 3,500 people across ten manufacturing facilities, and is continuing its journey of rapid growth.

**EEO Statement**

Dessert Holdings and its related entities provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or any other characteristics protected by law.

new_roles.description:
Company: B. Braun US Pharmaceutical Manufacturing LLC

Job Posting Location: Irvine, California, United States

Functional Area: Quality

Working Model: Onsite

Days of Work: Friday, Thursday, Wednesday, Tuesday, Monday

Shift: 5X8

Relocation Available: No

B. Braun Medical Inc., a leader in infusion therapy and pain management, develops, manufactures, and markets innovative medical products and services to the healthcare industry. Other key product areas include nutrition, pharmacy admixture and compounding, ostomy and wound care, and dialysis. The company is committed to eliminating preventable treatment errors and enhancing patient, clinician and environmental safety. B. Braun Medical is headquartered in Bethlehem, Pa., and is part of the B. Braun Group of Companies in the U.S., which includes B. Braun Interventional Systems, Aesculap® and CAPS®.

Globally, the B. Braun Group of Companies employs more than 64,000 employees in 64 countries. Guided by its Sharing Expertise® philosophy, B. Braun continuously exchanges knowledge with customers, partners and clinicians to address the critical issues of improving care and lowering costs. To learn more about B. Braun Medical, visit www.bbraunusa.com

Ready to lead where science, quality, and patient safety come together? Join B. Braun and shape the future of laboratory excellence while driving the strategy, compliance, and innovation behind critical healthcare products.

**Why this role matters:**

The Director, Lab Quality Control serves as the senior site authority for Quality Control Chemistry and Microbiology, providing the scientific and operational leadership needed to protect product quality and maintain regulatory compliance. This role establishes the site’s laboratory strategy, leads critical quality initiatives, and ensures that laboratory operations remain scientifically sound, inspection-ready, and aligned with business and product portfolio requirements.

**How you will make an impact:**

* Develop, maintain, and execute the site Quality Control strategy in alignment with business objectives, product portfolio requirements, and regulatory expectations.
* Provide strategic oversight for QC Chemistry and QC Microbiology operations, including release, stability, raw material, in-process, microbiological, and sterility-related testing activities.
* Establish and govern laboratory standards for testing compliance, data integrity, investigations, sample management, analytical methods, specifications, and laboratory workflows.
* Serve as the primary site subject matter expert during regulatory inspections and customer audits involving laboratory operations and quality systems.
* Partner with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Sterility Assurance, Engineering, Validation, Technical Services, Supply Chain, and Regulatory Affairs to support site operations and timely product release.
* Lead laboratory optimization, method modernization, automation, Lean deployment, and quality system improvement initiatives.
* Foster a culture of quality, accountability, scientific rigor, collaboration, safety, and continuous improvement.

**What sets you up for success:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline required; master’s degree or doctorate preferred.
* 10+ years of related experience, including significant leadership responsibility within laboratory quality control or pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Demonstrated expertise in QC Chemistry and/or QC Microbiology operations within a sterile drug product manufacturing environment.
* Significant experience with laboratory compliance, data integrity, out-of-specification and out-of-trend investigations, analytical methods, and pharmaceutical quality systems.
* Proven experience supporting regulatory inspections, customer audits, and interactions with senior internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to resolve complex scientific, operational, and compliance issues using sound judgment, technical expertise, and risk-based decision-making.
* Lean Six Sigma certification or demonstrated experience applying Lean and continuous-improvement methodologies preferred.

**What you will enjoy along the way:**

* The opportunity to shape the laboratory quality strategy for a regulated sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing site.
* A highly visible leadership role with influence across Quality, Manufacturing, Technical Operations, Supply Chain, and Regulatory Affairs.
* The ability to modernize analytical capabilities through automation, method lifecycle management, Lean principles, and emerging technologies.
* Responsibility for developing laboratory leaders, building organizational capability, and determining the effective allocation of people and resources.
* Meaningful work that directly supports product quality, regulatory compliance, operational reliability, and patient safety.
* A collaborative environment built on scientific rigor, accountability, diverse perspectives, and continuous improvement.

new_roles.title: Director, United States Operations Quality Audits & Inspections
new_roles.description:
Facility: Quality

Location:
Plainsboro, NJ, US

**About the Department**

 

The Clinical, Medical and Regulatory (CMR) department at Novo Nordisk is one of the most diverse and collaborative groups within the organization. From healthcare provider interactions and developing and implementing regulatory strategies with the FDA to providing medical education and collecting data to support efficacy and new product development, CMR is involved. The one thing that keeps us all marching to the same beat is our patient centered focus. At Novo Nordisk, you will help patients around the world. As their needs evolve, so does our challenge to find better and more innovative ways to improve their quality of life. We’re changing lives for a living. Are you ready to make a difference?

 

**The Position**

Lead independent, risk-based quality audits and inspection readiness across the approved USO Quality (USOQ) domain. Develop and execute the audit and self-inspection strategy to assess compliance, control effectiveness and risks to patient safety, product quality and data integrity across applicable current GxPs [Good Clinical (GCP), Pharmacovigilance (GPV), Distribution (GDP) and Manufacturing (GMP)] practices]. Maintain an objective view of business and Quality activities, including outsourced activities within scope. Lead sustained audit and inspection readiness and act as the designated local health authority inspection point of contact and inspection lead for the USOQ domain, coordinating with Regulatory Affairs, Global Quality, Patient Safety and accountable business leaders. Ensure readiness gaps and regulatory commitments are visible, owned, and escalated. Provide independent assurance over external-party quality controls through risk-based audits & remediation plans.

 

**Relationships**

Position reports to the Head of USO Quality. The sponsor approves the audit charter and risk-based plan, reviews resource adequacy, receives unfiltered findings and has formal input into the Director’s appointment, removal and performance assessment. The Director has direct access to the sponsor to escalate interference, disputed findings, scope restrictions and unresolved material risks. Interface with multiple Novo accountable business leaders, Regulatory Affairs, Legal, Safety, global Quality Audit and Global Clinical Compliance. External relationships include health authorities, clinical trial sites, external auditors and relevant vendors and partners. Coordinate USOQ inspection communications through approved authority channels without displacing global, legal-entity, Regulatory or Safety accountabilities. This role manages the independent audit and inspection department, with multiple experienced quality representatives assigned to diverse quality functions and includes auditor competence, inspection leadership, workload, budget and continuity.

 

**Essential Functions**

* Direct Independent Audits and Self-Inspection Program & Staff
* Maintain the USOQ audit charter, audit universe and risk-based audit and self-inspection strategy. Define scope, frequency, methods, auditor qualifications and escalation criteria across business functions, Quality verticals and relevant external parties. Secure approval of audit plans and material changes, ensure authorized access to personnel, sites, systems and records and align with global audit programs to prevent duplication and coverage gaps
* Lead the annual audit & self-inspection program, including routine, risk-triggered and for-cause reviews. Assign qualified, independent auditors; oversee evidence-based assessments of control design, effectiveness, data integrity and external-party controls. Ensure consistent finding classification, clear communication and timely reporting. Manage budget and staffing, document plan deviations and escalate material coverage or resource gaps
* Inspection Readiness and Health Authority Leadership
* Lead inspection readiness with business and Quality leaders through assessments, mock inspections, playbooks, document-retrieval exercises, SME preparation and trained deputies. Define inspection-team roles, front- and back-room responsibilities, request tracking and escalation. Coordinate USOQ administrative support while leading readiness coordination and independent challenge. Business and process owners retain responsibility for compliant operations, source records and readiness evidence
* Serve as the designated local health authority inspection contact and lead within approved USOQ scope, including FDA and other formally assigned authorities. Coordinate inspection logistics, meetings, interviews, requests and communications with Regulatory Affairs, global functions and accountable SMEs. Lead observation triage, response coordination and commitment tracking. Secure authorized approvals for submissions, commitments and risk acceptance; retain established company signatory, Regulatory and Safety reporting authorities
* Finding Ownership and Remediation Oversight
* Ensure all audit, self-inspection and inspection findings have accountable business or process owners, action owners, deadlines and escalation routes. Business leaders assign ownership and resources; finding owners investigate root causes, develop and implement CAPA and demonstrate effectiveness. Quality owns findings within its processes. Challenge inadequate responses and escalate unassigned, overdue, repeat or high-risk findings to the Head of USOQ and Corporate Quality Audit Sponsor, as appropriate. Honor health authority deadlines
* Independently assess audit and self-inspection responses and verify remediation effectiveness before closing findings under approved procedures. Require additional evidence or action where needed. For inspection observations, coordinate completion and effectiveness checks while preserving authorized response approvals and health authority closure decisions. Reviewers must not assess their own remediation; finding owners retain investigation, CAPA development and implementation
* Report audit themes, inspection readiness, overdue commitments and systemic risks to the Quality Council and relevant global forums. Escalate urgent risks immediately and independence concerns directly to the Corporate Quality Audit Sponsor
* Independence and Performance
* Protect audit objectivity through a documented charter, conflict disclosures, independent assignments and unfiltered reporting. Base conclusions on evidence, free from business or delivery pressures; escalate classification disputes through approved independent channels. Do not operate or approve controls the team audits; arrange independent review of its readiness and inspection-coordination activities. Track risk-based coverage, reporting and regulatory-response timeliness, readiness-gap closure, overdue and repeat findings, CAPA effectiveness and auditor competence. Do not incentivize low finding counts or guarantee inspection outcomes.
 

**Physical Requirements**

10-20% overnight travel required. This position (in-office) is located in Plainsboro, NJ.

 

**Development Of People**

Supervisory. Ensure that reporting personnel have individual development plans (IDP), with annual goals and measurements that are consistent with the priorities of the business and that interim reviews are held so that their work is focused on those priorities and they understand their level of accountability for results and the measurement process. Ensure that the IDP forms include completed learning and aspiration plans and are in place for all reporting personnel to enable the achievement of goals and capability to assume increased levels of responsibility. Manage the application and communication of all Novo Nordisk policies, procedures and Novo Nordisk Way.

 

**Qualifications**

* **Education level:** Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree preferred; advanced degree may substitute for 2 years of experience
* **Experience Level:** 10+ years of progressive experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO industry, including at least 5 years in GxP Quality Assurance, Compliance, or related functions, and 5 years in people leadership or leading complex cross-functional quality initiatives. Demonstrated experience in commercial/affiliate quality, pharmacovigilance quality, regulatory inspections, and pharmaceutical Quality Management Systems (QMS). Broader GDP/GMP experience preferred.
* **Specific or technical job skills:** Deep expertise in GxP and FDA inspections; working knowledge of GPV/GDP/GMP/GCP and other requirements applicable to commercial & post-marketing operations. Demonstrated leadership of independent audits, self-inspection programs, inspection readiness and health authority inspections, including finding classification, root-cause/CAPA challenge and effectiveness verification. Ability to distinguish inspection coordination from business execution and authorized regulatory commitments 
 The base compensation range for this position is $187,100K to $327,000K. Base compensation is determined based on a number of factors. This position is also eligible for a company bonus based on individual and company performance. Novo Nordisk offers long-term incentive compensation and or company vehicles depending on the position's level or other company factors.

Employees are also eligible to participate in Company employee benefit programs including medical, dental and vision coverage; life insurance; disability insurance; 401(k) savings plan; flexible spending accounts; employee assistance program; tuition reimbursement program; and voluntary benefits such as group legal, critical illness, identity theft protection, pet insurance and auto/home insurance. The Company also offers time off pursuant to its sick time policy, flex-able vacation policy, and parental leave policy.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

 

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and defeating diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

 

Novo Nordisk is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by local, state or federal laws, rules or regulations.

 

If you are interested in applying to Novo Nordisk and need special assistance or an accommodation to apply, please call us at 1-855-411-5290. This contact is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

new_roles.description:
Job Description
 
 
Position Overview
 
 
Quality Lead, Director– QMS & Digital Quality Governance Analytical
 
Global Quality Management Systems
 
 
The Global Quality Group within our Company Manufacturing Division is seeking an experienced transformation lead in the capacity of Director– Quality Management Systems (QMS) & Digital Quality Governance, to provide strategic and operational leadership for the QMS workstream within a complex, enterprise-level laboratory transformation program.
 
 
This role is accountable for architecting, modernizing, and deploying a modernized, digitized Quality Management System tailored to support next-generation QC testing, end-to-end analytical digitization, instrumentation innovation, and laboratory automation.
 
 
The QMS Quality Lead will oversee the harmonization and evolution of quality processes—including deviation management, investigations, CAPA, change control, risk management (ICH Q9), and computerized systems validation (CSV/CSA)—to ensure seamless integration with modern automated laboratory workflows, LIMS, ELN, and digital data pipelines. In close partnership with the program leadership team, Site Quality heads, Analytical Development, Digital/IT Quality, and Regulatory Compliance, the incumbent will ensure that innovative operational models maintain rigorous compliance with global health authority regulations while driving efficiency, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement.
 
 
Key Responsibilities and Requirements
 
The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise in global Quality Management Systems with a forward-thinking innovation mindset, translating digital and automated laboratory advancements into agile, compliant, and sustainable QMS frameworks.
 
 

* Strategic QMS Architecture & Modernization: Define, lead, and execute the QMS integration strategy for the lab transformation initiative, ensuring core quality processes (Change Control, OOS/OOE/OOT investigations, Deviations, CAPA, Method Transfer/Validation, and Batch Release support) are optimized, digitized, and natively integrated with automated laboratory systems
* Coding Experience: Experience and understanding on how coding translates to QMS and analytical functions. Responsible for overseeing the eQMS and ability to be able to review and understand the underlying code and how it is ensures compliance.
* Digital Quality & Data Integrity Governance: Partner with IT/Digital Quality and Automation engineers to embed robust Data Integrity by Design (ALCOA+) and Computer Software Assurance (CSA) principles into digitized laboratory platforms, instrument interfaces, and automated data flows.
* Regulatory Compliance & Inspection Readiness: Ensure all modernized QMS processes, policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) comply with global cGMP regulations (FDA 21 CFR Part 11/210/211, EU Annex 11, ICH Q9/Q10, WHO). Drive inspection readiness strategies and author/review corresponding regulatory briefing documents and filing sections.
* Matrixed Program Leadership & Governance: Direct the QMS workstream governance forum, actively tracking milestone execution, interdependencies, risks, and critical paths. Provide regular data-driven progress updates, risk assessments, and escalation pathways to the Overall Quality Lead and executive steering bodies.
* Change Management & Operational Transition: Drive human-centered change management and training initiatives to support site-level and global QC laboratory adoption of digitized quality workflows, fostering a strong culture of quality and transformation agent mindset.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the central quality authority across laboratory operations, technology development, computerized systems validation, and regulatory affairs, eliminating silos and resolving complex compliance roadblocks.
* People Leadership & Oversight: Supervise and mentor quality specialists, compliance leads, and external consultants supporting QMS transformation, maintaining high standards of technical rigor, accountability, and development.

Required Experience
 
 

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmacy, Engineering, Life Sciences, or related discipline required; advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, PharmD, or MBA) strongly preferred.
* Experience: 10+ to 15+ years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical quality operations, quality systems, or compliance within a cGMP manufacturing and QC laboratory environment.
* Quality Systems Expertise: Proven track record in designing, optimizing, and overseeing enterprise-level QMS processes (Deviations, Investigations, CAPA, Change Control, Out of Specification, and Quality Risk Management) in laboratories subject to global health authority inspections (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA).
* Digital & Laboratory Systems Acumen: In-depth knowledge of laboratory digital ecosystems, including LIMS, ELN, CDS, SDMS, automated instrumentation, and their integration into enterprise QMS platforms (e.g., TrackWise, Veeva Vault QMS).
* Validation & Compliance Mastery: Strong understanding of Data Integrity expectations, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and modern risk-based validation methodologies (GAMP 5, Computer Software Assurance).
* Governance & Program Execution: Demonstrated success leading large-scale cross-functional workstreams, setting project milestones, proactively managing risk registers, and driving accountable execution.
* Communication & Influencing: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to present technical compliance strategies effectively to executive sponsors, auditors, and technical teams.

Preferred Experience
 
 

* Direct experience leading or supporting QMS transformation initiatives (e.g., transition from paper/hybrid to end-to-end digitized paperless QC environments).
* Working knowledge of automated testing platforms, robotics, or continuous manufacturing/testing control frameworks.
* Experience with global health authority inspections, pre-approval inspections (PAIs), and authoring QMS/Quality sections for regulatory dossiers (NDA, BLA, MAA).
* Practical application of Lean / Six Sigma methodologies to streamline quality workflows and cycle times.
* Programming experience is an asset, and or strong demonstrated ability to quickly learn.
* Experience supporting enterprise workforce strategy, technology evaluation, or transition initiatives.
* Experience managing external third party service providers, software vendors, and implementation partners in regulated environments.

**Required Skills:** 
Analytical Development, Cross-Functional Leadership, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Transformation, Executive Communications, GMP Compliance, Laboratory Quality Control, Project Governance, Quality Management Systems (QMS), Regulatory Strategies
 
 
**Preferred Skills:** 
Analytical Testing, Change Leadership, Program Governance

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
**Company Overview**

Red 6 is an innovative Augmented Reality (AR) technology startup leading the way in synthetic air combat training. Our primary technology, supporting our ATARS product, enables pilots to simulate the cognitive challenges of flying while accessing realistic, scalable training in dynamic outdoor environments.

**Director of Quality**

Lead Red 6 into a scalable aerospace product organization.

Red 6 develops advanced augmented reality capabilities for aerospace and defense applications. We seek a hands-on, strategic Director of Quality to lead the next phase of our evolution into disciplined, repeatable product qualification and production. This leader will strengthen existing foundations while guiding the processes, evidence, and behaviors needed to meet customer, regulatory, safety, and aerospace industry expectations.

Success requires more than maintaining certifications. The Director will embed quality planning into product development, improve manufacturing and supplier readiness, and create a culture in which teams jointly solve problems before they become defects, delays, or compliance findings. Key results are building practical, auditable quality processes with Quality as a trusted partner across Engineering, Operations, Programs, and the supplier base.

**WHAT YOU WILL LEAD**

* Own the enterprise Quality strategy and roadmap, scaling the Quality Management System (QMS) to match product maturity, production volume, and customer commitments.
* Maintain and continuously improve AS9100 certification and audit readiness. Lead management reviews, internal audits, corrective action effectiveness, risk based thinking, and process ownership.
* Lead ISO 45001 occupational health and safety management system maturation and certification readiness, in coordination with accountable safety and operations leaders.
* Deploy practical Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) disciplines aligned to AS9145 where applicable, including quality planning, process flow, PFMEA, control plans, measurement system analysis, first article inspection, and production readiness reviews.
* Integrate Quality into design inputs, reviews, verification and validation, configuration control, design changes, manufacturing transitions, and product release criteria.
* Establish scalable document and record controls, product pedigree, serial level traceability, inspection and test evidence, nonconformance controls, material review, CAPA, and calibration systems.
* Develop supplier qualification, surveillance, performance scorecards, supplier corrective actions, and risk based oversight of contract manufacturers and critical suppliers.
* Partner with Engineering and Operations to strengthen hardware quality, reliability, manufacturability, process validation, FOD/ESD controls, and handling of nonconforming material.
* Improve the connection between Windchill PLM, Epsilon3 MES, Unanet ERP, and existing compliance tools to support controlled, usable, auditable data across design, build, and delivery.
* Lead customer quality engagement, audits, contractual quality deliverables, and coordination with defense and aerospace stakeholders as applicable.

**LEAD A COLLABORATIVE QUALITY CULTURE**

* Build a capable Quality team with clear roles, coaching, succession planning, and cross functional influence.
* Act as a constructive partner to Engineering. Translate standards and contractual obligations into design intent, risk, and measurable acceptance criteria rather than relying on clause citations alone.
* Distinguish nonnegotiable compliance outcomes from implementation choices. Invite Engineering and Operations to co-design efficient solutions.
* Create early quality engagement in program planning and design reviews. Resolve disagreements using evidence, risk, cost, schedule, and accountable decision ownership.
* Establish shared performance measures and a regular Quality–Engineering working cadence to reduce late surprises and unproductive escalation.
* Promote a just, learning oriented culture that encourages timely issue reporting, root cause analysis, and effective preventive action.

**QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Significant progressive aerospace or defense quality leadership experience, including building or scaling an AS9100 QMS and leading certification or surveillance audits.
* Demonstrated success moving products from prototype or development environments into qualified, controlled, repeatable production.
* Working knowledge of APQP per AS9145, AS9102 first article inspection, supplier quality, configuration management, CAPA, and risk based process control.
* Ability to influence senior technical leaders without defaulting to authority or unnecessary bureaucracy. Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict resolution skills.
* Experience with customer and supplier quality requirements, quality metrics, and cross functional improvement programs.

* Ability to work on site in Denver and travel periodically to suppliers and other Red 6 locations.
* Must be US Citizen to have the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Security Clearance.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* ISO 45001 implementation or certification leadership; AS9115 awareness for deliverable software where relevant.
* DoD prime contractor interfaces, DCMA, DFARS, and applicable government customer quality requirements.
* Experience with PLM, MES, ERP, and integrated digital quality workflows, especially Windchill, Epsilon3, and Unanet.
* Lean Six Sigma, ASQ quality credentials, GD&T, hardware reliability, and complex electromechanical systems.
* Experience developing small teams into mature, business enabling quality organizations.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS**

* Publish an agreed risk based Quality maturity roadmap with clear process owners and milestones.
* Sustain AS9100 compliance and close systemic audit or corrective action gaps with evidence of effectiveness.
* Introduce an appropriate APQP and production readiness framework for priority product lines.
* Improve supplier quality visibility, product traceability, and readiness of controlled manufacturing documentation.
* Demonstrate stronger Quality–Engineering collaboration through earlier issue resolution and fewer late stage quality surprises.
* Provide leadership with a concise scorecard covering escapes, rework, supplier performance, CAPA aging, audit findings, and readiness milestones.

Estimated Base Salary range dependent on skills and experience: $175,000 to $195,000

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**

* Healthcare, Dental, and Vision (100% coverage for Employees)
* Paid time off, including vacation, sick, paid holidays, and parental leave
* Short and Long-Term Disability
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Voluntary Worksite Benefits (Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity)
* May be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus based on individual and company performance, subject to plan terms.

**Note**

Red 6 reserves the right to change its current benefits program at any time, in a manner that is consistent with applicable federal and state regulations.

This job description is not a contract and confers no contractual rights, privileges, or benefits on any applicant or potential applicant. Red 6 has the right to change any and all terms of this job description, including, but not limited to, job responsibilities, qualifications, and benefits. Nothing in this job description constitutes an offer or guarantee of employment.

Red Six Aerospace, Inc, is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
