***Internal rates may vary based on the selected candidate's current grade.***

***Ideal Candidate***

The ideal candidate is an experienced Class “A” Florida Wastewater Treatment Plant Manager or Supervisor with exceptional leadership skills. The candidate would possess extensive knowledge of wastewater process control strategies and would have exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills, with an ability to make sound and logical corrective actions. The candidate would possess maintenance experience which would allow them to make minor repairs or modifications as needed. The candidate would be well organized, utilizing calendars and reminders to aid themselves and subordinates in completing tasks. The candidate would possess the ability to plan and direct operational duties for his team or shift; cleaning duties, special projects, overtime, and maintenance. The successful candidate would be a highly motivated, self-starter possessing extensive motivational skills and exceptional teaching skills. The ideal candidate would utilize delegation as a tool to teach their subordinates and prepare them for succession. The candidate would have the ability to set up and facilitate staff meetings, safety meetings, and tailgate meetings before work. A good listener while also being a great communicator both orally and written as well as maintain detailed records and logs of duties and logistical data. The candidate would follow up on work performed in the plant, always communicating changes and status updates to the chain of command. Candidates should be able to safely and comfortably work with various industrial and laboratory chemicals. Candidates must be able and willing to respond to emergency situations to provide for public health and safety. Though the work consists of a team atmosphere, candidates at times will be required to work independently, occasionally work rotating shifts, including nights, weekends and holidays as well as cover overtime as needed. Candidates should have extensive computer skills with standard software such as Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams, etc.

**Core Competencies**

* ***Customer Commitment*** - Proactively seeks to understand the needs of the customers and provide the highest standards of service.
* ***Dedication to Professionalism and Integrity*** - Demonstrates and promotes fair, honest, professional and ethical behaviors that establishes trust throughout the organization and with the public we serve.
* ***Organizational Excellence*** - Takes ownership for excellence through one's personal effectiveness and dedication to the continuous improvement of our operations.
* ***Success through Teamwork*** - Collaborates and builds partnerships through trust and the open exchange of diverse ideas and perspectives to achieve organizational goals.

***Duties and Responsibilities***

Note: The following duties are illustrative and not exhaustive. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment to the position. Depending on assigned area of responsibility, incumbents in the position may perform some or all of the activities described below.

* Plans and makes recommendations for short, intermediate and long-term needs associated with the biennial budgeting process.
* Manages the work of subordinate staff by scheduling, assigning and reviewing work, providing training and counseling and evaluating performance.
* Trains subordinates in all aspects of job duties and responsibilities to achieve unit and organizational goals.
* Monitors, inspects, and analyzes all aspects of water and wastewater plant operations and maintenance for compliance with permit specifications.
* Conducts facility inspections with regulatory program enforcement officers and bond engineers to ensure compliance with permit specifications.
* Reviews and approves daily, weekly and monthly detailed operations reports and maintenance records.
* Notifies manager and/or other appropriate staff of needs for non-routine adjustments and/or malfunctioning of equipment.
* Develops, reviews, and updates standard operating procedures for facility processes, safety, and/or malfunctioning of equipment.
* Develops, reviews, and updates standard operating procedures for facility processes, safety, and emergency conditions to ensure proper and safe operations of facilities.
* Serves as the custodian of record for all fiscal assets located at a facility and conducts quarterly and annual in-house inventories.
* Oversees work performed by contractors, verifies that work is performed in accordance with contract terms, and recommends payment of pay requests.
* Evaluates unit performance, equipment condition and process systems for repair/replacement, budgeting, future planning and plant reliability needs.
* Conducts and attends meetings to disseminate and receive information.
* Notifies necessary personnel and responds accordingly in emergency situations such as floods, hurricanes, tornadoes and other natural and/or unnatural crises to provide for public health and safety.
* Manages and approves routine and non-routine adjustments to controls in conformance with operating instructions, Florida Administrative Code, and prescribed standards.
* Attends and participates in all design and pre-construction meetings providing vital input assisting the Engineering Group with plant expansions, upgrade and rehab projects.
* Performs other related duties as required.

***Job Specifications***

* Knowledge of the operation and maintenance of Advanced Water Reclamation, Potable Water supply, distribution systems, and solids management and related equipment.
* Knowledge of principles, practices and methods of water treatment, water reclamation, facility administration and regulation.
* Knowledge of effective managerial principles and practices.
* Knowledge of industrial mechanical methods relating to installation, maintenance and repair of water, wastewater and reclaim water process equipment.
* Knowledge of budget preparation and administration.
* Knowledge of department procedure and guidelines.
* Ability to perform assigned duties with considerable independence.
* Ability to plan, direct, and coordinate work of subordinates.
* Ability to prepare and interpret plans, specifications, blueprints, schematics, etc. pertaining to plant expansions and improvements.
* Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.
* Ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with employees, officials, regulatory agency representatives, and the general public.
* Ability and willingness to respond to emergency situations such as floods, hurricanes, tornadoes and other natural and/or unnatural crises to provide for public health and safety.
* Ability and willingness to work overtime, rotating shifts, including nights, weekends and holidays.
* Ability to use a computer and related software.

***Physical Requirements***

* The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
* The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

***Work Category***

* **Medium work** - Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

***Minimum Qualifications Required***

* Graduation from an accredited four-year degree granting college or university; AND
* Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in plant operations including leading or working in a team environment; and 2 years of supervisory experience in a Water/Wastewater plant environment; OR
* An equivalent combination of education (not less than a high school diploma/GED), training, and experience that would reasonably be expected to provide the job-related competencies noted above; AND
* Possession of a valid State of Florida Water or Wastewater Plant Operator "A" Certificate of License; AND
* Possession of a valid Florida Driver’s license.

***Emergency Management Responsibilities***

In the event of an emergency or disaster, an employee may be required to respond promptly to duties and responsibilities as assigned by the employee’s department, the County’s Office of Emergency Management, or County Administration. Such assignments may be for before, during or after the emergency/disaster.

new_roles.description:
Join a growing, stable company offering consistent hours, and strong benefits. Gas and Supply is the region’s largest independent distributor of welding, safety, and industrial supplies, as well as a top national distributor of industrial, medical, and cryogenic gases. With over fifty locations across seven states, we are seeking a motivated individual to become a part of our team as a Fill Plant Manager.

**What’s in it for you:**

* Competitive wages commensurate with experience
* Regular overtime
* Monday – Friday work week (some Saturdays as needed)
* Bonus opportunities
* Career advancement opportunities
* Employer-paid life insurance
* Employer-paid disability insurance
* Health, dental, and vision insurance available
* 401K with employer match
* Educational reimbursement program
* Generous personal leave policy

**Job Description**:

Our Fill Plant Manager is responsible for supervising activities and workers engaged in the repackaging of compressed gas and liquid gases into cylinders. They will also be responsible for assigning job tasks to workers according to customer needs, stocking levels and other branch needs. Additional tasks may be assigned depending on the workload.

**Job Duties:**

* Operate and safely maintain equipment for pumping or repackaging gases into cylinders.
* Perform all pre-fill and post-fill inspections and tests before cylinders are released.
* Ensure cylinders are adequately maintained - cylinders requiring maintenance or repair are removed from service until corrected.
* Regularly inspect and maintain pumping apparatus and associated pressure gauges and monitoring devices.
* Fill cylinders or containers to proper pressure or weight, whichever is appropriate.
* Ensure cylinder filling records are accurately maintained and that all required procedures are followed in order to comply with local, state and federal regulations.
* Conduct periodic checks of plant for safe and efficient operation.
* Operate a forklift, pallet jack and other warehouse equipment.
* Assist with loading and unloading trucks and/or trailers when required.
* Assist with inventory, general housekeeping and help customers when necessary.
* Position requires working at industrial sites with equipment and tools.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Must pass drug test.
* Must pass background check.
* A high school diploma or equivalent preferred.
* Ability to read and comprehend material safety data sheets.
* Knowledge of the area and ability to lift 60 lbs. required.
* Ability to work independently and under some pressure to meet deadlines.
* Must be able to work occasional overtime if necessary.
* Must be able to work with a wide variety of people with different personalities and backgrounds.
* Must be able to operate in a drug-free workplace.

* Lead the site to achieve Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and Cash initiatives
* Drive leadership in the application of Lean Principles and Methods
* Act as a change agent and drive campus toward improved waste elimination, in manufacturing and business processes.
* Provide strategy and direction to Value Stream Manager to meet production plans.

* Develop open lines of communication to continually monitor employee attitudes and concerns, and implement appropriate actions with input from Human Resources.
* Coordinate and drive activities that respond to customer and market needs through contact with marketing departments and district sales offices.
* Convert strategy deployment goals into Kaizen team actions – lead and follow-up on the conversion of batch processing to lean practices.
* Work with nVent leadership to identify opportunities, execute action plans, follow-up and assure achievement of enterprise goals.
Develop annual plan for multiple business units focusing on the Value Stream. 

 

**YOU HAVE:**

* A degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain or related business field is preferred
* Minimum 5+ years’ experience as a site manager and managing an organization with more than 100 people
* Ideally 10+ years manufacturing experience
* Proven record of Lean implementation and creating a lean culture
* Fabrication experience in metal stamping/pressing, painting and assembly highly preferred
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
* Knowledge of process improvement concepts and methods along with the flexibility and adaptability to accept, support, and deploy new processes in a changing business environment
* Skill in project management and organization

**WE HAVE:**

* A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day

We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.

 + Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money

* Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We’re known for being:

 + Innovative & adaptable
 + Dedicated to absolute integrity
 + Focused on the customer first
 + Respectful and team oriented
 + Optimistic and energizing
 + Accountable for performance

* Benefits to support the lives of our employees

**Benefit Overview**

At nVent, we value our people and their health and well-being. We provide a broad benefits package with meaningful programs for eligible full-time employees that includes:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans along with flexible spending accounts, short-term and long-term disability benefits, critical illness, accident insurance and life insurance.
* A 401(k) retirement plan and an employee stock purchase plan — both include a company match.
* Other supplemental benefits may include tuition reimbursement, caregiver, personal and parental leave, back-up care services, paid time off including volunteer time, a well-being program, and/or legal & identity theft protection.

new_roles.title: Director of ITAD Operations
new_roles.description:
**Director of ITAD Operations**

 

**A Candid Look at Our Culture**

Dynamic is a high-accountability, low-ego workplace. We take our work and commitments seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously.

At **Dynamic Lifecycle Innovations**, we give electronics their next best life while protecting our planet and our customers' interests. As a Certified Great Place to Work® since 2017, we've built a team culture that's rewarding, engaging, and FUN! But don't just take our word for it—see what our Team Members have to say.

**How We Hire: The Head, Heart, and Briefcase**

We believe great performance comes from alignment across three areas:

* **Head** – your natural behavioral drives and cognitive agility (measured by our Predictive Index assessment)
* ❤️**Heart** – your values, passions, and what drives you to make a meaningful impact
* **Briefcase** – your experiences, skills, and results from past roles

Every step of our process is designed to understand you in all three areas. It's how we ensure the best mutual fit, not just for what you can do, but for how you'll thrive here long-term.

**\*\*Required Step** **- You'll start with the Predictive Index (PI) assessment** (takes <20 minutes total), then move through structured interviews, work samples, and culture-focused interviews. We respect your time and promise clear, timely communication throughout.

**Location:** Onsite within our Onalaska, WI, or Hendersonville, TN facilities.

**Total Cash Compensation (Base + Bi-Annual Incentive):** $170,000 - $250,000

**Benefits Include:**

* Comprehensive health benefits starting the first of the month following hire
* 401(k) with company match
* Quarterly incentive opportunity
* Generous paid time off and paid holidays

**Your Purpose**

As the Director of ITAD Operations, you'll lead the people and operations that give technology its next best life. Our IT asset disposition (ITAD) facilities operate much like manufacturing environments, where production flow, labor planning, equipment, inventory, quality, and safety all contribute to performance. If you've led manufacturing operations and enjoy developing people while improving how work gets done, your experience could make a significant impact here.

Reporting to the Executive Vice President of ITAD, you'll turn strategy into results across Dynamic's primary and satellite facilities. You'll develop leaders, strengthen operational consistency, and use data and technology to improve efficiency, profitability, and customer satisfaction.

This is an opportunity to shape how our operations grow. From improving processes on the floor to building the capabilities needed across multiple locations, your leadership will help Dynamic process IT assets securely, efficiently, and profitably while advancing our mission.

**What You'll Do**

* **Lead operations across multiple facilities.** Turn business priorities into clear operating plans, align leaders around shared goals, and drive consistent execution across primary and satellite locations.
* **Develop leaders who develop their teams.** Coach, mentor, and empower your leaders to build team capability, own results, and prepare future leaders through training and succession planning.
* **Improve production flow and performance.** Apply Lean manufacturing practices, Gemba walks, and root cause analysis to remove bottlenecks, reduce waste, and improve productivity and quality.
* **Make performance visible and actionable.** Build dashboards and scorecards that help teams understand results, recognize issues early, and take ownership of improvement.
* **Connect operational decisions to profitability.** Manage labor, costs, and budgets while aligning production schedules and capacity with business demand and customer commitments.
* **Use technology to improve how work gets done.** Partner across teams to strengthen ERP use, inventory management, and process automation as operations grow.
* **Protect our people and our customers' trust.** Hold high standards for safety, quality, environmental compliance, and data security while ensuring customer assets are handled securely, and service commitments are met.

**What You Bring (Briefcase)**

* Bachelor's degree in operations management, business administration, engineering, supply chain management, or a related field. Additional relevant experience will be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Eight or more years of progressive operations leadership experience, including significant experience managing teams and operational performance. Demonstrated success leading complex, high-volume processing, manufacturing, reverse logistics, refurbishment, or ITAD operations.
* Experience leading operational teams across multiple facilities and developing leaders who deliver consistent results.
* Demonstrated success improving operational performance through continuous improvement, financial discipline, and data-informed decisions.
* Preferred: MBA
* Preferred: Knowledge of IT asset disposition, secondary markets for IT equipment and components, and the processing requirements of servers, networking equipment, storage systems, and GPUs.
* Preferred: Familiarity with R2, e-Stewards, NAID AAA, and ISO standards, along with ITAD data security and environmental compliance requirements.
* Preferred: Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma, Total Quality Management, or the Toyota Production System.

**Skills & Abilities (Head)**

* Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement practices, including Kaizen, 5S, Gemba walks, and root cause analysis.
* Financial acumen connecting operational decisions to gross margin, operating expenses, and overall profitability.
* Understanding of forecasting, labor and capacity planning, and Sales & Operations Planning.
* Ability to use ERP systems, inventory management technology, production planning, and automation to improve operations.
* Analytical skills to build actionable dashboards and scorecards that make performance visible in real time.
* Clear communication, active listening, and project management skills that help teams align and execute.
* Leadership skills in coaching, mentoring, training, delegation, and succession planning.

**❤️** **Who You Are (Heart)**

You're a leader who connects strategy with what happens on the floor. You set clear expectations, listen closely, and help people understand how their work contributes to the bigger picture. You're comfortable digging into the data, asking thoughtful questions, and working alongside your teams to solve problems.

You hold high standards for results and how they're achieved. You build accountability through trust, develop leaders who can own their decisions, and look for better ways to work without losing sight of safety, quality, or the customer. You bring the judgment to balance today's operational demands with the capabilities Dynamic needs for its next stage of growth.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

**Purpose with Impact:** Help give electronics their "next best life" while protecting the planet 
 **Award-Winning Culture:** We put people first as a Certified Great Place to Work® since 2017 
**Executive Influence:** Shape long-term enterprise strategy with your executive peers

**Transform at Scale:** Lead the modernization of technology, data, and AI through growth
 **Build Something Lasting:** Dynamic is privately owned without PE – our focus is long-term, sustainable growth, and you'll help us build a foundation to enable decades of success

* **️** **Equal Employment Opportunity**

Dynamic Lifecycle Innovations is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing fair employment opportunities for all based on merit. For positions subject to state contract requirements, we adhere to state affirmative action obligations and take proactive steps to ensure equal opportunity in our hiring practices. We do not discriminate or make any employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

 
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.
* Experience or education in statistical process control, root cause analysis, or other analytical methods.
* Training and hands-on experience with value stream mapping, kaizen methods, 5S, leader standard work, and other Lean tools.
* Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver on timelines, budgets, and goals.
* Experience developing or implementing a playbook for a management operating system (MOS) and a continuous improvement program, including how the playbook was rolled out across sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP and Power BI for operational reporting.
* Experience in food or consumer packaged goods manufacturing.
* Experience with Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), with at least working exposure to its Autonomous Maintenance (AM) and Planned Maintenance (PM) pillars.

**Skill and Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence leaders at every level.
* Diplomacy in communicating needs and recommendations, with credibility that earns trust across functions.
* A proactive style that drives projects to completion despite obstacles.
* A collaborative team approach in all situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams at once.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

 **Additional Information**

*The salary range for this role is $195,000 - 225,000 annually*

Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** 
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

new_roles.title: SVP Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

The Senior Vice President, Manufacturing is the enterprise leader responsible for the strategy, performance, scalability, and continuous improvement of Mama’s Creations’ manufacturing network.

This executive owns the development and execution of an enterprise manufacturing strategy that enables profitable growth while delivering uncompromising safety, food safety, Grandma Quality, service, cost, capacity, and operational performance. The SVP will ensure Mama’s manufacturing capabilities evolve ahead of the Company’s growth, customer requirements, innovation pipeline, and acquisition strategy.

The role builds on Mama’s established “One Factory, Three Locations” operating model, creating common operating systems, performance standards, management routines, capabilities, and accountability across the manufacturing network located in NY/NJ.

The SVP Manufacturing will be a key member of the senior leadership team and a strategic partner to Operations, Supply Chain, FSQA, Engineering, Finance, People Operations, Culinary/R&D, Commercial, and other functions.

Base Pay: $250,000 - $300,000; Bonus Target: 40%; LTI Eligible

**Key Responsibilities**

Enterprise Manufacturing Strategy

* Develop and execute Mama’s multi-year manufacturing strategy aligned with the Company’s growth, profitability, innovation, and customer strategies.
* Translate the corporate strategy into clear manufacturing priorities, capabilities, capacity requirements, technology investments, and operating plans.
* Establish the roadmap for an increasingly integrated Mama’s manufacturing network, advancing the One Factory, Three Locations model.
* Determine when capacity should be created through existing facilities, expansion, automation, new facilities, acquisitions, or external manufacturing.
* Anticipate future production requirements and ensure that manufacturing capacity, capabilities, infrastructure, and talent are positioned ahead of demand.
* Regularly assess manufacturing footprint, capacity utilization, constraints, and investment requirements.
* This enterprise orientation is consistent with current external SVP benchmarks, which distinguish the SVP level through manufacturing strategy and footprint optimization rather than simply managing current production.

Manufacturing Performance & Operational Excellence

* Establish a consistent manufacturing operating system with common KPIs, operating reviews, accountability mechanisms, and problem-solving disciplines.
* Drive measurable, sustainable improvement across facilities using Lean manufacturing, structured problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Identify performance gaps and ensure corrective actions produce durable results rather than short-term fixes.
* Promote sharing of best practices across all manufacturing locations.
* Comparable manufacturing executives are expected to lead continuous process improvement, line efficiency, cost reduction, KPI management, benchmarking, technology adoption, and operational excellence.

Safety, Food Safety & Grandma Quality

* Establish a manufacturing culture where employee safety and food safety are non-negotiable.
* Ensure manufacturing processes consistently deliver Mama’s commitment to Grandma Quality.
* Partner closely with FSQA leadership to maintain compliance with applicable FDA, USDA, FSMA, HACCP, GMP and customer requirements.
* Ensure manufacturing leaders maintain sustained audit readiness and promptly address corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure productivity improvements never compromise employee safety, food safety, product integrity, or customer requirements.
* Mama’s internal manufacturing leadership model already places food safety, regulatory compliance, audit readiness and Grandma Quality at the center of plant accountability.

Capacity, Capital & Automation Strategy

* Own the long-range manufacturing capacity plan.
* Develop and prioritize the enterprise manufacturing capital roadmap in partnership with Finance, Engineering, Reliability, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders.
* Establish rigorous business cases for capital investments based on capacity, productivity, safety, quality, reliability, labor reduction, growth, and ROI.
* Lead major facility expansions, production line additions, equipment installations, and manufacturing technology investments.
* Evaluate automation opportunities that improve capacity, consistency, employee safety, labor productivity, quality, and scalability.
* Ensure capital projects deliver intended financial and operational benefits following implementation.

Financial & P&L Leadership

* Own enterprise manufacturing budgets and overall manufacturing cost performance.
* Establish annual productivity and cost-improvement objectives across the network.
* Partner with Finance to understand manufacturing cost drivers and identify sustainable margin-improvement opportunities.
* Drive disciplined management of labor, overtime, yield, waste, downtime, supplies, maintenance, and other controllable manufacturing expenses.
* Ensure plant leaders understand the financial impact of operating decisions.
* Balance cost and productivity objectives with safety, service, Grandma Quality, employee capability, and long-term operational health.
* External benchmarks similarly position manufacturing VPs/SVPs as responsible for budgets, capacity, workforce requirements, cost control, quality and resource planning.

Manufacturing Organization & Leadership Development

* Build a high-performing manufacturing leadership organization capable of supporting Mama’s continued growth.
* Lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable senior manufacturing and plant leaders.
* Establish clear decision rights and accountability between enterprise manufacturing leadership and individual facilities.
* Build succession plans for critical manufacturing leadership positions.
* Partner with People Operations on organizational design, workforce planning, leadership development, performance management, employee engagement, and succession.
* Establish leadership expectations that reinforce accountability while maintaining Mama’s values and culture.
* Develop an internal pipeline of future Plant Directors, VPs, and manufacturing executives.

Workforce & Labor Strategy

* Establish the enterprise manufacturing workforce strategy in partnership with People Operations.
* Develop scalable labor models tied to production volumes, product mix, line capabilities, and operating schedules.
* Create greater consistency across plants in labor planning, overtime management, staffing models, skills development, and workforce utilization.
* Champion frontline leadership capability and supervisor development.
* Support strategies that improve attendance, retention, workforce stability, productivity, and employee engagement.
* Evaluate opportunities to reduce dependence on temporary labor and excessive overtime through improved workforce planning, scheduling, automation, and retention.

Reliability, Engineering & Technology

* Ensure manufacturing operations have the asset reliability and infrastructure necessary to achieve business objectives.
* Partner with Engineering and Reliability leadership to build preventive and predictive maintenance capabilities.
* Improve equipment uptime, OEE, line reliability, and maintenance planning.
* Champion appropriate manufacturing technology, automation, ERP/MES capabilities, data visibility, and digital tools.
* Establish disciplined post-implementation measurement to ensure technology investments deliver expected benefits.

M&A and Manufacturing Network Integration

* Develop manufacturing integration plans for acquired businesses.
* Bring acquired manufacturing operations into Mama’s operating system while thoughtfully preserving capabilities, practices, and cultural elements that create value.
* Identify network optimization and synergy opportunities following acquisitions.
* M&A diligence and post-acquisition operational integration are already part of Mama’s Regional VP Plant Operations scope, so I recommend making this substantially more strategic and enterprise-level at the SVP level.
* Cross-Functional & Executive Leadership
* Serve as the senior manufacturing partner to Supply Chain, Procurement, FSQA, Engineering, Finance, People Operations, R&D/Culinary, Sales and other enterprise functions.
* Ensure manufacturing readiness for new product commercialization, customer launches, promotions, and significant volume changes.
* Partner with the co-manufacturing organization to optimize allocation between internal and external manufacturing capacity.
* Provide the executive team with clear visibility to manufacturing performance, capacity, risks, investment requirements, and emerging opportunities.
* Present manufacturing strategy, performance, CapEx priorities, and major operational risks to executive leadership and the Board as requested.
* Mama’s existing co-manufacturing structure owns the external manufacturing network, including capacity, service, cost, quality and commercialization. The SVP Manufacturing should therefore partner closely with that organization rather than duplicate its responsibilities.

Culture & Values

* Lead in a manner that Commits to Craftsmanship, Honors Heritage, and Nurtures Relationships.
* Protect and advance Grandma Quality as the organization grows and manufacturing processes become increasingly sophisticated.
* Maintain visible leadership presence across manufacturing locations.
* Build a culture of disciplined execution, continuous improvement, transparency, respect, accountability, and pride in workmanship.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Business, Food Science, or related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing/operations leadership experience, with significant leadership experience in food, beverage, refrigerated/fresh foods, CPG, or another complex regulated manufacturing environment.
* 7+ years leading multi-site manufacturing operations or an equivalent enterprise manufacturing network.
* Demonstrated success leading large-scale manufacturing organizations through periods of significant growth and change.
* Deep knowledge of food manufacturing operations and applicable FDA, USDA, FSMA, HACCP and GMP requirements.
* Demonstrated ownership of manufacturing budgets, productivity programs, capital investment, and operating performance.
* Strong experience with manufacturing capacity planning, network optimization, equipment investment, and facility expansion.
* Proven ability to build and develop high-performing Plant Managers/Directors/VP-level leaders.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to translate operating performance into EBITDA and margin impact.
* Demonstrated experience establishing KPIs and operating rhythms that drive accountability and continuous improvement.
* Executive-level communication and influencing abilities.
* Bilingual English/Spanish capability beneficial.

new_roles.title: Senior Plant Manager - Peach Tree City, GA
new_roles.description:
**WHY DO WE NEED YOU?**

The Senior Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, efficient, and profitable operation of our CertainTeed Roofing manufacturing facility in Peachtree City. Reporting to the Senior Director of Regional Operations, this role provides overall leadership for safety, quality, production, cost, delivery, people development, and sustainability performance.

You will set the vision and culture for the site, align daily operations with business strategy, and lead continuous improvement and long term plant performance. Success in this role requires sound judgment, strong business and people leadership, and the ability to balance workforce engagement, customer expectations, regulatory compliance, and community responsibility.

 **IS THIS JOB FOR YOU?**

**What you will do:**

* Lead all aspects of plant operations, including safety, production, maintenance, quality, logistics, engineering, and environmental performance.
* Build and sustain a strong safety culture where health and safety are integrated into daily decisions and operations.
* Deliver plant performance goals across safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, and profitability.
* Own the plant operating budget, forecasting, cost management, and long range planning.
* Drive continuous improvement through Lean Manufacturing, reliability, process optimization, problem solving, and operational excellence.
* Lead change initiatives and translate business strategy into actionable plant priorities and measurable results.
* Build and develop a high performing leadership team through coaching, feedback, succession planning, and employee development.
* Partner cross functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, R&D, Product Management, and other key stakeholders to support customer and business needs.
* Provide leadership for major capital projects and other strategic plant initiatives.

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience, required.
* 10+ years of progressive production or operations management experience.
* 5 to 7 years of experience at the Production Manager or Plant Superintendent level preferred.
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or Operations Management preferred.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, scheduling, supply chain, budgeting, forecasting, and cost control.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, WCM, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Knowledge of quality management systems, equipment reliability, process optimization, OSHA requirements, and safety practices.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem solving, and change management skills.
* Ability to travel domestically approximately 20% of the time.

 
**A LITTLE MORE ABOUT US**

Through the responsible development of innovative and sustainable building products, CertainTeed, headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, has helped shape the building products industry for more than 110 years. Founded in 1904 as General Roofing Manufacturing Company, the company’s slogan, “Quality Made Certain, Satisfaction Guaranteed,” inspired the name CertainTeed. Today, CertainTeed is a leading North American brand of exterior and interior building products, including roofing, siding, trim, insulation, drywall, and ceilings. CertainTeed is a subsidiary of Saint-Gobain, one of the world’s largest and oldest building products companies.

 **LEGAL STATEMENT**

Saint-Gobain provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. Saint-Gobain is an equal opportunity employer of individuals with disabilities and supports the hiring of veterans.

Applicants for roles based in Washington state or remote roles that would be worked from Washington state are encouraged to direct any concerns regarding the state’s Pay Transparency laws to the SGNA HR Compliance team at SGNA\_HR\_Compliance@saint-gobain.com.

 **BENEFITS IN JOINING US**

Saint-Gobain aims to deliver a comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports employees’ wellbeing and helps improve daily life for employees and their families. Be Well. Be You brings together inclusive programs and meaningful resources that support physical, emotional, financial, and social wellbeing. Employees have flexibility to choose the benefits that best fit their individual needs.

Health and wellbeing

* Medical, prescription drug, vision, and dental insurance
* Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
* LiveWell Wellness Program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Paid time off and paid parental leave

Retirement and protection

* 401(k) with company match and Retirement Accumulation Plan cash balance pension plan
* Company provided life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment insurance, and short term disability
* Voluntary employee and dependent life insurance, long term disability, critical illness insurance, and accident insurance

Additional benefits

* Commuter benefits
* Group legal and identity theft protection
* Auto and home insurance
* Pet insurance and discounts
* Back up child and elder care
* PerkSpot Employee Discount Program
* Volunteer Day

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations (Hybrid - Brookings, SD)
new_roles.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**Sr. Manager, External Manufacturing Operations**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As a **Sr, Manager of External Manufacturing Operations**, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

* Owning the operational performance and strategic relationship of the external manufacturing partners supporting Brookings.
* Maintaining direct accountability for the continuity and availability of externally supplied materials and products required for Brookings manufacturing.
* Ensuring materials are available when needed, meet established specifications, and do not disrupt the manufacturing process.
* Establishing clear expectations for Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) performance across quality, delivery, capacity, cost, responsiveness, compliance, and supply continuity.
* Maintaining visibility to supplier production plans, materials, inventory, logistics, capacity, and constraints.
* Leading rapid response and escalation when supplier quality, capacity, production, logistics, technical, or operational issues threaten Brookings manufacturing.
* Driving containment, recovery, root cause, corrective action, and prevention to ensure issues are sustainably resolved.
* Establishing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the CMO network.

**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

 

* Bachelor's degree or higher in (completed and verified prior to start) AND twelve (12) years of combined experience in manufacturing, operations, external manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, planning, and/or procurement

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

 

* Experience managing contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), contract manufacturers, and/or strategic manufacturing suppliers
* Experience supporting medical device manufacturing within a regulated manufacturing environment
* Experience managing supply continuity, CMO capacity, production planning, supplier quality, asset strategy, and/or operational risk

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

 

* Experience applying medical device quality systems and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience applying GMP, supplier quality, change control, specifications, CAPA, SCARs, Quality Agreements, and/or regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience developing and executing CMO risk mitigation and business continuity strategies.
* Experience establishing supplier KPI dashboards, scorecards, and executive performance reviews.
* Experience supporting CMO contracts, Quality Agreements, commercial negotiations, and supplier performance management.
* Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, capital expenditure (CapEx) planning, and business case development.
* Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Value Stream Management, Supply Chain, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and/or external partners.
* Experience communicating, negotiating, and presenting recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders.

**Work location:**

* **Hybrid Eligible (Job Duties allow for some remote work but require travel to Brookings and other sites, including suppliers and other Solventum locations)**

**Travel: May include up to 70% domestic/international**

**Relocation Assistance: May be authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Applicable to US Applicants Only:The expected compensation range for this position is $187,600 - $257,950, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. new_roles.title: Senior Plant Manager, Contract Logistics Site Operations
new_roles.description:
We are the leading provider of worldwide smart end-to-end supply chain & logistics, enabling the flow of trade across the globe. Our comprehensive range of products and services covers every link of the integrated supply chain – from maritime and inland terminals to marine services and industrial parks as well as technology-driven customer solutions.

* Ensure that customer expectations are met and/or exceeded within the confines of company guidelines
* Quarterly presentations to customer senior management relative to our scorecard and initiatives
* Participate in customer invited meetings e.g. 9:30 am to support Customer strategic objectives
* Communicate with the customer and demonstrate initiatives supporting continuous improvement
* Meet company objectives with respect to Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Morale and Environment
* Quarterly presentations to senior management of DP World re Plant objectives and initiatives
* Establish 5 year / contract life business plan, annual budgets and ensure targets are met
* Local initiatives to ensure plant progression in all regards

ADOPT CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT WITHIN THE WORKPLACE

* Plan and execute the concepts of lean manufacturing
* Ensure the plant plans and executes productivity tasks on an annual and ongoing basis
* Prioritize activities associated with the elimination of waste in all aspects of our operations

ORGANIZATIONAL STRENGTHENING

* Continue to build a stronger salaried team capable of leading the hourly workforce into the demands of the future
* Improve employee relations and morale through participation of personnel from the shop floor and instill behavioral discipline
* Improve communication throughout the organization and at all levels

NEW BUSINESS

* Work with the business development and account management group to identify business opportunities within the capabilities of the plant and local area
* Ensure the plant participates in all activities surrounding potential business and future profitability
* Ensure the plant is always in a state that maximizes its appeal to outsiders and potential customs

BE A CORPORATE CITIZEN, CREATE AN EXTERNAL IMAGE

* Ensure that DP World is a positive force within the community and considered to be a good employer
* Increase the exposure of DP World in a positive light to maximize our opportunity for future growth
* Work with other suppliers and industry focus groups in the local community to learn from their experiences and adapt accordingly

QUALITY & ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS

* Participate as an active member of the management team in supporting ISO 14001 and ensuring that their direct reports abide by these processes and operating work instructions
* Drive, Attend and participate in both ISO TS 16949 and ISO 14001 management review

**QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS**

* A college or university degree related to manufacturing is preferred and /or MBA
* At least seven years of progressively responsible operational leadership experience in logistics, warehousing, manufacturing, or comparable environments, including at least three years managing managers or site leadership teams. Comparable relevant experience may be considered.
* Job experience in a Tier 1 operation is beneficial
* A production, materials and quality control background compliment skill set

***Please note****: This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visas. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in The United States without sponsorship now or in the future.*

**ABOUT DP WORLD**

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 115,000 employees from 160 nationalities, spanning 78 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses - Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimizing disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.

We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. Free minds and different perspectives are changing our world, and together we can change what’s possible.

***WE MAKE TRADE FLOW***

***TO CHANGE WHAT'S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE.***

We strongly believe that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success and we make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or belief.

new_roles.description:
Who is Swire Coca-Cola? We are a family-owned bottling company with a story spanning over two centuries. We are one of the largest bottlers of Coca-Cola in North America and distribute more than 50 beverage brands and flavors creating joy for our customers every day. Our 8,000+ driven employees work hard as part of a team that delivers refreshment to over 30 million consumers across 13 states. Begin a journey with us at Swire Coca-Cola and belong to a community of dedicated team members who think big and believe in winning together.
 
 
**Job Details:** 
**Job Level:** 7
 
 
**Why you’ll love working at Swire Coca-Cola:** 
Swire Coca-Cola is committed to providing balance to support you in all aspects of your life, both at work and beyond. We offer the benefits you need for physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
 
 

* Health coverage (3 medical options, dental and vision). 401(k) Retirement Plan w/company match
* Health Savings Accounts w/company match
* FREE virtual primary care, acute care and physical therapy
* FREE Employee Assistance Program
* Company paid (vacation, holidays, sick time, bereavement, jury duty, maternity/parental, disability leave and volunteer time)
* Discounted & free product
* Tuition reimbursement
* Opportunities for career advancement

In addition to health benefits, Swire Coca-Cola is proud to offer you opportunities where you help give back directly to the communities and causes you care about. Note: Enrollment in a Swire Medical Plan is required for some benefits.
 
 
What does a Sr. Quality Manager do at Swire Coca-Cola?
 
Lead the Manufacturing Quality discipline at a manufacturing plant level to ensure that plant is operating to the Coca-Cola KORE standards and that all products produced maintain the highest standards of consumer quality for brand integrity.
 
 
**Responsibilities:** 

* Develop, guide and measure the in-plant quality standards that must be met to manufacture products that meet all KO and industry standards for consumer consumption
* Hire, train, and mentor Quality Lab Technicians and Lab/Sanitation Supervisors at the plant level to ensure they are qualified to perform all the quality processes and procedures required to deliver quality product to consumers
* Guide the creation and maintenance of documentation, processes, and procedures to fully comply with all KO KORE standards requirements, as well as any other industry/regulatory requirements for quality in manufacturing at the plant level
* Establish and maintain strong associations with other Coca-Cola bottlers in the Quality Management space in order to effectively learn best practices, provide guidance/counsel where appropriate, and be aware of changing trends and requirements that must be implemented at the plants
* Proactively develop relationships with local and state government agencies responsible for managing water usage and quality standards, discharge standards, etc
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Requirements:** 

* High School Diploma (or GED) required and
* College degree preferred in chemistry, biology, preferred or related science field
* 4+ years' experience in Quality Management in a food manufacturing industry – soft drink preferred
* Strong understanding of the science of soft drink production at the base molecular level
* Strong knowledge of industry quality standards for manufacturing of food grade products
* Specific knowledge of all state and local standards and requirements for water quality and raw materials for food grade production
* KO KORE and ISO quality standards in a soft drink environment

Come and join our Sparkling team!
 
 
Due to the nature of our work and to help maintain a safe workplace for our employees and customers, after a candidate receives a conditional offer of employment, they will be required to complete pre-employment screening. This includes a criminal background check, drug screening, and for certain roles, a motor vehicle record review.
 
 
Screening results are evaluated based on several factors, including the nature and severity of an offense, how much time has passed, the relevance to the position, patterns of repeated offenses, and driving history for roles that require operating a vehicle.
 
 
All results are reviewed fairly and in accordance with applicable state and federal laws, including the Fair Credit Reporting Act.
 
 
Swire Coca-Cola is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer that participates in the E-Verify program as required by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status or other legally protected characteristics. new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Production Planning & Control (PP&C)
new_roles.description:
**About Hirsh Precision**
-------------------------

Hirsh Precision is a leader in U.S. manufacturing, bringing productivity and product innovation to medical, aerospace, industrial, and scientific markets through software, advanced manufacturing techniques, and modern production systems. Our reputation for integrity, quality, service, and excellence is powered by a passionate, engaged team and a culture focused on work that improves people’s lives.

**Role Snapshot**
-----------------

As the Senior Manager, Production Planning & Control (PP&C), you will orchestrate end-to-end planning operations that keep our factory synchronized—from MRP and buy planning to inventory control, warehousing, and logistics. You’ll shape the planning strategy, lead a high-performing team, and ensure schedules, materials, and capacity align to deliver on time, every time.

### **What you’ll do**

* Own and execute MRP activities, including buy planning, material master data stewardship, warehousing, and logistics coordination.
* Partner closely with Production, Engineering, Quality, and Finance to align planning strategies to business goals.
* Lead continuous improvement to increase affordability while safeguarding performance and quality.
* Build, mentor, and develop a top-performing team through training, coaching, performance assessments, and recognition.
* Create and manage production schedules to optimize capacity utilization and meet on-time delivery commitments.
* Monitor shop orders, production priorities, and work center schedules, adjusting proactively as conditions change.
* Collaborate with Operations, Purchasing, and Sales Operations to anticipate and resolve material, labor, and equipment constraints.
* Act as the primary escalation point for all scheduling-related issues.
* Advance scheduling processes, tools, reporting, and overall efficiency via continuous improvement.
* Maintain pristine scheduling data integrity within BPCS and generate KPI dashboards, performance reports, and metrics.
* Provide senior-level insights and reporting to executive stakeholders.

### **A week in the role might look like**

* Kick off with an S&OP alignment touchpoint; validate demand signals and capacity models.
* Review MRP outputs; firm planned orders and buy plans; resolve exceptions with Purchasing.
* Walk the floor with Operations to assess bottlenecks; rebalance work center loads and update priorities.
* Host a cross-functional huddle with Engineering and Quality to mitigate risks on critical programs.
* Publish schedule health KPIs from BPCS and brief leaders on variances and corrective actions.
* Coach a planner on data-governance best practices; recognize wins in a team standup.

### **Basic qualifications**

#### **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Industrial Engineering, or a related field
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM)

#### **Experience**

* 8–12 years of progressive experience in manufacturing planning, supply chain, or operations management
* At least 3 years leading multi-disciplined teams

#### **Technical proficiency**

* Hands-on with mid- and upper-tier ERP systems
* Strong analytical capability, KPI dashboard development, and data-governance expertise

#### **Leadership competencies**

* Clear, influential communicator with stakeholder management strength
* Demonstrated talent development and mentorship capability

#### **Other core skills**

* Data-driven problem solving
* Change management expertise
* Continuous-improvement mindset

#### **Desired skills**

* Strategic execution—able to think long-term while delivering hands-on results
* Mentorship & team building—coaching, developing high-performing teams, and succession planning
* Business acumen—translate data into actionable insights that drive cost savings and operational excellence
* Collaboration—excel in matrix environments; foster cross-functional partnerships and knowledge sharing
* Innovation mindset—champion new tools, processes, and best practices that elevate PP&C performance

### **Tools you’ll use**

* ERP & MRP Systems
* ERP Software (including BPCS for scheduling data integrity and reporting)

new_roles.title: Manager / Senior Manager, Technical Operations
new_roles.description:
ARS Pharmaceuticals is a fast-growing, innovative company dedicated to transforming the treatment of severe allergic reactions with **neffy®**, the first and only FDA-approved needle-free epinephrine product. If you're motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is your opportunity to join a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and inclusive culture.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

 

The Manager / Sr. Manager, Technical Operations will play a key role in executing Technical Operations programs that support the continued development and commercial supply of neffy™. The successful candidate will combine strong technical judgment, project management, and external partner leadership in a highly collaborative environment.

Working closely with internal stakeholders and CMOs, this role provides technical and operational leadership across the ARS outsourced manufacturing network. Responsibilities include leading Technical Operations projects, supporting formulation and process development, technology transfer, GMP manufacturing activities, and resolution of technical and operational issues. The position ensures project scope, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, and budgets remain aligned while proactively identifying and escalating risks to support compliant, reliable, and on-time product supply.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage cross-functional Technical Operations projects and day-to-day technical and operational interactions with assigned external partners, including scope, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, budgets, risks, key milestones, project meetings, action tracking, scopes of work, proposals, change orders, and CMO/vendor performance metrics and KPIs (e.g., service, quality, delivery, capacity, and right-first-time).
* Serve as a Technical Operations point of contact for assigned external manufacturing partners and work closely with CMOs and internal stakeholders to ensure execution against agreed project plans and supply requirements.
* Provide technical oversight of formulation and process development, scale-up, technology transfer, process characterization, process validation/PPQ, and continued process verification activities, as applicable.
* Plan and support clinical and commercial manufacturing campaigns in coordination with CMOs, Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, and other internal functions; provide on-site/person-in-plant support for key manufacturing activities as needed.
* Review manufacturing and process documentation, including master and executed batch records, protocols, reports, process performance data, vendor change controls, investigations, and annual/product reviews, for technical accuracy and process performance.
* Lead or support technical assessment and resolution of manufacturing deviations, out-of-specification or atypical results, and other process issues; contribute to root-cause analysis and appropriate corrective and preventive actions in partnership with Quality Assurance.
* Assess proposed manufacturing and process changes for technical impact and support cross-functional evaluation of quality, supply, and regulatory implications.
* Monitor and trend manufacturing and process performance data to identify emerging risks, process drift, and opportunities for continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Support vendor selection, onboarding, and qualification activities in collaboration with Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and other stakeholders.
* Communicate project status, technical risks, manufacturing issues, and recommend actions clearly to Technical Operations leadership and cross-functional stakeholders; escalate significant issues to appropriate decision-makers.
* Support preparation and review of CMC information for regulatory submissions and responses to health authority questions, as required.
* Support Technical Operations process improvement, business continuity, capacity planning, and other strategic operational initiatives as assigned.
* Support commercial supply operations managed within Technical Operations, including coordination with third-party logistics (3PL) providers, distribution partners, and external manufacturing/packaging partners to maintain reliable product supply.
* Support product serialization activities, including EPCIS data exchange and operational compliance with applicable Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) requirements, working with packaging, distribution, Quality Assurance, and other partners as appropriate.
* Support clinical supply activities, including coordination with Clinical Operations and external vendors for clinical packaging, labeling, distribution, inventory/expiry management, and Interactive Response Technology/Interactive Web Response System (IRT/IWRS) activities, as applicable.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**

* Strong working knowledge of current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), pharmaceutical manufacturing operations, and applicable quality systems and regulatory expectations.
* Demonstrated technical understanding of formulation, manufacturing processes, scale-up, technology transfer, process validation, and process performance sufficient to critically evaluate CMO data and recommendations, work effectively in cross-functional technical teams, and hold external partners accountable to commitments.
* Strong project and vendor management skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, deliverables, and external partners in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate complex manufacturing or process issues, develop recommendations, and communicate the rationale for action.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively across functions and organizational levels, including senior management and external partners.
* Well-organized, detail-oriented, and able to identify and escalate risks while maintaining focus on execution and business priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project/reporting tools; experience with project management, continuous improvement, or operational excellence methodologies is a plus.
* Working knowledge of commercial and clinical supply operations relevant to Technical Operations, including 3PL interfaces, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA requirements, and clinical IRT/IWRS processes; direct experience in one or more of these areas is preferred.
* Must be able to travel domestically and internationally up to approximately 20% to support external manufacturing partners and key project activities.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, chemical engineering, engineering, or a related scientific/technical discipline; an advanced degree is a plus. An acceptable combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant pharmaceutical/biotechnology experience in Technical Operations, manufacturing, process/formulation development, CMC, supply chain, or a related function.
* Experience working with external CMOs/CDMOs and supporting GMP clinical and/or commercial manufacturing is strongly preferred.
* Experience with drug-device combination products, nasal/inhalation products, sterile manufacturing, commercial product launch, or PPQ is preferred.
* Experience reviewing manufacturing batch records and process documentation and supporting technical investigations, change controls, and regulatory CMC activities is preferred.
* Experience supporting commercial distribution/3PL operations, serialization/EPCIS and DSCSA compliance, and/or clinical supply and IRT/IWRS activities is preferred.

At ARS, we are proud to offer a highly competitive compensation & benefits package.

The full-time salary range for this posted position is $140,000 to $175,000and may be eligible for a discretionary annual performance bonus. Actual pay rates are determined by considering multiple factors including qualifications, relevance of experience, education & credentials, subject matter expertise, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

new_roles.description:
**Position Purpose**

The Senior Manager leads the global Advanced Manufacturing Technology (AMT) organization and converts long-range technical direction into an executable three-to-five-year portfolio of technology, automation, equipment, and factory-transformation initiatives.

The role owns people leadership, portfolio execution, global capital-process stewardship, strategic vendor and technical-equipment vendor portfolio management, deployment, adoption, and business results.

**Principal Accountabilities**

**Strategy and Portfolio Leadership**

Translate enterprise strategy and technical direction into an executable AMT roadmap.

Prioritize initiatives using business value, readiness, risk, capacity, and strategic alignment.

Drive results across functions, regions, and multiple levels.

**Global Capital Process Custodianship**

Serve as custodian of the global capital process, including standard work, governance, review cadence, documentation quality, portfolio transparency, and continuous improvement.

Develop and quality-review investment plans, business cases, and Capital Expenditure Requests (CERs).

Provide the Vice President portfolio analysis and recommendations supporting global capital strategy and prioritization.

Manage assigned capital and operating budgets and ensure financial adherence.

**Global Vendor and Technical Equipment Portfolio**

Lead strategic relationships with key global manufacturing-technology and equipment vendors.

Create and maintain the technical equipment vendor portfolio, including preferred capabilities, technology coverage, performance, quality, delivery, risk, capacity, lifecycle support, and regional applicability.

Lead supplier development, technical reviews, commercial alignment, long-term service strategies, and executive escalation.

Use global portfolio leverage to improve standardization, innovation access, total cost, delivery, and support.

**Technology Deployment and Results**

Lead programs from concept approval through industrialization, qualification, deployment, adoption, and benefits realization.

Establish accountability for scope, schedule, budget, risk, and measurable outcomes.

Remove organizational barriers and ensure consistent execution across regions.

**Organization and Talent**

Lead, coach, and develop.

Build morale, productivity, innovation, learning, succession, and accountability.

**AMT Expansion Playbook**

Create and maintain the AMT expansion playbook covering organizational, people, technical, process, specification, vendor, equipment, installation, qualification, training, and readiness requirements.

Own the AMT workstream for expansion programs and ensure equipment and technology readiness at each stage gate.

**Nature and Scope**

The Senior Manager leads the global AMT organization with broad accountability for organizational capability, global capital-process stewardship, key vendor relationships, the technical-equipment vendor portfolio, technology investment execution, deployment, and measurable business outcomes across regions.

**Knowledge & Skills**

**Education & Experience**

Bachelor degree in Engineering required; advanced degree preferred.

12+ years in manufacturing technology, automation, industrialization, or related fields.

5+ years leading technical teams and complex cross-functional programs.

**Technical & Functional Expertise**

Manufacturing technologies, automation, controls, robotics, digital manufacturing, industrialization, equipment-vendor management, capital governance, and portfolio management.

Strong working knowledge of Lean and high-variation, low-volume manufacturing.

**Leadership & Business Competencies**

Compelling vision, stakeholder mobilization, financial acumen, talent development, change leadership, and three-to-five-year strategic planning.

**Working Conditions**

Office and manufacturing environments.

Standing and walking up to 50 percent; occasional lifting up to 30 pounds.

Domestic and international travel up to 30 percent.

BAC Employees are eligible to participate in an annual bonus incentive program.
