new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality Puerto Rico
new_roles.description:
**Entity:** CSL Plasma

**Job Category:** Quality

**Job Family:** Plasma Center

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Location****:** Remote, Puerto Rico, United States

**Employer Reference:** R-294561

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Role**
============

Lead the development and deployment of quality processes and communications with the assigned region; drive quality culture, competent decision-making, appropriate risk assessments, and timely remediation of situations. Maintain frequent and open communications with executive and corporate leaders that focus on timely resolution of issues that may potentially affect the safety, quality, identity, purity, and/or potency of collected plasma. Review and monitor Quality metrics and reports for trends and opportunities for improvement.

 

**Reports To**: Sr. Director, Quality Assurance
 
**Direct Reports:** Assistant Manager of Quality (Approximately 6-7)

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

 
 

* Manage staff, including selecting, training, developing, coaching and terminating, as applicable with guidance from Human Resources. Appraise employee performance and provide feedback and counseling to staff, as applicable.
* Manage compliance to and successful use of the Quality System tools such as change and deviations management.
 
 Ensure regular management review of quality performance that delivers stable, high levels of compliance performance in assigned QA areas. Provide leadership and coordination to established automated systems for control.
* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) performance to ensure meeting regulatory and departmental requirements, and to drive continual improvement in department processes. Works with CSL applicable systems to analyze and identify significant quality issues/trends and reports those to appropriate Sr. Management. Provides routine reports on the quality KPIs as requested by the applicable business units.
* Maintain understanding of all policies and procedures. Participate in and may lead the development of functional policies and SOPs for assigned areas
* Establish, implement and ensure timely delivery of strategic Quality Assurance performance. Provide direction and guidance on quality topics including resolutions and corrective actions. Perform LSW above center visits. Ensure deployment and sustainability of in-center LSW practices to assigned region.
* Develop & maintain process to disseminate quality interpretation & strategies to operationalize relevant regulations, guidance & standards in collaboration with stakeholders. Maintain & update Quality training materials and provide consistent technical guidance to the operations team. Develop, deploy and occasionally deliver Quality information/publications to appropriate Corporate or Center staff.
* Mentor others on data analysis, technical problem prevention and resolution, design control procedures, investigation processes, and methods to arrive at true root causes as it relates to quality systems.
* Maintain high level of regulatory, compliance and communications skills with department staff, ensuring competence to make decisions and judgments in the course of business, including times of uncertainty.
* Perform other duties, as assigned, to support business needs.
 

 

**Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Science, Business Administration or Quality Management required; or
* Minimum 8 years equivalent combination of education, training and experience
* Fluency in English/Spanish

**Experience**

* 5+ years’ experience successfully serving in a leadership role within an FDA-regulated or other regulated industry required
* Minimum 2 years managing people preferred
* Experience in leading projects to a successful conclusion
* Understand regulatory standards, various local, state, and federal laws that apply to the business and where to find information on standards and interpretations
* Computer literate with knowledge of word processing and spreadsheets
* Excellent critical reasoning, decision-making, and problem-solving skills to analyze situations, determine risks, find solutions to prevent future issues, and resolve recurring defects
* Strong leadership, training, written and verbal communication, and interpersonal and presentation skills to drive results
* Organizational skills and ability to manage projects involving multiple tasks by a team with deadlines.
* Good leadership and people management skills are essential in the success of leading project teams.
* Establish solid working relationships with to interface with and support senior management, third parties and other positions and circumstances within the organization
* Excellent customer service orientation with flexibility and adaptability to work as a member of the team and respond quickly to changes as required by the business operations
* Maintain a professional demeanor and handle confidential information with discretion
Lead teams without the benefit of a direct reporting relationship 

**Additional Comments**

The person selected for this position **will need to live/relocate to Puerto Rico**; they will be responsible for above-center quality leadership of all centers on the island.

**Working Conditions (physical & mental requirements)**

* Ability to make decisions which have significant impact on the department’s credibility, operations and services
* Ability to formulate complex and comprehensive materials such as authoritative reports of major scope and impact, etc. and/or to make formal presentations
* Exercise good judgment to refer decisions to management when decisions fall out of the realm of established guidelines
* Overnight travel required up to 50% of the time
* Frequent standing and walking
* Ability to lift or carry up to 25 lbs.
Fast-paced environment with frequent interruptions 

Note: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, national origin or other legally protected classifications

CSL Plasma operates one of the world's largest and most sophisticated plasma donation networks, with nearly 330 donation centers in the U.S. and Europe. new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Performance and Quality
new_roles.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

As the Senior Manager, Performance and Quality, you'll lead proposal development and formal client responses for the account, and coordinate the team's responses to client, external, and government audits. You'll turn complex contract, pricing, performance guarantee, and operational requirements into accurate, persuasive, on-time submissions. Every commitment and audit response you produce is supported, traceable, and clear to the client. In Finance and Contract Compliance, you'll link what proposals promise to how performance and quality are checked through audits and corrective action. You will also project-manage implementations and changes on the account.

**Primary responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Develop proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, client-requested program and benefit-change proposals, and contract amendments that align with account objectives and client requirements.
* Manage the end-to-end development and submission of proposals and formal client responses, from requirement intake through final review and delivery.
* Partner with account, executive, Finance, Legal, Clinical, and Operations leadership to define key messages and value propositions, and confirm that pricing, performance guarantee, and contract commitments are accurate and approved before submission.
* Write clear, persuasive, client-ready narratives and executive communications about capabilities, program results, and positions, and represent the team in client meetings on proposals and deliverables.
* Lead project management for implementations and account changes, such as new programs, vendor transitions, and benefit or system changes. Build and manage project plans for these and for RFPs, renewals, contract amendments, client deliverables, and audit responses, with timelines, milestones, owners, and dependencies. Plan for compressed client turnaround times and escalate at-risk items early.
* Research client needs, program developments, and market and competitive trends to inform proposal strategy and client recommendations.
* Implement standardized templates, content libraries, style guides, and quality checklists for proposals and audit responses, and train contributors to use them.
* Support contract negotiations during RFPs and amendments by coordinating redlines and negotiating items with Legal and leadership, and documenting each decision to keep, trade, or drop an item, with its approver, so the rationale stays on record.
* Own the audit request log and coordinate intake, scoping, ownership, and evidence production for client, external, and government audits of the account, including third-party audits triggered by performance guarantee escalation provisions.
* Perform quality reviews of audit responses and evidence packages to confirm every part of the request is addressed, amounts reconcile, and the response is clear to an independent reviewer; coordinate secure submission and retain final versions.
* Maintain internal corrective action plans (CAPs) for known contract breaches, so completed fixes are documented before the client asks, and lead the response when the client invokes the contract's formal CAP process. Track audit findings, management responses, fixes, and closeout against contract timelines, and report recurring performance and quality themes to leadership.

**Key deliverables**
--------------------

* Proposal and client-response calendar, plus a project plan for each RFP, renewal, contract amendment, implementation, and major account change.
* Proposal strategies and response plans for renewals, RFPs, RFIs, and client-requested proposals.
* Standard content library, templates, style guide, and quality checklist.
* Commitment and negotiating-items log tying each commitment and redline decision to its approver and source.
* Audit request log, scope and ownership matrix, and evidence-package standards.
* Internal CAP register for known contract breaches, plus a findings, management-response, and corrective-action tracker and audit closeout packages.
* Leadership summaries of open proposals, implementation and change status, at-risk deliverables, and audit status.

***\*\*\*This is a remote role, but the ideal candidate will live in the Eastern Time Zone\*\*\****

**Minimum qualifications**

* 7+ years of work experience.
* Experience managing end-to-end proposal or RFP responses for complex healthcare or PBM clients.
* Experience planning, executing, and delivering across concurrent deadlines and owners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and proposal content-management tools.

**Preferred qualifications**

* PBM, health plan, or government program experience, including implementations or vendor transitions.
* Experience coordinating audits, regulatory requests, or evidence-based client reviews.
* Experience validating pricing, performance guarantee, or contract commitments in proposals.
* Proposal management or project management certification.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$67,900.00 - $182,549.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

 
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

 
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/14/2026

new_roles.description:
**Job Title:**

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality Engineering (Burnet, TX)

**Job Description:**

**THE ROLE**

The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality Engineering is responsible for leading manufacturing quality across two Entegris manufacturing sites in Texas and translating global quality standards and quality priorities into consistent site execution. This role provides multi-site leadership to reduce risk, strengthen process capability, improve customer satisfaction, and deliver measurable quality improvements across the two-site footprint. 
 
The Senior Manager partners with site Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Development, Customer Quality, Product Quality and Quality Systems teams to embed quality ownership into daily operations. This leader is accountable for site quality performance, consistent implementation of quality standards, compliance with applicable regulatory, industry, and customer requirements, and the development of capable site quality teams. The role leads through site quality leaders and teams, establishes clear ownership and follow-through, and escalates risks and resource needs to North America quality leadership.

The hired individual will work on-site at our Burnet, TX location with some travel to our Decatur, TX location.

 

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Translate global quality standards and quality priorities into coordinated execution plans for the two Texas sites, with clear owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead manufacturing quality across all two sites through site quality leaders and teams; clarify responsibilities, prioritize resources based on risk, and maintain regular on-site engagement.
* Ensure consistent implementation of global quality standards, policies, procedures, and best practices; maintain audit readiness and timely closure of findings at each site.
* Partner with site Operations leaders to establish quality roadmaps, objectives, and common key performance indicators (KPIs); conduct routine cross-site reviews and drive recovery plans where performance falls short.
* Own quality improvement plans that reduce defects, scrap, rework, cost of poor quality (COPQ), customer complaints, and manufacturing escapes, with site-level accountability for results.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to improve process capability, product conformity, yield, and manufacturing performance through effective process controls and proactive risk management.
* Lead targeted continuous improvement and change implementation across the two sites; standardize effective practices and verify that improvements are sustained.
* Ensure timely containment, disciplined root cause analysis, corrective/preventive action, and effectiveness verification for significant quality issues; deploy lessons learned across all two sites.

new_roles.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

**ABOUT ENOVIS™**

Enovis Corporation (NYSE: ENOV) is an innovation-driven medical technology growth company dedicated to developing clinically differentiated solutions that generate measurably better patient outcomes and transform workflows. Powered by a culture of continuous improvement, global talent and innovation, the Company’s extensive range of products, services and integrated technologies fuels active lifestyles in orthopedics and beyond. For more information about Enovis, please visit www.enovis.com.

**What You'll Do**

At Enovis™ we pay attention to the details. We embrace collaboration with our partners and patients, and take pride in the pursuit of scientific excellence — with the goal of transforming medical technology as we know it.

Because that’s how we change the lives of patients for the better. And that’s how we create better together. Why work at Enovis? See for yourself.

As a key member of the Quality Assurance team, you will play an integral part in helping Enovis drive the medical technology industry forward through transforming patient care and creating better patient outcomes.

**Job Title**:

Sr Manager, Quality Assurance

**Reports To**:

Director, Quality Assurance

**Location:**

Fort Worth, TX

**Business Unit Description**:

QA

**Job Title/High-Level Position Summary:**

The Sr. Quality Assurance Manager is responsible for leading a team of quality engineers and Quality technicians in driving product and process excellence across the Recovery Sciences /Bracing and Support device portfolio. This role ensures compliance with regulatory standards, support manufacturing as well as new product introduction and fosters a culture of continuous improvement. The Sr. Quality Assurance Manager will collaborate cross-functionally to implement quality strategies that enhance product reliability, reduce risk, and improve operational efficiency across multiple locations.

**Key Responsibilities**:

 

* Lead and mentor a team of quality engineers and technicians, providing technical guidance and performance management.
* Develop and implement quality strategies that align with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Lead quality engineering support for manufacturing operations, ensuring robust process controls, effective risk management, and validation of production methods.
* Ensure compliance with FDA QSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485, and ISO 14971 standards.
* Drive root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) for product and process issues.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, and Supply Chain to resolve quality challenges and improve processes.
* Support internal and external audits, acting as a subject matter expert for quality engineering practices.

* Maintain and improve quality system documentation, including procedures, work instructions, and validation protocols.
* Be qualified as a Laser safety officer for the DFW location.
* Represent the LiteCure, TJM, and TJD Quality Management System as Management Representative.

**Travel requirements:**

* 50% to Tijuana sites

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Biomedical, Industrial, or related field); Master’s degree preferred.
* 8+ years of experience in quality engineering within medical devices or other regulated industries, including 3+ years in a leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 13485, FDA QSR, ISO 14971.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage complex projects.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Desired Characteristics:**

* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Certified Quality Manager (CQM), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or Six Sigma Black Belt.
* Familiarity with eQMS systems, statistical software, and metrology tools.
* Demonstrated success in driving quality improvements and regulatory compliance.

*Currently, Enovis does not provide sponsorship for employment visas (e.g., H-1B) and will not offer such sponsorship in the future. Applicants must already have full-time work authorization in the United States, both now and in the future, without requiring sponsorship.*

**“Creating better together”. It’s the Enovis purpose, and it’s what drives us and empowers us every day on a global scale.** We know that the power to create better – for our customers, our team members, and our shareholders – begins with having the best team, pursuing common goals, operating at the highest levels, and delivering extraordinary outcomes.

**What does creating better together mean to us at Enovis? Discover the “why” behind our purpose, values and behaviors:**

Our Enovis Purpose, Values and Behaviors on Vimeo

* Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Spending and Savings Accounts
* 401(k) Plan
* Vacation, Sick Leave, and Holidays
* Income Protection Plans

* Legal Services

Join us in creating better together.

We are currently looking for a Full Time Sr. Manager, Healthcare Quality Assurance to join our Healthcare Quality Assurance team located at the Newcastle Medical Center working 8:00AM-5:00PM - Mo Tu We Th Fr.

**Summary:** 
The Sr. Manager, Healthcare Quality Assurance is responsible for evaluating healthcare facilities, clinical operations, equipment, and support services to ensure compliance with federal, state, accreditation, and organizational standards. This position will conduct inspections, audits, investigations, and quality assessments to improve patient safety, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and healthcare outcomes. The role works closely with clinical leadership, facilities management, infection prevention, biomedical engineering, environment of care, and regulatory agencies to identify deficiencies and implement corrective actions.

**Responsibilities:** 

* Conducts comprehensive inspections and quality assurance audits of healthcare facilities, departments, and operations
* Evaluates compliance with standards established by organizations such as: The Joint Commission, Centers for Medicare and Medicaid, OSHA, NFPA, and FGI
* Inspects patient care areas, utility systems, medical equipment, life safety systems, infection control practices, and environmental conditions
* Reviews policies, procedures, maintenance records, inspection reports, and regulatory documentation
* Identifies deficiencies, risks, and non-compliance issues and prepares detailed corrective action recommendations
* Leads or assists with mock surveys, accreditation readiness activities, and regulatory inspections
* Monitors performance improvement initiatives and verifies corrective actions are completed effectively
* Prepares detailed written reports, inspection summaries, and compliance documentation
* Provides guidance and training to staff regarding healthcare regulations, safety standards, and quality improvement practices
* Maintains current knowledge of healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and industry best practices
* Assists leadership in continuous quality improvement and patient safety initiatives
* Performs all other duties as assigned

Essential:
 

* Ability to prepare clear and concise role-specific reports
* Ability to read, understand and interpret architectural, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, civil and structural drawings
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
* Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, plumbing and general building construction trades
* Knowledge of international fire codes (IFC), international building codes (IBC), electrical codes (NEC), and international plumbing codes (IPC)
* Knowledge of infection control procedures
* Knowledge of all applicable regulatory and accrediting agency requirements
* Problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail
* Organizational and time-management abilities

* Basic Computer skills
* Must be familiar with the Microsoft Office Suite of products
* Advanced project management skills
* Proficient in compliance tracking software and building automation systems

**Experience:**

* 3 years directly related supervisory experience
* 10 years directly related experience

**Education:**

**Credentials:**

* CN Core Leadership Level 2
* Pass general background check
* Standard Driver's License

* Certified Healthcare Safety Professional

 
 
Essential:
 

* This position requires completion of level two Core Leadership Training within 18 months of the hire or promotion date

* Frequently lift and or carry up to 25 lbs

new_roles.description:
At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us?

This role is part of Alcon's **Quality & Regulatory Affairs** function, a team that ensures our products are in compliance with global, local, and internal regulations and meet the strictest standards of quality as we help people see brilliantly.

The **Sr. Manager, Quality Control Labs** is primarily responsible for leading laboratory operations, ensuring compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), and Good Documentation Practice (GDP), and managing personnel qualifications and equipment validation. You will supervise Out of Specification (OOS), Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), and Out of Trend (OOT) investigations, implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and oversee Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE), budget, and Quality Assurance (QA) functions at our **Manufacturing Facility in Houston, TX.** Specifics Include:

 

* Lead multiple teams in quality control labs to ensure product and raw material compliance with specifications and standards.
* Guide and supervise team activities, make key decisions, approve projects, and allocate resources.
* Oversee Microbiology, Analytical Science and Technology (AS&T), Incoming Inspection, and Calibration / Metrology for quality and customer compliance.
* Ensure adherence to GxP regulations, SOPs, and maintain accurate documentation.
* Promote rigorous quality control and complete all required training.
* Encourage associates to meet job requirements and contribute to organizational compliance.
* Develop strategies and provide directions to the Quality Control team to ensure they are meeting customer deadlines, metrics/KPI reporting, timely completion of CAPAs/Action items.
* Develop and improve QA programs, policies, processes, procedures, and controls to ensure that product performance and quality conform to established standards and agency guidelines.
* Provide support for internal and external audit inspections.
* Provide strategic leadership to the Quality Control team to establish metrics to monitor, improve, and sustain performance.
* Allocate resources to lead, plan, and execute project activities in alignment with site initiatives and budgetary requirements.
* Review and approval of quality documents, change controls related to Quality Control, and deviation management records.
* All associates must adhere to GxP regulations by strictly following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), maintaining accurate and complete documentation, ensuring rigorous quality control, and completing all required training.
* Compliance with regulatory requirements and a commitment to continuous improvement are essential to our operations.

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO ALCON:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of directly related experience (or high school +15 yrs; Assoc.+11 yrs; M.S.+4 yrs; PhD+3 yrs)
* The ability to fluently read, write, understand and communicate in English
* 7 years of relevant experience
* 5 years of demonstrated leadership
* **Work Hours:** Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST
* **Location**: Onsite
* **Travel Requirements**: Up to 10%
* **Relocation Assistance**: No
* **Sponsorship Available**: NO

**PREFFERED:**

* Degree in Science or Engineering
* Medical device or pharmaceutical industries

**HOW YOU CAN THRIVE AT ALCON:**

* Collaborate with teammates to share standard processes and learnings as work evolves!
* Join Alcon’s mission to provide top-tier, innovative products and solutions to enhance sight & enhance lives.
* Grow your career in a highly collaborative and diverse environment.
* Alcon provides robust benefits package including health, life, retirement, flexible time off for salaried associates, paid time off for hourly associates and much more!

Sun Life U.S. is one of the largest providers of employee and government benefits, helping approximately 50 million Americans access the care and coverage they need. Through employers, industry partners and government programs, Sun Life U.S. offers a portfolio of benefits and services, including dental, vision, disability, absence management, life, supplemental health, medical stop-loss insurance, and healthcare navigation. We have more than 6,400 employees and associates in our partner dental practices and operate nationwide.

 

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

 

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

 

Visit our website to discover how Sun Life is making life brighter for our customers, partners and communities.

*DentaQuest manages dental and vision benefits for more than 33 million Americans. Our outcomes-based, cost-effective solutions are designed for Medicaid and CHIP, Medicare Advantage, small and large businesses, and individuals. With a focus on prevention and value, we aim to make quality care accessible to improve the oral health of all.*

**Job Description:**

**Location:** Sun Life embraces a hybrid work model that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility of virtual work. Our team members and leaders are expected to foster connection and teamwork by being present in the office at least 2 days per week.

 

**The opportunity:**

The Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance leads the Quality Assurance function within Dental Shared Services and is accountable for the consistent execution of quality monitoring, audit, calibration, reporting, and improvement activities across supported operations. This role manages quality teams and programs, translates performance data into actionable recommendations, and partners with Operations, Compliance, Training, Workforce Management, Client Engagement, Technology, and Business Process Outsourcing partners to strengthen controls, address risk, and improve member, provider, client, and business outcomes.

 
 

**How you will contribute:**

new_roles.title: Sr. Director Operations Engineering - C&I
new_roles.description:
**We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
====================================================================================================

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

**Sr Director, Operations Engineering**
=======================================

The Sr Director, Operations Engineering is responsible for leading the enterprise Operations Engineering function with a focus on New Product Launches, Operations Integrations, Product Moves, and Operations Standards. This role ensures that new products, newly integrated operations, and transferred products are launched and sustained in manufacturing safely, on time, at quality, and at target cost. Through the development and deployment of enterprise standards, best practices, and the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS), the Director drives consistent, world-class execution across the Order-to-Cash process (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver & Service). The role partners closely with Engineering, Advanced Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, HR, and Business Unit leadership, and supports Generac's global manufacturing portfolio.

**Major Responsibilities**
--------------------------

### **New Product Launches (NPI)**

* Lead and coordinate the successful launch of New Product Introductions (NPI) within operations, from early design involvement through production ramp and sustained performance.
* Ensure manufacturing readiness for new products, including process design, PFMEA, line layout, tooling, fixtures, work instructions, and capacity planning.
* Partner with Product Engineering to drive design for manufacturability and assembly so new products launch with optimal cost, quality, and delivery.
* Establish launch gates, readiness criteria, and success metrics, and hold cross-functional teams accountable to them.
* Lead and support the introduction of new and revised processes and technologies that support cost reduction and competitive advantage.

### **Operations Integrations**

* Lead the operational integration of new sites, acquisitions, and expanded capacity into the Generac manufacturing network, aligning processes, systems, and performance expectations.
* Lead and contribute to facility transformation, including layout, mixed-model lines, value stream design, and deployment of the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS).
* Assess integrated facilities, infrastructure systems, and technology against best-in-class capability and develop roadmaps to close gaps.
* Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with HR, Finance, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and senior leadership to ensure integrations meet business objectives.
* Incorporate workplace optimization, space planning, and long-term facility planning into integration plans.

### **Product Moves & Transfers**

* Lead the planning and execution of product moves and technology transfers between facilities and with external supply chain partners, ensuring continuity of supply, quality, and cost.
* Own and continuously improve the product transfer procedure, and support the Operations Product Transfer Steering Committee to ensure alignment and adherence to the procedure.
* Develop transfer plans that include capacity validation, equipment and tooling relocation, process validation, training, and inventory bridge strategies.
* Partner with Business Unit and Manufacturing Strategy leaders to support footprint, rebalancing, and new capacity decisions with sound operations engineering analysis.

### **Operations Standards**

* Develop with corporate Advanced Manufacturing, deploy, and sustain enterprise operations engineering standards, policies, procedures, and process documentation that drive consistent execution across all facilities.
* Drive significant contributions to the implementation of the Generac Fulfillment System (GFS) across the Order-to-Cash process.
* Develop and implement operating methodologies designed to maximize floor space utilization, asset uptime and utilization, eliminate waste, and reduce operating cost.
* Champion lean principles and continuous improvement, and ensure the ongoing success of process improvement initiatives.
* Establish and monitor KPIs to evaluate productivity, engineering output, launch performance, and facility efficiency, using data to drive improvement.
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards, and incorporate sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

### **Project Management & Financial Stewardship**

* Drive and project manage major cost, quality, and delivery initiatives, with a strong focus on breakthrough process and technology improvements.
* Facilitate project flow through regular engagement with engineering, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams, managing shifting priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Oversee capital projects related to launches, integrations, and product moves, and provide budgetary figures for future fiscal year planning.
* Manage the operations engineering budget and support reduction of the operating cost of each facility consistent with company objectives.

### **Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead the Operations Engineering team, including project planning, technical guidance, and resource allocation across sites and initiatives.
* Select, coach, and develop a high-performing team of engineers and project managers, setting objectives that align with company strategy.
* Manage organizational talent through performance management, succession planning, and development, ensuring feedback is consistently delivered and performance is systematically improved.
* Provide guidance to cross-functional teams and leadership on key decisions related to investment in core manufacturing technologies, processes, and systems.

**Minimum Job Requirements**
----------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial) or Industrial Technology.
* **Work Experience:** 10+ years of related experience in Operations Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Production, including leading new product launches and product transfers.
* **Leadership Experience:** 5+ years of increasing responsibility for project and/or people management involving a broad range of operational technologies and processes.

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**
----------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of New Product Development, PFMEA, and operations engineering principles.
* Knowledge of lean principles, continuous improvement, and end-to-end supply chain principles.
* Experience operating in both high-mix, low-volume and high-volume, low-mix production environments.
* Ability to assess and manage end-to-end processes and to manage strategic and tactical issues by being hands-on.
* Ability to develop and deploy standards and best practices across multiple sites.
* Ability to attract, develop, and manage an impactful team.
* Demonstrated skills in problem solving, conflict resolution, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leadership.
* Proven ability to prioritize multiple projects with shifting priorities and moving deadlines.
* Proficiency in a CAD platform (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and/or ProE), MS Office, and ERP platforms.

**Preferred Job Requirements**
------------------------------

* Master's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering.
* Project Management certification (e.g., PMP).
* Experience deploying processes and standards at an enterprise level, both internally and with external supply chain partners.
* Experience leading operations integrations, facility transformations, and multi-site product transfers.
* Experience working in an international company and in matrix organizations, with multi-site support experience.
* Previous experience using SAP or an equivalent ERP.
* Experience with facilities engineering and with using and/or implementing CMMS systems.
* Large-scale project management experience.

new_roles.title: Director of Cyber Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
The Director of Cyber Operational Excellence leads the design, deployment, and continuous improvement of a modern, digitally enabled Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity operating model.

This critical role will lead the improvement and governance of HBS’s OT cybersecurity capability and standards across the globe to ensure HBS has the ability to provide market-ready and competition leading solutions for customers.

You will report directly to our Chief Operating Officer and you'll work out of the Atlanta, GA location on a hybrid schedule.

 

**You Must Have**

* Minimum 8 years demonstrated experience in cybersecurity architecture or solution architecture for OT and IT systems.
* Competent with security frameworks and standards such as: ISO 27001, NIST Guidelines, IEC/ISA 62443, CIS.
* Strong understanding of service contracts, entitlement models, field operations, and planning systems.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders in a complex, matrixed environment.
Experience leading a high‑impact team 

**Success Measures**

* Understands industry cybersecurity standards and has insights into in country cybersecurity regulations.
* Provides strategic input and guidance for global Buildings OT focused cybersecurity solutions.
* Provides cybersecurity technical knowledge and experience to help close high-level sales.
Orders and margin above set quota in support of Annual Operating Plan (AOP). 

*Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status.* Learn more

 

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and operationalize the end‑to‑end cybersecurity value chain, integrating cybersecurity offerings across new projects, service contract bundles, entitlement structures, digital capabilities, and customer use cases into a cohesive and scalable operating model.
* Lead the evolution of standardized, value‑optimized cybersecurity offerings, moving away from highly customized, labor‑biased delivery models.
* Partner cross‑functionally with Commercial, Digital, IT, Finance, and Operations leaders to align strategy, execution, and investment priorities.
* Establish closed‑loop Voice of the Customer (VOC) and Voice of the Employee (VOE) feedback mechanisms to continuously improve cybersecurity design and execution.
* Lead transformation initiatives across short‑, medium‑, and long‑term horizons, ensuring adoption of new operating models and ways of working.
* Directly manage and develop a high‑performing team focused on cybersecurity offering definition, management, analytics, and continuous improvement, including improving deployment policies.
* Monitor and analyze market trends including ability to differentiate against competitors’ services and products.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and customer focus within the team.

 
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

**Job Details:**

Job Summary:
 
As a pivotal leader in the organization, this role assumes comprehensive responsibility for all facets of operations across multiple plant locations. From overseeing the efficient functioning of production, maintenance, safety, shipping & receiving, sanitation, scheduling, quality, to driving continuous process improvement, this position plays a crucial role in ensuring the holistic success of our facilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

In addition to these core responsibilities, the incumbent will have ownership and/or responsibility for critical business metrics, including P&L, Return on Sales, Operations, and People Metrics. This underscores the significance of the role in not only operational efficiency but also in contributing to the financial health and workforce dynamics of our organization.
 
 
The position involves motivating and guiding managers to enhance the skill levels of their teams, adeptly addressing issues related to the quality of incoming and outgoing goods and leveraging a keen eye for reviewing cost and performance data to identify areas in need of improvement. The execution of all capital improvements for designated facilities falls under the purview of this role, emphasizing a commitment to driving excellence and ensuring a positive impact on key financial and operational indicators.
 
 
Within the broader context, the position's scope extends to providing guidance, leadership, and coaching to Plant Managers, and support groups across the division. With decision-making authority in the absence of the business unit Vice President, the role involves leading problem resolution, holding underperforming plants accountable, and motivating the leadership team to achieve both short and long-term goals. The responsibilities further encompass onboarding and training new plant managers, and senior production managers, identifying and delivering development opportunities for plant management, and overseeing special projects for the Business Unit.
 
This role is pivotal in fostering a culture of excellence, proactively addressing challenges, and contributing to our organization's overall success and growth through a multi-year strategy, directly impacting key financial and operational metrics.

Work Experience: 12-plus years of progressive experience in manufacturing; relevant food manufacturing experience a plus.

Position Information

**Be a Tar Heel!**

A global higher education leader in innovative teaching, research and public service, the **University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill** consistently ranks as **one of the nation’s top public universities**. Known for its beautiful campus, world-class medical care, commitment to the arts and top athletic programs, Carolina is an ideal place to teach, work and learn.

One of the best college towns and best places to live in the United States, Chapel Hill has diverse social, cultural, recreation and professional opportunities that span the campus and community.

University employees can choose from a wide range of **professional training opportunities** for career growth, skill development and lifelong learning and enjoy **exclusive perks** for numerous retail, restaurant and performing arts discounts, savings on local child care centers and special rates on select campus events. UNC-Chapel Hill offers full-time employees a **comprehensive benefits package**, paid leave, and a variety of health, life and retirement plans and additional programs that support a healthy work/life balance.

 

**Primary Purpose of Organizational Unit**

The UNC Adams School of Dentistry Dean’s Office provides oversight for the Adams School of Dentistry and serves as the liaison to the University, citizens, alumni and friends.

 

**Position Summary**

The Director of Continuous Improvement & Transformation provides strategic project leadership and organizational improvement expertise to strengthen the operations and services that support the Adams School of Dentistry’s education of future oral health professionals, advancement of research and discovery, and delivery of exceptional patient care. The position leads complex, high-priority initiatives designed to transform and improve ASOD operations, organizational effectiveness, service delivery, and the experience of faculty, staff, students, patients, and other stakeholders.
 
 
Working collaboratively with ASOD leadership and stakeholders across the School and University, the Director of Continuous Improvement & Transformation identifies organizational and operational challenges and opportunities for improvement; defines, scopes, and prioritizes projects; analyzes current-state processes and organizational needs; and facilitates the development of solutions aligned with ASOD priorities. The position serves as a strategic thought partner to leadership and applies project management, change management, analytical, and continuous improvement approaches to complex issues that may cross multiple departments, programs, and functional areas.
 
 
The Director of Continuous Improvement & Transformation leads initiatives through the full project lifecycle, including project definition and planning, analysis and solution design, implementation, change management, evaluation, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities include establishing project goals, deliverables, measures of success, and implementation strategies; coordinating work among subject matter experts and stakeholders; monitoring progress and outcomes; identifying and resolving barriers; and supporting the adoption and sustainability of improvements.
 
 
Projects vary in size, complexity, duration, and organizational impact. Depending on the scope and complexity of assigned initiatives, the position may lead a single large-scale project or manage multiple concurrent projects. The role works across organizational boundaries and relies on collaboration, facilitation, strategic influence, and effective stakeholder engagement to advance initiatives and achieve measurable improvements in support of ASOD priorities.

 

**Minimum Education and Experience Requirements**

Master’s or Bachelor’s and 0-2 years’ experience; or will accept a combination of related education and experience in substitution.

 

**Required Qualifications, Competencies, and Experience**

Demonstrated knowledge of project management, change management, organizational improvement, and problem-solving principles, with the ability to apply these concepts to complex, cross-functional initiatives.
 
 
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to assess organizational and operational challenges, evaluate potential solutions, develop actionable recommendations, and use qualitative and quantitative information to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
 
 
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with leaders and stakeholders across multiple functional areas and organizational levels and to facilitate change and influence outcomes without direct supervisory authority.
 
Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate meetings and discussions, present information and recommendations, and communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
 
 
Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities, exercise sound judgment, navigate ambiguity, monitor progress and outcomes, and adapt to changing organizational needs.

 

**Preferred Qualifications, Competencies, and Experience**

Experience leading complex, cross-functional or organization-wide projects, strategic initiatives, operational reviews, or organizational improvement efforts.
 
 
Demonstrated experience applying project management and change management methodologies to the planning and implementation of complex initiatives.
 
 
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred. Formal training or certification in organizational change management methodologies, such as Prosci Change Management Certification or an equivalent program, is highly desirable.
 
 
Experience facilitating collaborative problem-solving and solution-design activities with senior leaders, subject matter experts, and stakeholders across multiple functional areas.
 
 
Experience developing performance measures, analyzing outcomes, and using data and metrics to evaluate effectiveness and support continuous improvement.
 
 
Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information and develop clear recommendations, presentations, and other communications for senior leadership and diverse stakeholder groups.
 
 
Experience working within a complex organization, preferably in higher education, academic health care, or a similarly decentralized environment.
 
 
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and experience using project management, collaboration, data visualization, or related business tools.

 

**Special Physical/Mental Requirements**

 

**Campus Security Authority Responsibilities**

This position is designated as a Campus Security Authority in accordance with the Clery Act. This position will be required to report Clery crimes to the Clery Compliance Manager and complete annual training about reporting responsibilities.

new_roles.title: Director, Merchandising Operations
new_roles.description:
Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment.

Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

### **About the Role**

Parachute Health is building the definitive platform for ordering home medical equipment and supplies, helping clinicians and suppliers ensure that millions of patients each year receive the critical equipment and supplies they need. Our Merchandising Operations team (AKA "Merch") comprises Category Managers and Category Analysts who have three primary jobs: 1) build and maintain our catalog, 2) build and maintain our coverage criteria rules engine, and 3) partner with R&D to improve the tools and workflows behind both. Merch sits at the intersection of e-commerce, compliance, operations, and R&D, and its work is central to Parachute's core functionality. Clinicians use our catalog to find and order the right equipment for their patients, and suppliers rely on it to fulfill those orders. Our coverage criteria help users determine whether an item should be covered by the patient's insurance.

The Merch team's work is nuanced and detail-dense: we maintain information on tens of thousands of products so our software, and the people who use it, can rely on it. The 18-person team splits its time between project work, like building and redesigning product categories and turning payer rules into qualification questions, and ticket-based work, resolving complex requests escalated by our support and partner teams. Our work requires efficient operational processes and excellent documentation.

As Director of Merchandising Operations, you will own the team's operating framework: how work is planned, prioritized, and delivered, and how the team partners with other teams across Parachute. You'll coach and develop a mix of managers and individual contributors, lead the team's largest cross-functional projects, and serve as a close thought partner to the SVP of Merchandising.

The role is primarily internal (roughly 90%), with occasional customer communication, especially on escalations, that calls for a steady, polished hand.

### **What You'll Do**

* Be the operational leader for a highly motivated, highly capable team of managers and individual contributors: keep work running smoothly, protect morale, and learn and add to a team culture that is already strong.
* Drive key projects: stay close to the work and personally drive the team's largest, most complex projects, including timelines, dependencies, and cross-team communication.
* Know every team process end to end. Lead the creation, maintenance, and centralization of SOPs and shared resources; drive consistent practices, training, quality assurance, and continuous improvement across category teams.
* Collaborate with partner teams (e.g., Supplier Implementation, Product, Customer Success) so handoffs and shared processes run smoothly.
* Be a Merch advocate: make the team's work understandable and visible across the company.
* Run bandwidth and capacity planning; flag risks early and rebalance coverage.
* Define and report on team metrics (ticket throughput, SLAs, SKU work, rollout milestones).
* Own escalations as needed, partnering effectively with people at all levels across the organization.
* Support recruiting as needed, own onboarding for new merchants, and maintain continuity coverage for every category.

### **Requirements**

* 7+ years in operations, program delivery, or management or technology consulting (e.g., a Big Four or top-tier firm), with 3+ years managing and growing managers.
* Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects using a clear, repeatable methodology.
* Data-driven: comfortable with capacity models, dashboards and prioritization trade-offs.
* Willingness to travel roughly once a quarter.

### **More About You**

* Passionate about improving patient outcomes in the healthcare space.
* Gets things done: drives work to completion and builds processes that stick.
* Thrives in complex, nuanced domains; quickly learns intricate systems (e.g., insurance coverage rules, product data) well enough to make sound calls.
* Clear, concise communicator who pushes back constructively and drives decisions.
* Sound compliance judgment: in a highly regulated industry, you know which issues to resolve and which to escalate.
* Track record of growing into increasing scope and responsibility.
* Nice to have: catalog, product data or e-commerce experience; healthcare, DME/HME or payer experience.

### **Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Comprehensive plans with options for low-to-no-cost premiums
* Employer HSA Contribution: Company-funded contributions to your Health Savings Account
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Equity Incentive Plan
* Annual Company-Wide Bonus: Opportunity for up to 15% bonus based on company performance
* Remote-First Culture: We are remote-first with a dedicated NYC office and reimbursement options for co-working spaces
* Flexible Vacation Policy
* Summer Fridays: 5 additional Fridays off during the summer (separate from PTO)
* Home Office and Wellness Stipend
* Monthly Internet Stipend
* Annual Learning and Development Stipend

### **Base Salary Range (based on level and experience)**

$145,000-$180,000

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
--------------------------------------------

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

 
 
 

**Local Study Operations Manager (LSOM), Director**
---------------------------------------------------

**What you will do**
--------------------

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will provide strategic and operational leadership for the country LSOM organization and is accountable for the quality, timeliness, cost, and compliant execution of the country clinical study portfolio. The role achieves results through LSOM Senior Managers and their FTE and FSP teams, translating global clinical development strategy into country operating priorities. The role directs portfolio delivery, resource and capacity strategy, financial planning, quality and risk management, vendor performance, and inspection readiness from feasibility through study close-out. As a member of the country leadership team, this role influences study placement and portfolio decisions, leads the resolution of significant operational issues, develops organizational capability and succession plans, and represents LSOM operations in country, regional, and global governance forums.

 
 

**Accountabilities**

* Lead the successful delivery of the country study portfolio through the LSOM management organization, ensuring alignment with global clinical development priorities.

* Provides strategic direction and leadership to LSOM country organization across the full study lifecycle, including feasibility, study execution, and study close-out.

* Establishes portfolio-level oversight of delivery, quality, risk, timelines, and performance, directing timely escalation and resolution of critical issues for LSOM management organization.

* Manage LSOM and LSOM vendor performance to guarantee high-quality study execution, serving as the primary escalation point for local study challenges, driving solutions, and ensuring portfolio targets are met within the country.

* Build leadership capability within the LSOM organization through targeted coaching, development, and succession planning, preparing LSOMs to lead increasingly complex trials and programs.

* Establishes strong operating partnerships with Clinical Research Associate (CRA) organization to support study start-up, monitoring, issue resolution, and compliant trial execution across the country portfolio.

* Cultivate a high-performing, accountable, and inclusive organization focused on operational excellence and continuous improvement.

* Champion strong integration between study strategy and local execution teams to translate portfolio priorities into effective country-level delivery.

* Strengthen cross-functional alignment and accountability across country teams to accelerate execution and deliver portfolio commitments.

* Influences study-placement and portfolio investment decisions by providing strategic insight into country's capabilities, operational readiness, performance, and growth potential.

* Anticipates portfolio-level delivery risks, quality trends, and evolving resource requirements, directing mitigation strategies and systemic improvements across country operations.

* Sponsor initiatives that advance operational efficiency, digital innovation, organizational capability, and the adoption of leading practices.

* Direct resource strategy, capacity planning, and workload allocation across FSP and FTE LSOM teams to optimize execution and align resources with global priorities.

* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, GCP, ICH, and organizational standards across the country's study portfolio.

Partner with the Regional Head/Country Head and senior cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, establish accountability for trial deliverables, and resolve significant escalations. 



**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the functional leader for LSOM Senior Managers and the broader LSOM team, including both FSP and FTE, to optimize trial execution and align with global priorities. including strategy and execution, managing risks and escalations

* Partners closely with CRAs, CSPO, Quality, and FSP partners.

* Leads the coordination among country functional teams to ensure successful delivery of the country portfolio.

* Ensure inspection readiness and provide hands-on support during inspections, including responsibility for storyboards.

* Sponsors continuous operational improvement initiatives and encourage sharing of best practices.

* Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory and quality standards.

* Collaborate with the Regional Head/Country Head to engage cross-functional stakeholders, align on trial deliverables, and manage escalations as needed.

**Capability Building and People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop LSOM Sr Managers, including performance management, succession planning, and leadership bench development.

* Build the organizational capabilities, resourcing needed to meet the current and future regional portfolio requirements.

* Foster a high-performing, inclusive, accountable, and patient-focused culture across geographically distributed teams.

* Lead organizational changes and enable adoption of new operating models, technologies

**Authority**

* Accountable for country level oversight and delivery of clinical trials.

* Manage the performance of LSOM Senior Managers and their teams

* Holds line management authority for regional and country operations leaders, including performance management, talent development, succession planning, and capability building.

* Sets regional delivery goals, operating expectations, and performance standards across study start-up, site engagement, monitoring, execution, and closeout.

* Capability build, talent and performance management, and acting as a liaison for cultural differences within region.

**Outputs**

* Manage LSOM resources in accordance with the global study strategy.

* Oversee resource allocation and workload balance across LSOMs.

* Handle FSP supplier resource coordination and monitor performance through quality oversight metrics.

* Identify and report any risks or compliance concerns related to FSP activities.

* Escalate issues to the Regional/Country Head as necessary.

**What we expect of you**

 
 

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Doctorate degree and 4 years of clinical research experience OR
* Master’s degree and 7 years of clinical research experience OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of clinical research experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 4 years of direct managerial and/or leadership experience or equivalent

* Deep knowledge of ICH GCP, ICH E6(R3), ICH E8(R1), and global regulatory expectations for risk-based monitoring and clinical trial oversight.

* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead complex cross-functional initiatives within a global matrix organization

* Strong Project Management experience

* Experience managing multiple teams / direct reports across multiple clinical functions / trials

* Experience at, or oversight of, clinical research vendors (CROs, central labs, imaging vendors, etc.)

* Experience managing clinical operations across relevant geography / region, including strong understanding of local regulatory requirements around global clinical trials

**What you can expect of us**
-----------------------------

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Description Director of Operations - Hybrid

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a high-caliber, transformative **Director of Operations** to lead, scale, and optimize our operations. In this role, you will serve as a strategic leader responsible for driving operational excellence, customer advocacy, and regulatory integrity across a multi-faceted organization.

 
 

You will move beyond routine contact center management to steer a dynamic organization comprised of specialized internal operational teams—covering strategic readiness, advanced customer advocacy, and complex fraud/escalation management—alongside large-scale BPO vendor partners managing ~200+ frontline agents.

 
 

You bring a blend of strategic vision, process optimization discipline, vendor governance, and high-impact people leadership required to elevate operational standards and deliver best-in-class customer experiences.

 
 

**You have a proven track record of:**

* **Large-Scale Operations Leadership**: Successfully leading multi-site contact center operations combining internal teams and offshore/nearshore vendor partners of 200+ headcount.
* **Operational Transformation**: Transforming reactive service centers into proactive, quality-focused customer advocacy hubs through structured process engineering.
* **Escalation & Fraud Management**: Effectively mitigating enterprise risk through robust Tier 2 & 3 complaint handling, fraud prevention protocols, and regulatory adherence.
* **Vendor Operations Governance**: Driving rigorous SLA performance, cost efficiency, and quality alignment across third-party BPO vendor organizations.
 

 

**What you’ll do:**

The Director of Operations maintains end-to-end accountability for operational strategy, performance delivery, vendor oversight, and organizational readiness.

* **Leadership Reach**: Direct oversight of Department Managers, Unit Managers (UMs), and Vendor Managers (VMs) across internal and external business units.
* **Core Internal Operations**:
 + **Strategic Operations:** Driving CX quality call listening, 1:1 and group coaching/training, operations readiness, and training materials maintenance.
 + **Customer Advocacy:** Overseeing high-touch inbound customer service, task execution, complex account resolution, and U.S. transfer handling.
 + **Escalations and Fraud**: Leading high-severity escalated problem solving, fraud operations, customer complaint research and resolution, and escalation follow-ups.
* **Core External Operations:**
 + Governance and SLA performance tracking for primary vendor partners overseeing a network of ~200+ non-associate vendor agents performing inbound calls and funding workflows.

 

**Key Focus Areas:**

* Reimagine end to end Operations in this era of AI
* Strategic Leadership & Governance to formulate and execute long-term operational strategies and partner cross functionally
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Business Analysis, and Process teams to establish and update processes, policies, procedures, and standards
* Define operational KPIs, quality targets, and SLA metrics to ensure consistent service delivery, funding accuracy, and customer satisfaction
* Direct vendor management leads to oversee third-party partners, ensuring ~200+ vendor agents adhere to operational guidelines and productivity benchmarks
* Risk, Fraud, & Complaint Resolution spanning complex problem solving and root-cause analysis
* Ensure business readiness for product launches, process updates, and technology enhancements across all operational sub-functions
* Mentor, develop, and inspire a multi-layered leadership team, cultivating a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and high performance.
* Optimize talent allocation and capacity planning across teams to handle volume fluctuations dynamically.
 

 

**Location:** Plano, TX - This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

 
 

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or military experience
* At least 5 years of people leadership experience
* At least 5 years of process or project management experience
* At least 5 years of relationship management experience
* At least 5 years of experience delivering transformational initiatives
 

 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* PMP, Lean, Agile, or Six Sigma certification
* At least 3 years of operations people leadership experience
* At least 7 years of people leadership experience
 

 

**At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, E-3, and O-1, or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer)**

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.
