existing_roles.title: Global Director of Quality
existing_roles.description:
**Lead Globally. Drive Innovation. Make an Impact.**

**Join Amphenol Alden and Make a Difference in Patient Care Worldwide!**

At **Amphenol Alden Products (AAP)**, what we do matters. Our medical cable assemblies and interconnect solutions support the advanced technologies healthcare professionals rely on every day. Behind every product is a patient, a family, and an opportunity to make a difference in someone's life.

With roots as a family business more than 90 years ago, Amphenol Alden combines a proud history and entrepreneurial spirit with the resources and opportunities of a global corporation. We are a growing organization that values innovation, teamwork, accountability, and the contributions of our employees.

We believe our people are the foundation of our success. That's why we offer competitive compensation, an outstanding benefits package, work/life balance, and opportunities for professional growth and development.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced and strategic **Global Director of Quality** to lead and advance quality operations across four manufacturing facilities in the United States, Mexico, India, and China.

Reporting to AAP’s General Manager and serving as a member of the Leadership Team, this individual will establish and drive the global quality strategy, strengthen Quality Management Systems (QMS), and promote a culture of quality excellence and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact by developing high-performing global Quality teams, driving operational improvements, strengthening customer and supplier partnerships, and ensuring consistent quality standards across all manufacturing locations.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities**

* **Global Quality Strategy:** Develop and execute global quality strategies, objectives, and initiatives that support business goals, product quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* **Quality Management Systems:** Lead the development, implementation, standardization, and continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems across all facilities, ensuring compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 13485, applicable FDA requirements, customer specifications, and other relevant regulatory standards.
* **Executive Leadership:** Participate as a member of the Executive Leadership Team in establishing business strategies, operational objectives, and organizational improvement initiatives.
* **Quality Performance:** Establish and monitor global quality metrics, including customer complaints, internal and supplier defects, Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), corrective actions, and audit performance. Drive measurable improvements in quality and process capability.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and data-driven problem-solving methodologies to reduce defects, minimize waste, improve process consistency, and enhance overall operational performance.
* **Engineering and Operations Partnership:** Collaborate with Engineering and Operations to ensure effective quality planning, design and process FMEAs, risk assessments, process validation, and verification throughout the product lifecycle.
* **New Product Introduction:** Provide quality leadership for New Product Introduction (NPI) and manufacturing transfers, ensuring process capability, quality requirements, and customer expectations are met before production release.
* **Supplier Quality:** Partner with Global Supply Chain to develop and maintain a high-performing supplier base through supplier qualification, audits, performance monitoring, development, and corrective action programs.
* **Customer Quality:** Provide strategic leadership for customer quality initiatives, serving as the senior escalation point for significant quality concerns, customer audits, and corrective action resolution.
* **Audits and Regulatory Compliance:** Oversee internal and external quality audits, regulatory inspections, and management reviews, ensuring findings are addressed promptly and compliance is sustained.
* **Corrective and Preventive Action:** Strengthen global CAPA processes through effective root cause analysis, risk mitigation, and prevention of recurring quality issues.
* **Global Team Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and develop the global Quality organization, establishing clear expectations, accountability, talent development plans, and succession strategies.
* **Global Standardization:** Promote consistency and the sharing of best practices across manufacturing facilities in the United States, Mexico, India, and China.
* **Executive Reporting:** Provide regular updates to executive leadership on global quality performance, emerging risks, customer satisfaction, and progress toward strategic quality objectives.

**Related Experience and Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality, Engineering, or a related technical or scientific discipline; Master's degree preferred.
* 10+ years of previous related experience and at least 5 years of experience managing individuals.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 9001, FDA Quality System requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
* Demonstrated experience leading Quality Management Systems and continuous improvement initiatives across multiple manufacturing locations.
* Strong working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, CAPA, root cause analysis, risk management, and quality improvement methodologies.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams, develop talent, and drive results in a global organization.

**Why Join Amphenol Alden?**

We believe great people deserve a great place to work. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your professional success, financial future, and overall well-being.

* Competitive salary and bonus opportunity.
* Hybrid work schedule.
* Excellent 401(k) retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future.
* Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short- and long-term disability, Health Savings Account (HSA), and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA).
* Employee discounts and company-sponsored activities.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career development.
* The opportunity to lead a global organization and make a meaningful contribution to products that support patient care worldwide.

**Ready to Lead What's Next?**

If you are a strategic quality leader who thrives on building strong teams, solving complex challenges, and driving results across global operations, we'd love to hear from you!

**Join Amphenol Alden and help shape the future of our global operations while making a difference in patient care around the world.**

*Amphenol Alden Products is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

*Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.*

existing_roles.description:
**About Tutor**

We believe robots should be the next chapter in making physical labor safer and more affordable. But, nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t have a single robot. Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

We build robots that go straight into real factories and warehouses, to do real work, with real impact. Our robot Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Our robot Sonny does handwork, using two arms to achieve human-like dexterity in picking and packing. Every robot learns on the job, and each one we deploy makes the next one more capable, more affordable, and faster to put to work.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, we do it all in-house: the robotics hardware, the machine learning, and the field deployment and service. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

**Why Tutor?**

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.

Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

**The Role**

Tutor is hiring a Head of Quality to lead quality as a function, alongside the Head of Manufacturing. You own the quality system, supplier quality across our supply base, product safety certifications, and the quality targets the company holds itself to. The quality engineers and the quality manager report to you, and you grow the team from there. You report to the CTO. As our operations organization grows, you and the Head of Manufacturing will report to the leader of that organization.

This is a building role. The first pieces, incoming inspection, supplier controls and failure analysis, are being put in place by the team you will lead. Your job is to turn them into a system that holds as production grows, a supplier base we can trust, and a quality record that customers and certifying bodies can verify. You have the authority to hold any shipment that is not right.

### **Requirements**

* You have led a quality function at a company that builds complex electromechanical hardware in volume
* You have built or rebuilt a quality system and taken it through ISO 9001 or an equivalent certification
* You have run supplier quality across a supply base, including suppliers overseas
* You have taken a product through product safety certification
* You have built and led a team of quality engineers and managers
* You make decisions from data, and you can hold a shipment when the data says so

### **Nice to haves**

* Robotics, automation, vehicles, or capital equipment
* Reliability engineering methods: life testing, failure rate analysis, design reviews
* Building quality data and tooling that other teams use
* Experience with manufacturing execution systems

### **Benefits**

* **Fully employer-covered health insurance**, so you’re protected without the premium.
* **A managed 401(k)** to help you plan for the future.
* **Generous time off:** unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full-time salaried employees, and 16+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees.
* **Regular in-office meals** and team social events throughout the year.

**Compensation**

The base salary range for this role is $220,000 to $280,000, depending on experience.

As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond.

*Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.*

existing_roles.description:
Department: Quality Assurance / Quality Control

Reports To: CEO / Executive Assistant

Location: On-site — Phoenix, Arizona Manufacturing Facility

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry Focus: Private-label OTC drugs, personal care, and nutraceuticals (dietary supplements)

Position Summary

The Head of Quality Assurance is the senior quality leader responsible for the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Specialty Formulations & Manufacturing’s Quality Management System (QMS) across all private-label product categories: over-the-counter (OTC) drugs, personal care and cosmetic products, and nutraceuticals / dietary supplements. This role owns regulatory readiness (FDA, state boards of pharmacy or health, and applicable international standards), batch release integrity, customer and brand-owner quality expectations, supplier quality, laboratory oversight, complaint and deviation systems, and inspection / audit performance.

The Head of QA is both a hands-on quality professional and a people leader. In a private-label environment, the position must balance speed-to-market and custom formulations with uncompromising compliance, documentation discipline, and brand-protection for client companies.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Own, maintain, and continually improve the site Quality Management System covering OTC drug CGMP (21 CFR 210/211), dietary supplement CGMP (21 CFR 111), and cosmetic / personal care good manufacturing practices (including 21 CFR 700 series and MoCRA-related requirements as applicable).
* Establish quality policy, quality objectives, management review cadence, and quality metrics (batch right-first-time, deviation rate, complaint rate, CAPA effectiveness, on-time release, audit findings).
* Author, approve, and control SOPs, specifications, master batch records, testing protocols, validation protocols, and quality agreements.
* Serve as primary quality contact for FDA inspections (drug, dietary supplement, and cosmetic), state inspections, customer audits, certification bodies, and third-party laboratories.
* Maintain inspection readiness at all times: documentation control, training files, equipment logs, environmental monitoring, stability programs, and reserve samples.
* Own FDA correspondence related to quality (483 responses, warning letter remediation, facility registration / listing support, product listing support as assigned).
* Final authority for batch disposition (release, reject, or quarantine) of OTC, personal care, and nutraceutical lots.
* Oversee in-process controls, finished-product testing, incoming raw material and component qualification, and certificate of analysis review.
* Ensure appropriate specifications exist for each private-label SKU, including customer-specific requirements captured in quality agreements and product technical files.
* Oversee environmental monitoring, water systems, cleaning validation / verification, equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), and process validation appropriate to product risk. Deviations, Complaints, CAPA & Change Control
* Own deviation, OOS / OOT, nonconformance, customer complaint, and product quality complaint systems, including investigation quality and timely close-out.
* Lead CAPA from root-cause analysis through effectiveness checks.
* Administer change control for formulas, processes, equipment, suppliers, specifications, and labels that can affect product quality.
* Manage product hold, recall / market withdrawal readiness, and mock recall exercises. Supplier, Customer & Brand-Owner Quality
* Qualify and periodically requalify raw material, component, packaging, and contract laboratory suppliers; maintain approved supplier lists and quality agreements.
* Build a culture in which quality is owned on the floor—not only in the QA office—through training,
* Ensure cGMP, hygiene, documentation, and data-integrity training is current for all relevant employees and contractors.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related scientific field. Advanced degree preferred.
* 2+ years of progressive quality experience in regulated manufacturing, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Direct experience with at least two of the three product categories: OTC drugs (21 CFR 210/211), dietary supplements (21 CFR 111), and personal care / cosmetics. Experience across all three is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership of FDA inspection readiness and successful inspection outcomes.
* Proven ability to write and defend investigations, CAPAs, and regulatory responses.
* Working knowledge of USP, NSF or equivalent supplement standards, ISO 22716 (cosmetics GMP) or equivalent, and stability / shelf-life principles.
* Strong command of documentation systems, batch record review, and electronic or hybrid record control.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with MoCRA, facility registration, product listing, and adverse event reporting for cosmetics.
* Familiarity with OTC monograph reform (CARES Act) and OTC labeling / Drug Facts requirements.
* Experience with dietary supplement identity testing, adulteration risk (e.g., spiked ingredients), and structure/function claim boundaries.

**Core Competencies**

* Intellectual honesty and backbone — willing to stop a batch or a shipment when the science or the record does not support release.
* Clear writing — SOPs, investigations, and FDA/customer responses that are precise, factual, and defensible.
* Operational partnership — works with production, purchasing, R&D / formulation, and sales without becoming a bottleneck or a rubber stamp.
* Risk-based thinking — applies controls commensurate with product risk (drug vs. cosmetic vs. supplement) rather than a one-size-fits-all bureaucracy.
* Teaching ability — raises the quality literacy of operators, formulators, and customer-facing staff.
* Confidentiality and professionalism with brand-owner formulas, claims, and audit findings.

**Working Conditions**

This is a hands-on, on-site role in a manufacturing environment. The Head of QA will spend time on the production floor, in the laboratory, in the warehouse, and in the quality office. The position requires the ability to review documents for extended periods, walk the facility, and respond to quality events, including during inspections. Some evening or weekend availability may be required during FDA inspections, customer audits, or critical batch investigations.

**Authority**

This position has independent authority to reject raw materials, halt production, withhold batch release, initiate product holds, and escalate quality risk directly to ownership. Quality decisions are not subordinate to

production schedule or sales commitments.

This job description outlines the general nature and essential functions of the role. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Duties may be added, removed, or modified to meet business and regulatory needs.

* Paid time off
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

existing_roles.description:
**Company Overview**

Contentnea Health is a Community Health Center providing comprehensive medical, dental and behavioral health services for members of our communities in Greene, Pitt and Pamlico counties in eastern North Carolina.

**Job Summary**

Provides strategic leadership, oversight, and coordination of all organizational quality initiatives, including designing, implementing and evaluating quality programs to ensure delivery of safe, patient-centered, equitable, and efficient care, leads data-driven improvement efforts, and supports regulatory reporting and compliance with standards.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* Oversees the Quality Improvement (QI) department activities.
 + Leads the development, implementation, and evaluation of the organization’s Quality Improvement Program.
 + Identifies opportunities to support QI efforts through evaluation, testing, and/or integration for electronic health record (EHR) functionality and other Heath Information and Technology (HIT) systems.
 + Summarizes and shares clinical quality data with the Board, key leadership, and staff to inform decision-making and priorities for improvement.
 + Champions the adoption of standardized best practices and lessons learned across disciplines and departments at the care team level and at the organizational level using communication tools, published workflows, staff meetings, events and trainings.
 + Facilitates QI Committee meetings and ensures documentation, follow-up, and progress tracking.
 + Establishes annual QI goals, work plans, and performance benchmarks aligned with strategic priorities.
 + Develops dashboards and data tools to share performance results with leadership and staff.
* Collaborates with and guides clinical care team members to establish QI processes through the organization.
 + Leads or participates in work teams related to QI and functions as a coach to support care team in building, fostering patient-centeredness and healthy patient outcomes.
 + Researches external organizations and participates in training opportunities, and works with partners, consultants and experts to guide QI efforts.
 + Assesses the need for and facilitates education, training, and technical assistance for staff to ensure compliance with QI efforts.
 + Uses existing data systems to identify areas in need of quality improvement across the organization.
* Oversees organizational data submission and sharing to external entities in collaboration with other departments as needed.
 + Follows regulation on data collection and reporting structure as defined by the Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) and health plan incentives.
 + Approaches changes to the EHR or other IT systems with consideration to data governance.
 + Monitors Federal Tort Claims Act (FTCA) requirements and the health center’s compliance.
 + Leads the annual FTCA deeming and redeeming application process and ensures all required evidence and documentation are completed and submitted accurately.
 + Ensures accurate and timely reporting of UDS clinical measures and other federal/state quality requirements.
 + Participates in HRSA review and response with organization leaders.
 + Acts as administrator for electronic Value-Based Care (VBC) and Quality Incentive Plans (QIP) platforms.
 + Partners with key leadership to determine participation priorities.
 + Oversees QI and clinical participation in contracted VBC and QIPs.
 + Monitors performance with VBC and incentive plans; shares performance data with key leadership.
* Ensures ongoing alignment with Patient-Centered Medical Home (PCMH) standards, manages The National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA) reporting and serves as PCMH project manager.
 + Leads annual submission of PCMH report to maintain recognition for each recognized site and maintains documentation and policies needed for audits, accreditation, and regulatory compliance.
 + Ensures all new hires are trained in PCMH processes, policies, and workflows, including care coordination, team-based care, access, patient experience and satisfaction.
 + Maintains current knowledge of NCQA/PCMH standards and serves as the subject matter expert. Analyzes and reviews processes, policies, and systems on an ongoing basis to ensure they are aligned with current and updated PCMH standards.
 + Uses data to drive continuous improvement in clinical quality, patient experience and cost/utilization outcomes.
 + Reports PCMH performance to leadership to inform resource allocation and prioritize performance improvement activities.
 + Coordinates PCMH improvement activities with staff and leadership.
* Provides overall management and direction to departmental staff.
 + Oversees the development and maintenance of the departmental budget; monitors ongoing budgetary compliance and addresses problems as needed.
 + Delegates departmental duties and responsibilities; participates in high priority special projects and activities.
 + Represents the department at all senior management meetings.
 + Prepares departmental company policies and procedures and conveys all senior management communications and directives.
 + Monitors departmental performance using company performance standards and addresses issues as needed.
 + Directs departmental performance and provides specific instructions on completion of tasks/responsibilities.
 + Prepares and conducts performance appraisals for immediate staff.
 + Conducts hiring, disciplinary, and termination procedures.

**Qualifications and Skills**

Bachelor Degree in Nursing. Current licensure as a Registered Nurse in good standing with the NC Board of Nursing. Possesses advanced understanding of quality improvement theory and quality methodology, evidence-based practice, state and national priorities for patient safety and population health as determined by HRSA, DHHS, and other entities, and regulatory, recognition and compliance standards, such as FTCA, PCMH, and HRSA. The ideal candidate will have progressive experience in leading quality improvement activities and in leading staff.

Description:

Exalt Health, an acute rehabilitation hospital, provides an intensive rehabilitation program, and admitted patients must be able to tolerate three hours of intense rehabilitation services per day. Focused on caring for patients with complex rehabilitative needs such as stroke, spinal cord injury, brain injury, head trauma, medically debilitation conditions, neurological disorders, cardio-pulmonary amputations, orthopedic injuries, and multiple major traumas.

**Position Summary**

The Quality Director is responsible for spearheading the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of a comprehensive quality and patient safety program throughout our inpatient rehabilitation hospital network. In this role, you will drive a culture of excellence, ensuring our delivery of the highest standards of patient care across all our facilities in Texas. This position demands strong leadership, data analysis skills, exceptional attention to detail, and an unwavering commitment to patient-centered care.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Strategic Planning: Design and implement a system-wide quality management framework, aligning with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Performance Monitoring: Oversee the collection, analysis, and reporting of key quality metrics and patient outcome data. Identify trends, pinpoint areas for improvement, and develop targeted interventions.
* Continuous Improvement: Lead initiatives to enhance clinical quality, patient safety, and process efficiency across all rehabilitation facilities. Implement evidence-based best practices and drive innovation in quality improvement endeavors.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure adherence to all state, federal, and accreditation standards (e.g., The Joint Commission) related to quality management and patient safety.
* Education and Training: Develop and deliver educational programs to cultivate a quality-focused culture among staff at all levels.
* Collaboration: Partner with clinical leaders, department heads, and frontline staff to foster a collaborative environment focused on continuous improvement and patient satisfaction.
* Risk Management: Proactively identify and mitigate potential risks to patient safety and guide the organization in proactive risk management practices.
* Board Reporting: Prepare regular reports for the Executive Leadership team and Board of Directors, showcasing quality performance metrics, initiatives, and strategic recommendations.

Requirements:

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

Licenses or Certifications

* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) or other relevant quality certifications highly desired.
* Current, unencumbered clinical licenses in the state where the hospital is operating required.

Education, Training, and Experience

* Education in a healthcare-related field or a clinical degree preferred.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare quality management, with a proven track record in an inpatient hospital setting.

Skills and Abilities, Proficiency and Productivity Standards

* Deep knowledge of quality improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, PDSA).
* Expertise in healthcare regulatory standards, accreditation requirements, and best practices.
* Proficiency in healthcare data management and statistical analysis tools.
* Organizes and prioritizes tasks and projects, accurately completing job responsibilities within the specified time constraints.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
* Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work under deadlines and handle multiple tasks.
* Speaks and communicates English effectively in verbal and written format; writes legibly.
* Reading and comprehension at the level necessary to perform job duties appropriately.
* Works cooperatively with co-workers and other hospital employees
* Functions proficiently in a Microsoft Windows environment (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

The company is an equal opportunity employer, drug-free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.

existing_roles.description:
**Summary:** Lead the company’s food safety, quality assurance, laboratory, and regulatory compliance programs. Establishes and maintains effective systems that protect consumers, meet customer and certification requirements, and support consistent manufacturing of safe, high-quality popcorn products.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

**Food Safety & Compliance**

* Direct the BRCGS food safety certification program, HACCP plans, & FSMA compliance activities
* Maintain & improve food safety plans, SOPs, SSOPs, records, training, verification activities, and audit readiness
* Help lead internal, customer, regulatory, and certification audits; oversee corrective actions and timely closure of findings
* Maintain product and ingredient specifications, quality databases, ERP traceability, and recall-readiness procedures, develop production BOMs in an ERP program, support production planning systems

**Quality Assurance & Lab**

* Lead the Quality Supervisor and Product Development Specialist; establish priorities, training, performance, expectations, and accountability
* Oversee lab equipment, supplies, maintenance and methods, including peroxide value, oil color, moisture, salt, allergen, microbiological, and popping-performance testing as well as QC related production equipment
* Provide quality assessment of slurry process deviations and misbatches; coordinate corrective formula decisions with Product Development & Production
* Oversee sampling, analytical and microbiological testing, shelf-life studies, calibration, and reliable reporting of results
* Track quality metrics, identify trends, and drive preventive and corrective improvements with operations
* Calculate Nutritional Profiles
* Develop FDA compliant Ingredient Statements

**Supplier, Sanitation, & Allergen Programs**

* Manage supplier and raw-material qualification, specifications, receiving/testing standards, and supplier corrective actions for ingredients, packaging, and co-manufacturers
* Maintain allergen controls and the allergen matrix, partner with sanitation leadership on environmental monitoring and sanitation validation, including CIP and warewashing as applicable
* Coordinate on ingredient and packaging supplier issues, including flavors and microwave popcorn bags
* Additional Food Safety & Quality Program responsibility

**Regulatory, Customer, & Incident Response**

* Review ingredient declarations, allergen statements, labeling compliance, product claims, and export requirements in collaboration with Marketing & Product Development
* Maintain applicable kosher, halal, gluten-free, and other customer or product certifications
* Investigate complaints, nonconforming product and food safety incidents; direct holds, disposition decisions, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions within company authority
* Maintain customer quality documentation and retailer portals, communicate food safety risks promptly to leadership
* Food regulatory resource for all FDA changes, including labeling for US, Canada, & International

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Partner with Product Development on safe product introductions, specifications, allergen review, and manufacturing handoffs
* Build a proactive food safety culture through coaching, floor presence and cross-functional training
* And all other duties as assigned by Supervisor

**Qualifications:**

To perform this job successfully an individual must have the following: Strong leadership skills and a proven track record of effectively leading teams and managing people. A bachelor’s degree in food science, microbiology, chemistry, or related discipline required. Significant progressive experience in food manufacturing quality assurance and food safety, including people leadership. Hands on HACCP, FSMA/PCQI, and GFSI-recognized certification program experience; BRCGS preferred. Experience managing a quality lab, supplier quality, investigation, and audits. Experience with shelf-stable snack, fats/oils, or microwave product experience is a plus, but not required. International labeling and kosher/halal experience preferred. ERP, SPC, Power BI, Excel and quality reporting tool experience a plus.

**Skills and Competencies:**

This role will provide strong leadership to employees, fostering a positive and high-performing culture. Must possess the ability to set clear expectations while helping guide department supervisors. Must work to identify and minimize risks that could impact the company while ensuring safety compliance. Ensures we are staying compliant with legal and regulatory requirements while upholding high standards and ethical conduct throughout the organization. Must have excellent communication skills to engage with all levels of employees at all locations while encouraging collaboration across. Sound decision-making ability skill needed to prioritize initiatives, assess risks, and make decisions that align with the organization. Deep understanding of the technical aspects related to APCC products. Strong problem solving skills needed to address quality issues promptly and effectively. Analytical skills required to analyze data, processes, and systems to identify areas for improvement.

**Work Environment:**

The work environment is both an office setting at a manufacturing facility and in the manufacturing facility itself. The environment is often dynamic and collaborative, with collaboration being essential in this role. Employees will contribute to overall production goals, with office employees supporting the efficiency and effectiveness of the manufacturing processes. The manufacturing facility involves hands-on tasks, machinery operation, and adherence to GMPs. This setting requires attention to detail, adherence to protocols, and the ability to adapt to the demands of the production schedule. Working hours outside of standard office hours may be required.

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential responsibilities of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This position requires a combination of sitting and standing throughout the workday. You will need to regularly engage in tasks that involve sitting at a desk for data entry and analysis, as well as administrative duties. You will also need to engage in tasks that require periods of standing, mobility and interaction with team members. This role requires adaptability to the changing demands of tasks and responsibilities. May be occasional lifting of supplies, typically not exceeding 20 pounds.

**General:**

At American Pop Corn Company, our culture is built on our TACT values – Teamwork, Always Learning, Customer First, & Tenacious. We are committed to creating a workplace where employees treat one another with respect, communicate openly, and work collaboratively toward shared goals.

Every employee plays an important role in our success. We are expected to support one another, remain adaptable, and step in when needed to help teammates or serve our customers. Employees are responsible for maintaining our high standards of safety, quality, and sanitation while identifying opportunities to solve problems, improve processes, and increase efficiency. By embracing our continuous learning, taking ownership of our work, and consistently putting our customers first, we strengthen our team and contribute to the long term success of the Company.

**What about benefits?** 
American Pop Corn Company has an amazing benefits package! Here are just some of our great benefits:

* FREE family health and dental insurance. That's right - JOLLY TIME doesn't charge for these benefits - and it's a major medical plan with full coverage!
* Vision insurance
* 401(k) with a 4% match
* 6 paid holidays
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Referral Bonus
* & More!

EOE post-offer drug screen required. E-verify. APCC is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

existing_roles.title: Quality Assurance Director
existing_roles.description:
Arrowhead Winch engineers and manufactures industrial winch, hoist and drive systems under the BRADEN, CARCO and Gearmatic brand names in Broken Arrow and Okmulgee, Oklahoma. We are seeking a talented **Quality Assurance Director** to join our team in **Broken Arrow, Oklahoma.** Please note: This is a **100% on site** office-based position supporting both the Okmulgee and Broken Arrow, Oklahoma manufacturing plants. Benefits include 401K with matching up to 5%, plus profit sharing plan; medical, dental and vision plans; flexible spending and health savings accounts; paid short- and long-term disability program; paid life insurance; and paid holidays, sick and vacation time. Our work environments are clean, climate controlled and safe. Arrowhead Winch does require applicants to complete a background check, drug test, and pre-employment physical as a condition of employment. Our goal is for all employees to work safely without injury while maintaining the highest safety standards in compliance with company policies.

**Quality Assurance Director** **Position Overview:**

The Quality Assurance Director leads the Quality Department and builds a world-class, prevention-focused quality culture across the Broken Arrow and Okmulgee plants. Partnering with Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, and frontline teams, this leader promotes quality at the source, shared accountability, and measurable customer satisfaction. The role oversees the ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS), customer and supplier quality, corrective action, measurement systems, traceability, warranty analysis, and new-product readiness.

**Quality Assurance Director** **Essential Functions/Responsibilities:**

* Build a quality-at-the-source culture through visible shop-floor leadership, employee engagement, supervisor coaching, recognition, and shared accountability.
* Set quality strategy and annual goals aligned with business priorities, customer requirements, and measurable results.
* Lead and standardize quality procedures, controls, audits, and ISO 9001 management reviews across both plants; ensure actions are completed and effective.
* Partner with Operations to strengthen standard work, in-process checks, visual controls, and mistake-proofing to prevent defects and improve first-pass yield.
* Establish clear expectations for employees to identify, contain, and escalate suspect product; support prompt action on quality concerns.
* Define quality standards and process controls for machining, welding, painting, assembly, and final testing.
* Track and review leading and lagging quality measures, including first-pass yield, customer escapes, scrap, rework, warranty cost, supplier rejects, cost of poor quality, and corrective-action effectiveness; assign owners for improvements.
* Monitor customer scorecards and ensure customer-specific specifications, certifications, inspection records, and corrective-action requirements are met at both plants.
* Communicate quality issues, containment plans, corrective actions, and verified closure promptly and accurately to customers.
* Develop employee quality awareness and problem-solving skills; maintain inspector training, qualification, and competency requirements.
* Lead Quality Department staffing, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and professional development.
* Oversee calibration, measurement system suitability, and gage repeatability and reproducibility (Gage R&R) studies.
* Lead cross-functional root-cause analysis and corrective action using structured methods such as 8D or 5 Whys; verify actions prevent recurrence.
* Use risk-based and layered process audits to confirm compliance with critical controls and sustain improvements.
* Manage nonconforming material, including identification, containment, segregation, documented disposition, controlled deviations, and release authorization.
* Control process changes through risk assessment, approval, validation, documentation, and communication.
* Partner with Purchasing to improve supplier quality through scorecards, reject trends, audits or visits, and targeted corrective actions.
* Lead returned-product, warranty, and field-failure investigations; coordinate containment, customer feedback, and prevention of repeat issues.
* Partner with Design Engineering to improve manufacturability and eliminate design-related quality risks.
* Support new products, engineering changes, and process transfers through risk-based quality planning, PFMEAs, control plans, inspections, and process validation.
* Set end-of-line testing requirements and records; ensure failed tests are investigated and authorized before retest or product release.
* Maintain part, component, production, and test traceability appropriate to product and customer requirements.
* Manage the quality budget and prioritize sustainable improvements that reduce the cost of poor quality without compromising conformance.
* Manage customer specific process approvals, create qualification plans, and maintain required test results and certifications. Establish required internal processes that must be maintained to hold the customer certifications.

**Quality Assurance Director** **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing, or a related field.
* Seven to ten years of quality leadership in ISO 9001 manufacturing, including machining and assembly, multi-site supervision, and team development.
* Proven success building a quality-first culture, coaching frontline teams, and reducing recurring defects through prevention and accountability.
* Ability to interpret part and assembly drawings; working knowledge of metrology and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
* Practical experience with Lean/Six Sigma, structured root-cause analysis, and corrective-action effectiveness verification.
* Experience with statistical process control (SPC), Gage R&R, process capability, PFMEA, and control plans, including methods suited to low-volume, high-mix production.
* Strong analytical, technical, leadership, communication, and conflict-resolution skills; ability to influence cross-functional teams and work effectively with customers.
* Strong documentation and organizational skills; proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

**Quality Assurance Director** **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Lean or Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or Black Belt preferred).
* ISO 9001 Lead Auditor training or certification.
* Experience using short-run SPC, layered process audits, and mistake-proofing in low-volume, high-mix manufacturing.
* Welding inspection knowledge; AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) a plus.
* Knowledge of paint and coatings inspection.
* Knowledge and Experience using AI Tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Copilot

**Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

* Sit, stand, and walk for extended periods, including in a manufacturing shop.
* Use a computer and review technical documents for extended periods.
* Have adequate vision to inspect parts and review documents.
* Hear and speak clearly for effective communication.
* Occasionally lift up to 50 lbs. with assistance and bend, squat, or stoop.
* Work around electrical and heavy equipment; handle and inspect parts.
* Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE) in applicable areas.

existing_roles.title: Director of Trade Compliance & Quality
existing_roles.description:
Description:

The Director of Trade Compliance & Quality leads Zhone’s global trade compliance program and supports the development and implementation of the company’s Quality Management System.

The primary responsibility of this position is Trade Compliance. The successful candidate must have extensive, hands-on experience managing U.S. and international import/export compliance in a global business environment, including export controls, customs, product classification, sanctions and restricted-party screening, licensing, regulatory documentation, and international shipping requirements.

The role provides subject-matter expertise and practical guidance to Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Sales, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to help ensure Zhone products and transactions comply with applicable trade laws and regulatory requirements.

As a secondary but strategically important responsibility, the Director leads Zhone’s Quality Management System initiatives, with the objective of achieving and subsequently maintaining ISO 9001 and TL 9000 certification.

The position requires a practical, hands-on leader capable of developing policies and procedures, resolving complex compliance matters, preparing the organization for audits and certifications, and working effectively with suppliers, contract manufacturers, customers, regulatory authorities, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and certification bodies.

**Key Responsibilities**

Trade Compliance - Primary Responsibility

* Lead and continuously improve Zhone’s global import and export compliance program.
* Interpret and apply applicable U.S. and international trade laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ITAR where applicable, U.S. Customs requirements, sanctions requirements, and FCC-related regulatory considerations.
* Manage classification of products, components, software, and technology using Export Control Classification Numbers (ECCNs) and Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) classifications.
* Determine export authorization and licensing requirements and manage applicable export licenses and import permits.
* Manage denied-party, restricted-party, sanctions, embargo, and country-of-destination compliance.
* Review transactions involving controlled or potentially restricted technologies, customers, countries, suppliers, end users, and end uses.
* Provide guidance on the handling and transfer of export-controlled technical information and technology.
* Establish and maintain trade compliance policies, procedures, work instructions, records, and internal controls.
* Ensure accurate customs, import/export, and international shipping documentation.
* Support proper determination and documentation of country of origin, customs valuation, tariff classification, and applicable trade requirements.
* Support compliance associated with global sourcing, contract manufacturing, product transfers, and changes in manufacturing location.
* Monitor regulatory developments, assess business impact, and implement required process and documentation changes.
* Conduct or coordinate periodic trade compliance audits and risk assessments.
* Develop and deliver role-appropriate trade compliance training.
* Maintain documentation needed for internal audits, external audits, disclosures, and regulatory inquiries.
* Investigate and resolve complex or escalated trade compliance matters.
* Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders, suppliers, customers, regulatory authorities, and external trade counsel, as appropriate.
* Partner with Engineering to obtain the technical information necessary for defensible product classifications and regulatory assessments.
* Provide practical compliance guidance that supports business execution while maintaining appropriate regulatory controls.

Quality Management - Secondary Responsibility

* Lead Zhone’s initiative to achieve and maintain ISO 9001 and TL 9000 certification.
* Develop, implement, and maintain an effective company-wide Quality Management System (QMS).
* Conduct gap assessments against ISO 9001 and TL 9000 requirements and establish a prioritized certification-readiness roadmap.
* Develop and maintain quality policies, procedures, work instructions, records, and document-control requirements.
* Establish and coordinate the internal quality audit program and QMS management reviews.
* Manage or oversee nonconformities, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), root-cause analysis, and verification of corrective-action effectiveness.
* Establish and monitor quality performance indicators and applicable TL 9000 measurements.
* Coordinate quality requirements with Zhone’s ODM, EMS, component, and other manufacturing partners.
* Support supplier qualification, supplier performance monitoring, supplier corrective actions, and quality audits, as appropriate.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer Support on product and process quality matters.
* Lead preparation for certification and surveillance audits and serve as a primary interface with certification bodies.
* Ensure audit findings and nonconformities are appropriately investigated, documented, corrected, and closed.
* Drive continuous improvement using quality data, customer feedback, product returns, manufacturing issues, field performance, and supplier performance.

Requirements:

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, International Trade, Engineering, Quality, or a related discipline preferred.
* An equivalent combination of relevant education and substantial trade compliance experience may be considered.

Trade Compliance

* 8+ years of progressive, hands-on trade compliance experience, preferably within telecommunications, networking equipment, electronics, technology, or another international hardware business.
* Extensive working knowledge of the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR).
* Demonstrated experience performing or managing ECCN classifications.
* Strong experience with HTS classification and U.S. Customs requirements.
* Experience determining export licensing and authorization requirements.
* Demonstrated experience with sanctions, embargo, end-use/end-user, and restricted-party compliance.
* Experience managing international import/export documentation and regulatory records.
* Experience working with freight forwarders, customs brokers, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
* Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to assess regulatory and operational risk and resolve complex trade compliance matters.
* Experience developing or maintaining trade compliance policies, procedures, internal controls, training, and audit programs, and translating regulations into practical business processes and documented decisions.
* Ability to interpret technical product information and collaborate with Engineering on regulatory classifications.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex regulations in clear business terms and influence and collaborate across Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Sales, Finance, Legal, and executive management.
* Ability to work effectively with customers, suppliers, manufacturing partners, auditors, and regulatory authorities.
* High attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate, audit-ready compliance and quality records and supporting documentation.
* Strong Microsoft Excel and data-analysis capabilities; experience with ERP systems and trade-compliance or classification tools is preferred.

Quality

* Practical experience working within an ISO 9001 Quality Management System.
* Familiarity with QMS documentation, internal audits, management reviews, certification readiness, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA), root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Experience supporting or leading an ISO certification or surveillance audit is strongly preferred.
* Previous TL 9000 experience is highly desirable.
* Experience with quality management in telecommunications, electronics manufacturing, ODM/EMS, or another technology-hardware environment is preferred.
* Familiarity with 5 Whys, 8D, Fishbone/Ishikawa analysis, Pareto analysis, and FMEA is desirable.

**Recommended Professional Certifications**

Trade Compliance - Certifications Strongly Preferred

* Certified Export Specialist (CES), NCBFAA Educational Institute.
* Certified Customs Specialist (CCS), NCBFAA Educational Institute.
* U.S. Customs Broker License, highly desirable.
* Additional recognized training or credentials covering EAR/export controls, sanctions, customs, and international trade compliance.

Quality - Certifications Preferred

* ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer training.
* TL 9000 training.
* ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA).
* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE).
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE).

**Quality Director OTP**

*\*Remote with travel to our Northern and North Central CA locations\**

**We offer competitive salary, full benefits package, Paid Time Off, and opportunities for professional growth.**

Pinnacle Treatment Centers is a growing leader in addiction treatment services. We provide care across the nation touching the lives of more than 35,000 patients daily.

Our mission is to remove all barriers to recovery and transform individuals, families, and communities with treatment that works. Our employees believe we are creating a better world where lives and communities are made whole again through comprehensive treatment.

As, **Quality Director OTP**, you will oversee, develop, and maintain a comprehensive and effective quality improvement system for Pinnacle Treatment Services. The Quality Director is responsible for the oversight of PTC (Pinnacle Treatment Center) Quality team functions including QSR completion, accreditation survey scheduling, performance improvement measurement completion, and documentation storage.

**Teammate Appreciation Benefits:** At Pinnacle Treatment Centers, we value our teammates and offer a variety of benefits to support their personal and professional growth.

* **Variable Pay Structure:** Competitive compensation based on experience, education, and licensure.
* **Defined Career Pathing:** Clear advancement opportunities through our Counselor Tier Program, designed to reward achievement in education, licensure, and credentials.
* **Bonus Incentives:** Recognizing and rewarding quality patient care with monthly performance-based bonuses.
* **Continuing Education:** Free access to over 600 CEU courses to enhance your skills and knowledge.
* **Paid Time Off:** 18 days of PTO and 8 paid holidays to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
* **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Initiatives:** Be part of a workforce that reflects the diversity of our patient population.
* **Free Clinical Supervision:** Available based on licensure and availability to support your professional growth.

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred in a behavioral healthcare, business, or public administration.
* 3 years minimum supervisory or administrative experience in a healthcare setting, preferred.
* Preferred MAT experience.
* Knowledge, training and at minimum 3 years of experience in a quality role.
* Demonstrated ability to exhibit a positive personal image/public presence and ability to communicate effectively and comprehensively in oral and written format.
* Technical and organizational skills and efficiency to perform responsibilities consistent with procedure. Possesses strong skills in project management and meeting deadlines and producing deliverables.
* Must possess a current valid driver’s license in good standing in state of employment and be insurable by the designated carrier. This role is required to drive for company purposes.

* Quality Lead in accreditation process, scheduling, and corrective action (when applicable).
* Project management in areas of clinical significance such as AMAs, corrective action, and EMR reports management. medical necessity documentation.
* Maintains training guidelines to support clinical excellence.
* Develops and maintains a Pinnacle Quality audit tool and process inclusive of system of care adherence, current CARF standards, corrective action if required, applicable state or payor requirements, medical necessity criteria documentation. Collaborative relationships with Clinical, Compliance and Operational teams related to quality audits.

* Ensures effectiveness of provider improvement systems and adherence to standards.
* Work with the Talent/HR Department and others as appropriate to develop an effective training program, including appropriate introductory training for new employees on the treatment team and ongoing training for all employees and managers.
* Acts as a resource to providers to solve problems related to quality of services.
* Assist the corporate Chief Legal & Compliance Officer and Sr. Director of Quality with special projects as assigned, Action Plans, periodic monitoring and tracking, recruitment, community relations, and public speaking upon requests from community agencies.

existing_roles.description:
**About us:**

YQN is a leading one-stop international logistics online services platform, offering comprehensive international logistics services, including FCL, LCL, air freight, rail service, trucking, customs clearance, warehousing, cargo insurance, bulk cargo service, port of destination services, etc.

We are designed to apply internet and digital technology to visualize and optimize cross-border supply chain logistics, achieving the same efficiency and convenience as express delivery. 'Simple shipping and easy freight' is the mission of YQN. We have developed strategic cooperative partnerships with leading ocean carriers and logistics service providers such as COSCO Shipping, Maersk Line, Sinotrans, etc.

**Position Summary****:**

The Director of Operational Excellence is responsible for establishing, optimizing, and overseeing the end-to-end quality assurance framework across all warehouse locations nationwide. This role leads the quality strategy, operational audits, cross-site process standardization, and warehouse project implementation to ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence across the entire network.

**Responsibilities**：

* Develop and maintain the nationwide warehouse quality control strategy, policies, and operational standards.
* Define and implement standardized operating procedures (SOPs), KPIs, and audit mechanisms for all warehouse functions, including receiving, putaway, inventory control, picking, packing, shipping, returns, and value-added services.
* Analyze warehouse data to identify trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct routine and random quality audits across all warehouse locations to ensure compliance with internal standards and customer requirements.
* Review and approve quality reports, deviation records, root-cause analyses, and corrective/preventative action plans (CAPA).
* Lead initiatives to improve order accuracy, inventory accuracy, packaging quality, and process compliance.
* Work closely with Warehouse Operations, Supply Chain, HR/Training, Customer Service, and IT teams to ensure consistent implementation of quality standards.
* Facilitate communication between site managers, regional leadership, and executive-level stakeholders regarding quality metrics and priorities.
* Support client-facing teams by aligning warehouse quality processes with evolving customer requirements.
* Lead major warehouse quality improvement projects, multi-site rollouts, and technology/tool implementations, such as WMS enhancements and QC automation tools.
* Ensure new processes, tools, and standards are deployed successfully across all locations and properly documented.
* Deliver regular quality and operational performance reports to executive leadership.
* Ensure adherence to relevant regulations, industry standards, and customer-specific SLAs.
* Support internal and external audits as required.
* Perform other tasks as assigned by senior leadership.

 

**Qualifications**：

* 5–10+ years of quality management experience in warehousing, logistics, or distribution.
* Strong background in multi-site quality leadership.
* Bilingual proficiency in Chinese is highly preferred
* Deep understanding of warehouse processes and quality methodologies (such as RCA, Lean, Six Sigma).
* Excellent communication, leadership, and training capabilities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Ability to travel nationwide as needed.
* Proficiency with the Microsoft Office Suite and warehouse management systems (WMS).

 

Job Type: Full-time, Onsite

Location: Fontana, CA

Compensation: Starts at $150,000 per year, plus bonus

Benefits: Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance, PTO, 401(k) Match

**Req #** 212479 **Location** Deerfield, Illinois, United States **Job Category** Quality **Date posted** 10/30/2026

 

**Overview**
------------

This is where you make a difference in our patients’ safety. As a member of the Baxter Quality team, you will play an essential part in our mission of saving and sustaining lives. Quality is important throughout the entire product lifecycle and works collaboratively with all areas of the organization. Because Quality touches everything Baxter does, a role in Quality provides many opportunities for growth, learning and a successful career that has a daily impact on people’s lives.

* Support for Parents
* Continuing Education/ Professional Development
* Employee Health & Well-Being Benefits
* Paid Time Off
* 2 Days a Year to Volunteer

**Success Profile**
-------------------

What makes a successful Quality team member at Baxter? Take a look at some of the top traits we’re looking for and see if you’re a fit.

* Detail Oriented
* Continuous Learner
* Courageous
* Collaborative
* Critical Thinker
* Influential

 

**This is where** your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

At Baxter, the quality of our products and the strength of our regulatory practices directly support the patients and clinicians who rely on us. As Vice President, Global Quality & Regulatory Excellence, you will shape how Baxter anticipates risk, strengthens operational performance, and uses data, technology and innovation to advance quality worldwide. Based in Deerfield, Illinois, you will influence enterprise strategy and help build the capabilities that will define Baxter’s future.

 
 

**Your Role at Baxter**
-----------------------

You will lead the strategy connecting quality excellence, operational quality, regulatory resilience, enterprise risk, data and analytics, and responsible artificial intelligence. Working closely with the senior Quality leadership team and leaders across Baxter, you will translate emerging regulatory, technology and business trends into decisions that protect patients, strengthen product availability and quality, and support sustainable growth.

 
 

Your impact will extend across Baxter’s businesses, manufacturing network and global quality systems. You will guide enterprise priorities, investments and transformation initiatives while building scalable capabilities that improve performance and strengthen regulatory confidence.

 
 

Success will be reflected in early identification of risk, stronger operational and process performance, disciplined investment decisions, effective governance, responsible innovation, and quality capabilities built to deliver lasting business and patient impact.

 
 

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

* Shape Baxter’s multi-year strategy for quality excellence, operational quality, regulatory resilience, enterprise risk, data, analytics and responsible AI, aligning priorities with patient needs and business strategy.
* Strengthen operational quality across manufacturing sites, product platforms, supply networks and quality systems by identifying systemic opportunities and driving improvements in reliability, compliance and product availability.
* Lead enterprise quality transformation and targeted interventions, focusing expertise and investment where they can create the greatest patient, regulatory and business value and scaling successful approaches across Baxter.
* Advance Baxter’s digital quality and analytics strategy by prioritizing scalable technology, automation and AI capabilities that improve insight, decision-making and organizational performance while maintaining appropriate governance and human oversight.
* Anticipate changes in U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and global health authority expectations, translating external developments into proactive regulatory strategies, preparedness priorities and enterprise decisions.
* Guide enterprise risk, operating-plan and capital-investment decisions by connecting quality and regulatory priorities with patient and product risk, resilience, financial stewardship and long-term value.
* Build a strong global leadership and talent pipeline, developing the capabilities Baxter will need across operational quality, strategic risk, data, technology and transformation while creating alignment across businesses, functions and geographies.
 

 

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Microbiology, Chemistry, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Data Science, Business, or a related discipline.
* At least 18 years of progressive leadership experience, including significant executive responsibility in Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Compliance, Manufacturing, Operations, Enterprise Risk, Digital Transformation, or a related discipline within medical device, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry.
* Demonstrated success at the Vice President or comparable enterprise level, setting strategy and leading transformation across a complex global organization with measurable patient, regulatory, operational, financial and organizational impact.
* Deep operational quality experience spanning manufacturing, supply chain, product lifecycle, quality systems, inspection readiness, remediation and continuous improvement, together with experience engaging the FDA and other global health authorities.
* Experience leading significant operating budgets and influencing capital investment, resource allocation, business cases and investment priorities.
* Ability to advise senior executives and communicate complex quality, regulatory, operational and risk considerations clearly to executive and Board-level audiences.
* Demonstrated success leading across organizational boundaries, building strong leadership capability and using data, analytics and external insights to improve strategic decision-making.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree such as an MBA, MS, PhD or PharmD.
* Executive education or recognized certification in enterprise risk management, data analytics, artificial intelligence, digital transformation or quality leadership.
* Experience as an enterprise Quality or Regulatory executive, Site Quality Head, senior Operations leader, or comparable global technical leader with broad business and financial accountability.
* Experience sponsoring or governing AI, machine learning, automation or digital quality initiatives, including consideration of model risk, privacy, cybersecurity, data integrity and regulatory requirements.
 

 

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The estimated base salary for this position is $288,000 - $396,000 annually. The estimated range is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position. We may pay more or less than of the anticipated range based upon market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change. Individual pay is based on upon location, skills and expertise, experience, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, commission, and/or long-term incentive. For questions about this, our pay philosophy, and available benefits, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview.

 
 

At Baxter, you'll join a team united by a shared purpose: improving outcomes for patients and healthcare providers around the world. We believe innovation happens through collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a relentless commitment to excellence. Here, your leadership will help shape the future of healthcare while creating opportunities for growth, impact, and professional fulfillment.

 
 

*Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.*

This is where your well-being matters. Baxter offers comprehensive compensation and benefits packages for eligible roles. Our health and well-being benefits include medical and dental coverage that start on day one, as well as insurance coverage for basic life, accident, short-term and long-term disability, and business travel accident insurance. Financial and retirement benefits include the Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), with the ability to purchase company stock at a discount, and the 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan (RSP), with options for employee contributions and company matching. existing_roles.description:
**Process Insights, Inc.** (PI) is a global company, focused on differentiated analytical solutions and technologies used in critical-mission applications in chemical, industrial, semiconductor, environmental, clean energy, life sciences, agriculture, food & beverage and other continuous process industries. Our products provide differentiated solutions across a diverse range of applications ensuring safe operation, quality output, efficiency and productivity improvements, and reduced disruptions and downtime; all while managing increasing regulatory complexity and cost in industrial processes. Our global portfolio of trusted technologies is known for consistency, reliability, repeatability, and performance that adds exponential value to our end-user’s applications and processes. Our exceptional aftermarket services and support are a crucial component to our continued success and ultimate customer intimacy.

We currently have an opening for a Plant Manager for our Industrial Measurement Solutions (IMS) division. This position is based in Houston, TX (NW near Tomball) and reports into the Global VP of Operations, with full leadership responsibility for site manufacturing operations. The Plant Manager drives safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance, leading teams to produce dependable, high-quality analytical solutions for our customers. This is an operations leadership position that will collaborate closely with the Engineering, Supply Chain, and Quality departments.

**Are You a Good Fit:** 
Successful candidates will be a hands-on, accountable, and people-focused leader who is highly organized and analytical. We are looking for candidates who like to solve complex operational problems, build strong teams, and drive continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment. If you are disciplined, results-driven, and passionate about operational excellence, this position could be a great fit!

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Direct and oversee all manufacturing operations at the site, including assembly, test, calibration, and production planning functions
* Develop and execute site operational strategy to meet safety, quality, delivery, and cost targets
* Lead and develop site operations leadership and staff, including hiring, coaching, and performance management
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, Six Sigma, 5S) across all operational areas to improve efficiency and reduce waste
* Oversee production planning and scheduling to ensure on-time delivery and effective capacity utilization
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality (ISO 9001/17025 as applicable), and regulatory requirements across site operations
* Partner with engineering, quality, supply chain, and HR to resolve operational issues and support site-wide initiatives
* Manage the site operations budget, including labor, capital, and operating expenses
* Analyze operational performance metrics (throughput, quality, on-time delivery, cost) and drive corrective action as needed
* Lead site readiness for customer and regulatory audits
* Oversee facilities, equipment maintenance, and capital equipment planning for the site
* Support new product introduction and site-level process validation
* Communicate site performance, risks, and initiatives to executive leadership
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Qualifying Attributes and Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or related field
* 8+ years of manufacturing operations experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role overseeing multiple functions (assembly, test, calibration, planning)
* Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes, production planning, and quality systems
* Demonstrated leadership experience managing multi-disciplinary operations teams
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with experience managing budgets and operational metrics
* Experience with Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to executive leadership
* MBA or advanced degree in operations/business
* Experience in process analyzer, instrumentation, or precision manufacturing environments
* Experience with ISO 9001/17025 quality systems
* Familiarity with ERP systems (Epicor)

**Process Insights is an equal opportunity employer with a generous compensation plan:**

 

* Excellent earning potential with qualifying annual bonuses
* Health, Dental and Vision Benefits Plan
* Elective Flexible Spending and Dependent Care Accounts
* Elective Critical Care, Hospital Confinement, and Accident Coverage Plans
* Life Insurance (1X), Short and Long-Term Disability
* 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
* Paid Holidays and Vacation

existing_roles.description:
**ADMA Biologics** is a biopharmaceutical company relentlessly committed to creating superior products for immunodeficient patients at risk for infection. It is our devotion to this underserved population that fuels us and our hands-on approach to production and development that sets us apart. If you are looking for a dynamic, innovative, growing company in the biopharmaceutical industry that is committed to excellence and integrity, then consider ADMA Biologics. We currently have an exciting opportunity available for a **Senior Director, Quality Assurance in Boca Raton, FL!**

Job Title: Senior Director, Quality Assurance

Job Description:

**Position Summary:**
---------------------

The Senior Director, Quality Assurance, is responsible for leading and executing the QA strategy for strong oversight of the end-to-end production for ADMA Biologics’ specialty plasma-derived products. This leader will ensure that materials, processes, facilities, and products meet applicable regulatory requirements and ADMA’s strict quality standards. The role requires sound GMP judgment, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to resolve complex quality issues while supporting reliable product supply.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**
---------------------------------------------

* Lead and develop the QA teams responsible for manufacturing oversight, batch record review, product disposition, and quality systems execution.
* Provide operational leadership and expertise in the development, implementation, and training of cGMP compliant quality systems, such as document control, change control, investigations, deviations, CAPA, and product quality complaints.
* Provide independent quality oversight of plasma manufacturing operations, aseptic filling, packaging, and associated laboratory and support activities, as applicable.
* Responsible for ensuring organizational goals are transmitted and communicated effectively throughout the QA department to include all members of the team.
* As a member of senior management, works collaboratively and cross-functionally with other key leaders to ensure execution of department(s) and organizational goals. Assigns resources according to priority and project needs.
* Establish performance measures and use quality trends to identify emerging risks, set priorities, and drive continuous improvement.
* Direct the development of systems, practices, and processes to ensure effective ongoing review of manufacturing, facility, and process-related changes.
