existing_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering
existing_roles.description:
Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler (MC) is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber's first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date.

Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara.

### **About The Role:**

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Platform Manufacturing Engineering to lead Production Manufacturing Engineering as we scale the Matter Compiler from pilot production into high-volume manufacturing. You will own the equipment that builds our devices — its build, integration, bring-up, qualification and reliability — and the team of engineers who deliver it.

**You are an engineer first.** This is a player-coach role and the player half is not decorative: you will spearhead the hardest projects on the critical path personally, in CAD and on the floor, and use that work as the vehicle for coaching everyone around you. The fastest way to set a standard here is to define it while you produce work that meets it, then mentor your team to achieve the same bar.

Mentoring here happens inside the work, not alongside it. You will pull engineers onto the projects you lead, hand off scope as they are ready for it, review their designs with real technical depth, and grow the next set of project leads out of people who learned by building with you.

The management half is real. You will hire against a plan rather than a wish list, develop engineers toward the next level, run performance honestly, and install the operating standards this function works to — documentation, change control, qualification and release discipline, and what "done" means before work leaves the group. You will plan the organization ahead of where the business is today, own headcount and capital budget, and get manufacturability and equipment requirements into specifications set by other teams rather than reviewing them at the end.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Spearhead the hardest equipment projects on the critical path yourself — architecture, CAD, build, bring-up and qualification — and bring engineers along on them as the primary way they develop.
* Lead a team of 5–10 engineers spanning equipment design, automation and controls, integration, and sustaining, through a mix of direct reports and technical leads.
* Set the engineering standard by producing work to it: reference designs, qualification plans, RCCAs and documentation your team can pattern from, with the reasoning made explicit so it transfers.
* Coach through the work — pair on designs, run technical reviews with real depth, hand off scope as engineers are ready for it, and grow the next set of project leads out of people who built alongside you.
* Own the delivery record for the function — the equipment, qualifications and production readiness your team commits to, against committed dates.
* Lead equipment deployment end to end: installation, validation, commissioning, acceptance testing, SOP/WI release and operator qualification.
* Run root cause and corrective action personally on the failures that matter, teach the method by doing it in front of the team, and drive the corrective actions across teams that do not report to you.
* Install and uphold the operating standards: documentation, change control, qualification and release discipline, RCCA method and closure, and how work is reviewed before it leaves the group.
* Plan organizational growth — forecast hiring needs ahead of demand, define roles and levels, build and defend the hiring plan, and manage headcount and capital budget with Supply Chain and Finance.
* Own and resolve escalated personnel situations arising from business and priority changes, rather than routing them away.
* Get manufacturability and equipment requirements into specification setting and design milestones with Design Engineering and Product, rather than reviewing at the end.
* Balance competing priorities with peer leaders so committed deliverables are still met, and own communication of impact and resolution path where they cannot be.
* Own contract manufacturer and automation supplier execution through final integration and test to conformant hardware on schedule.
* Drive throughput, yield, cost and uptime improvement — held with control limits, not delivered as one-time gains — and establish the operating metrics and reporting cadence leadership can rely on without chasing.
* Travel between Emeryville and Santa Clara sites as needed.

### **What You'll Need:**

* 7+ years of manufacturing or equipment engineering experience, including 3+ years managing engineers with 5 or more direct reports.
* **Current hands-on capability.** You still design in CAD, still debug hardware on the floor, and could take the hardest open task on your team's board tomorrow. We will test this directly in the loop.
* Proven ownership of automated production equipment end to end — architecture through mechanical, controls and software integration, into a qualified, released system running in production.
* Proficiency in CAD for equipment design (SolidWorks, Onshape, AutoCAD or similar), with recent personal use.
* A track record of **developing engineers through the work** — specific people who grew because you put them on projects you were leading, reviewed their designs, and handed off scope as they were ready for it.
* A track record of building out a functional group: defining roles, hiring against a plan, and installing the operating standards — not only inheriting an existing team.
* Experience leading a team spanning more than one discipline (e.g., equipment, controls/automation, integration, sustaining), including people whose work sits outside your own background.
* Ownership of headcount and capital budget, with resourcing tradeoff decisions made under real constraint.
* Depth across DFx, RCCA, eBOMmBOM conversion, qualification and acceptance testing, and PLM/document control and release (Arena a plus).
* Experience in semiconductor, solar, hardware-based biotech, EV, or similar high-tech industries.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functionally without authority — specifically, getting manufacturing and equipment requirements into specifications owned by other teams.
* A first-principles mindset — you question assumptions, reframe problems from the ground up, and approach challenges with a foundational understanding rather than relying solely on precedent.
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

### **Bonus Points For:**

* Experience standing up or rebuilding a manufacturing or equipment engineering function at a company moving from pilot to production scale.
* Experience staying technically current while managing — a design, patent, or build you personally delivered while running a team.
* Knowledge of basic coding: RSLogix, Ignition, Python, or C/C++.

Atomic Machines is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and does not discriminate based on characteristics protected by applicable law. We are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including for individuals with disabilities. To request an accommodation, contact rc@atomicmachines.com. To help our recruiting team manage application volume and respond to candidates more efficiently, Atomic Machines may use AI-assisted tools.

existing_roles.title: Senior Manager, Factory Engineering
existing_roles.description:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.

At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

**POSITION OVERVIEW:** 
The Senior Manager, Factory Engineering position is responsible for managing the engineering activities relating to the factory and provide professional engineering and strategic technical leadership in the Factory, ensuring people health and safety, product safety and environment are never compromised. Strategic leader for engineering function, leveraging Nestle’s leadership principles in the following areas; capital execution, asset maintenance and utilities excellence, engineering compliance, and sustainability.

Important Note: This position offers relocation assistance.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Define, propose and monitor the implementation of the Factory Engineering teams plans and objectives in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles and the Key Engineering Activities as outlined in the Nestlé Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document.
* Live Nestle leadership principles in all aspects of the role.
* Set the technical strategic vision for the factory, leveraging other functional leaders and cascade objectives to all leaders in engineering department, within factory cost targets.
* Develop and maintain technical competencies at the factory, including detailed action plans, accountability to progress, talent review, career and succession planning.
* Drive equipment reliability through implementing maintenance foundations in TPM.
* Build cooperation and collaboration with the production and other cross functional teams to build world class operation.
* Improve maintenance cost structure by improving technical skill sets and optimizing 3rd party spend.
* Implement Nestle capital process to drive excellence in capital execution.
* Proactively develop, maintain and execute the capital market business strategy (MBS) to align with the business needs.
* Drive factory master planning to facilitate long term strategies across the factory for example in Safety, Quality and Warehouse.
* Ensure full compliance with all governing bodies for utilities system relevant to the Modesto site. This is paramount and non-negotiable to have strong understanding in these utilities system.
* Maintain reliability through implementing maintenance foundations and TPM methodology.
* Develop and maintain all skillset necessary for internal management of utilities systems.
* Drive and execute plant sustainability objectives in line with market targets.
* Drive world class water management in the factory.
* Drive reliability in all electrical components in the factory.
* Develop and drive automation plan for the factory.
* Ensure full compliance with Nestle standards including calibration.
* Develop technical skills in maintenance to ensure electrical reliability.
* Drive Innovation/Renovation, initiating/coordinating implementation of new processes/technology with relevant Market, Product Technology Center, Corporate and Strategic Business Unit.
* Cascaded objectives to all leaders that are in-line with factory objectives.
* Implement strategic technical OMP and factory master plan.
* Detailed cost management plan for all aspects of engineering including YoY improvements.
* Detailed action plan for all aspects of technical execution.
* Leverage Maintenance Foundations/TPM.
* Leverage corporate resources and Nestle Market standards.

**EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:**

* University Degree (BA/BS) in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Chemical, Process or equivalent experience is required.
* At least 10 years related work experience is strongly preferred with at least 3 years of leadership/management experience.
* Knowledge of food safety, regulatory requirements for food safety and hygienic engineering (OSH&R) preferred.
* Strong understanding of, or ability to learn, the full scope of role responsibilities, including financial analysis and key business drivers such as Nestlé Standard Costing, Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM), CAPEX budgeting and preparation (CIAT), and Industrial Services/Energy Management (NEMT).
* Familiarity with TPM and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency with AutoCAD, Visio, CDM, AMM, ESAT, CIAT, NEMT and similar technical tools/systems.
* Demonstrated technical and managerial capabilities with in depth knowledge of food processing plant operations, technologies, utilities, maintenance systems, and hygienic engineering requirements (OSH&R).
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to apply root cause analysis and technical creativity to resolve complex short and long term issues.
* Effective communication and networking skills, with the ability to perform under pressure and in ambiguous environments.
* Experience in Project Engineering/Management, including plant design and construction.

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

existing_roles.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

The Senior Manufacturing Engineering Manager is responsible for overseeing and leading a team of engineers to deliver technical projects efficiently and effectively. This role involves managing resources, budgets, and project timelines, ensuring high-quality engineering solutions, and providing technical guidance. The Senior Manufacturing Engineering Manager is responsible for team development, stakeholder communication and implementing best practices to achieve project goals and drive innovation. 
#LI-BB2

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

Serving in a leadership role, directly supervising project engineers and designers.

Overseeing, managing, and supporting calibration programs for the facilities, including production equipment, facility equipment.

Developing concepts for new and revised products maximizing function, safety, features, and user benefits while minimizing costs.

Directing preparation of models and lab testing as required to develop product.

Preparing and maintaining Project Control Charts and schedules.

Participating in meetings as required to communicate and coordinate projects with various departments within Hubbell.

Developing the site maintenance budget for approval and managing site budget costs to meet the approved budget targets.

Directing preparation of product drawings and checking completed drawings.

Preparing product standards and specifications and obtaining agency listings as required (UL/CSA etc.).

Approving tooling, assemblies, and updating drawings. Release approved product for production.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (required)

10+ years of relevant experience (required)

5+ supervisory experience in an engineering related field (required)

Ability to check design drawings with extreme thoroughness while paying strict attention to detail

Ability to manage multiple design projects with varying priority levels

Proven track record working with systems engineering functions including concept of operations development, requirements management, technical risk management, interface definition and control

Experience effectively communicating and presenting with all levels of management and individual contributors on the program team

Strong organization, coordination, planning and collaboration skills

Experience supporting engineering teams in a multi-discipline environment

Experience conducting system integration and system tests to include development of integration and test plans, test cases and procedures

Ability to visualize system functionality, to create block diagrams, and to analyze system performance

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

**Hubbell Utility Solutions**

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.

It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

existing_roles.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

As Senior Vice President, Quality Engineering Manager for Payments Technology, you will own the test strategy for CitiDirect, Citi's award winning digital banking platform that gives clients one-click access to global transaction capabilities across payments, liquidity and trade. You will direct multiple testing teams, set the standards for test automation and User Acceptance Testing, and make sure every release of CitiDirect and its connected systems meets a high quality bar before reaching production. This is an opportunity to shape how a global bank validates mission critical payments technology and to build a modern, automated testing organization.

 
 

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the test strategy for CitiDirect and its upstream and downstream applications across the Payments, Liquidity and Trade domains.

* Direct multiple testing teams, setting priorities and resolving complex issues that carry significant business impact.

* Design and implement User Acceptance Testing scripts and plans together with technology project managers, UAT professionals and business users.

* Build testing standards and quality benchmarks that keep automation, documentation and release processes consistent across teams.

* Plan and coordinate cross-team testing dependencies to keep releases on schedule and reduce production risk.

* Partner with development teams, IT project managers, business stakeholders and external vendors to align testing approach with delivery goals.

* Manage team performance and development, including hiring, coaching, compensation decisions and career planning for testing professionals.

* Assess risk in every release decision and escalate control issues early to protect Citi and its clients.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 10+ years of experience in a testing environment, including senior level people management experience.

* Deep understanding of Systems Development Life Cycle processes and end to end testing methodologies.

* Hands-on experience with test management tools such as Quality Center and related testing platforms.

* Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to negotiate and influence at a senior level.

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work through complex and unfamiliar testing situations.

* A track record of leading teams to deliver high quality results under tight deadlines.

* A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in a related field.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman, Rest Assured or SoapUI.

* Programming skills in Java, Python or JavaScript, combined with background in payments technology, cloud platforms and Agile or Scrum delivery, and a track record of moving manual QA functions to automated testing.:

* Playwright & TypeScript/JavaScript Mastery (Required): Extensive hands-on experience designing and implementing scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks from scratch using Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript.

* CI/CD Pipeline Integration & Quality Gating (Required): In-depth experience establishing continuous testing workflows within CI/CD pipelines, including setting up automated regression triggering and pipeline hard gating.

* Containerization & Scaled Infrastructure (Strongly Preferred): Strong background in leveraging Docker and Kubernetes to containerize test suites and horizontally scale distributed test execution across enterprise environments.

* GenAI & Agentic Testing Workflows (Strongly Preferred): Experience using AI Harnesses (e.g., GitHub Copilot or Claude) and creating custom AI agents or automated agentic workflows to optimize the software testing lifecycle.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred

**What We Offer**

Based at Citi's Jersey City location, you will lead a testing function that supports a payments platform used by clients around the world, with the backing and resources of a global technology organization.

* Work in a hybrid arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely each week.

* Shape testing strategy and standards for a platform operating across global markets, with real influence on outcomes.

* Access ongoing learning and leadership development programs to continue growing your career in technology.

* Collaborate with testing, development and business teams across multiple geographies and time zones.

* Benefit from financial wellbeing programs, healthcare coverage and family support resources.

Apply now to lead the quality engineering strategy behind one of Citi's most critical payments platforms.

existing_roles.description:
**Company Description**

With over $2B in revenue, 80+ manufacturing facilities across 6 continents and over 9,000 employees worldwide, Signode is a leading manufacturer of a broad spectrum of transit packaging consumables, tools, software, and equipment that optimize end-of-line packaging operations and protect products in transit. Signode brings this extensive product portfolio together under hundreds of trusted brands to offer complete transit packaging solutions to its customers. 
 
We produce strap, stretch and protective packaging. We also manufacture packaging tools and equipment used to apply the bulk packaging materials. These commercial packaging products are used to pack, bundle, unitize, protect, and secure goods during warehousing and transit. Our company is a pioneer in the industrial packaging sector with a long history of customer-focused innovations in materials, processes and automation technology that have revolutionized the sector. 
 
Headquartered in Tampa, Florida, we are proud to be the Transit Packaging Division of Crown Holdings, Inc. We are excited to go to market as Signode and to share the portfolio of products, services and capabilities that make us the world’s premier end-of-line packaging company.

 **Job Description**

**Benefits:**

Signode offers a comprehensive benefits package to full-time employees, which includes health, dental, vision, 401k, paid time off, life insurance, wellness perks, and more. Benefits begin the month following the hire date.

**Salary:**

The annual salary for this position ranges from $163,500 - $200,000 plus 20% bonus and varies based on specific responsibilities and geographic location. Starting annual salary within this range will be determined based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and/or skillset.

**Summary**

This role is for a Plant Manager who is a true leader, one who can build a strong, positive culture throughout the plant. The position calls for a sharp operational and analytical mind that constantly seeks out, teaches, and leads improvements in Safety Performance, Cost Control, Standardized Processes (LEAN), Production Reporting, and Inventory Control.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to lead one of Signode’s most important locations, having a big impact on our ability to deliver a profitable year. Here is what makes this role stand out:

* Pilot the company’s Operational Excellence system, delivering a glidepath in Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Output, and Morale.
* Take charge of a major turnaround facility. The right leader is confident yet humble, ready to run a 24/7 site from the bottom up, and understands the sweat and equity required to turn it around.
* Succeed here, and fast-track your path to the next level.

**Essential Functions**

* Directly manage and coordinate the activities of various plant departments and sites within Signode.
* Provide strong leadership to the manufacturing team, fostering a collaborative and results-oriented work environment.
* Develop and implement strategic plans to achieve production goals, optimize processes, and enhance overall plant efficiency.
* Communicate, uphold and enforce safety protocols and regulatory compliance to maintain a safe and secure working environment.
* Responsible for talent management and employee lifecycle activities, from hiring to terminating.
* Collaborate with senior management to align plant operations with organizational objectives.
* Monitor and analyze production metrics, ensuring that production targets are met while maintaining high-quality standards.
* Implement efficiency improvement initiatives and address any bottlenecks or issues in the production process.
* Efficiently allocate resources, including manpower and equipment, to meet production schedules and deadlines.
* Collaborate with the maintenance team to ensure optimal functionality of machinery and equipment.
* Collaborate with the quality control department to ensure that products meet or exceed quality standards.
* Implement measures to address any deviations or non-conformities in the production process.
* Develop and manage budgets for the manufacturing facility(s), controlling costs and optimizing resource utilization.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement measures to improve overall plant profitability.
* Effectively communicate with senior management, department heads, and front-line staff to ensure clear understanding of goals and objectives.
* Prepare regular reports on plant performance, production metrics, and other relevant KPIs.
* Lead and support initiatives for continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to enhance plant processes, reduce waste, and increase overall efficiency.

 
**Qualifications**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Management, Business, or Engineering. Masters Degree in similar field preferred.

**Experience:** Minimum of 15+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, with at least 5 -7 years in a managerial or supervisory role. **Previous experience as a plant manager is a must.**

* Financial Acumen with the ability to analyze and forecast data and translate results to better solutions. With the understanding of general ledger accounting and activity rate costing.
* Strong knowledge of safety metrics and programs.
* TPM mastery
* **Previous experience leading a turnaround factory**
* Extrusion technical skills
* ERP system knowledge a plus.
* LEAN Manufacturing Training or CI Management Experience (Tier I, II, III)

**Functional Success Drivers:** These competencies are what we require for an individual to be successful in this role.

* Strategic Skills
* Leadership
* Result Oriented
* Safety & Security
* Communication (Oral & Written)
* Analytical Skills
* Inspiring “Followership”
* Vision

 
**Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

The Company does not sponsor for employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

**Reasonable Accommodation Statement**

To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities.

Signode is committed to providing equal opportunities to all qualified applicants, including providing reasonable accommodations during our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodation in applying for this position, please contact us at HRRecruiting@Signode.com.

It is intended to provide guidelines for job expectations and the employee's ability to perform the position described. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate. This document does not represent a contract of employment, and the Company reserves the right to change this job description and/or assign tasks for the employee to perform, as the Company may deem appropriate.*

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for a proven manufacturing executive with deep **paper manufacturing and paper machine operations experience**. Our client is seeking a hands-on, results-driven leader who can take full ownership of plant performance, strengthen operational discipline, and lead the facility to improved results across **safety, quality, production, reliability, cost and people development**.

The successful candidate will be responsible for all aspects of plant operations and will play a key role in driving performance improvements, stabilizing underperforming areas, and building a strong culture of accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This role is ideal for a seasoned Plant Manager or senior operations leader who understands the complexity of paper manufacturing and has a track record of improving plant performance through strong leadership, technical knowledge, disciplined execution and data-driven decision-making.

The Plant Manager will oversee the day-to-day and strategic leadership of the facility, ensuring the plant operates safely, efficiently and profitably while developing both leadership and frontline teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead all plant operations to achieve established **safety, quality, production, reliability and financial objectives**.
* Build and reinforce a strong **safety culture** through visible leadership, clear expectations, coaching and accountability at all levels of the organization.
* Oversee plant performance and ensure operations are aligned with productivity, quality and cost targets.
* Optimize **paper machine performance**, equipment uptime, production output and finished-product quality.
* Improve equipment reliability through strong maintenance systems, including preventive and predictive maintenance, planning and scheduling, and root cause analysis.
* Manage and improve plant financial performance, including cost-per-ton, labour, maintenance, fibre, chemical and energy costs.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts using structured, data-driven problem-solving methodologies to improve operational and financial results.
* Develop and execute recovery or turnaround plans for underperforming operations, establishing clear priorities, ownership, milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Build, coach and strengthen plant leadership, technical and hourly teams through employee development, performance management, succession planning and accountability.
* Partner with maintenance, production, quality and leadership teams to ensure cross-functional alignment and effective execution of plant priorities.
* Establish a culture focused on **performance, engagement, ownership and continuous improvement**.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a strong plant leader with deep technical and operational knowledge of **paper manufacturing**, particularly **paper machine operations**, who can lead a large team and drive measurable business results.

existing_roles.title: Director, Commercial Operations and Asset Management
existing_roles.description:
**SUMMARY:** The Director, Commercial Operations & Asset Management provides leadership over the operational execution and ongoing asset management of Rhyze’s Commercial lending platform. This role is accountable for establishing scalable, controlled processes across transaction closing, funding, participation, servicing and portfolio administration, while actively overseeing the performance, credit quality and risk profile of the commercial real estate loan portfolio.

The Director leads portfolio surveillance, borrower and property performance monitoring, covenant compliance, annual review coordination, delinquency management and the operational execution of workout and loss mitigation strategies. The position works closely with the Managing Director, Commercial; Capital Markets; and Legal, and coordinates with lead lenders, borrowers, servicing partners and participating credit unions as appropriate.

The successful candidate combines commercial real estate credit and asset management expertise with operational discipline, sound judgment, strong communication skills and a focus on scalable execution.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Commercial Portfolio & Asset Management**

· Lead portfolio surveillance and risk-based monitoring of commercial real estate loans, including payment performance, DSCR, net operating income, occupancy, rent rolls, leasing, borrower liquidity, maturities and concentration exposure.

· Oversee borrower and property financial reporting, covenant testing and compliance calendars; identify reporting deficiencies, covenant breaches, emerging risks and required follow-up.

· Coordinate annual and interim credit reviews, risk-rating assessments, watchlist management and action plans, with documented findings, ownership, deadlines and management escalation.

· Oversee collateral protection requirements, including insurance, property taxes, escrows, reserves, liens, property inspections, appraisals and other third-party assessments, in coordination with Servicing and Legal.

**Special Assets & Loss Mitigation**

· Identify and escalate delinquencies, maturity or covenant defaults and deteriorating credits; coordinate borrower outreach, collection strategies and remediation plans for criticized or classified assets.

· Evaluate requests for waivers, modifications, extensions, forbearances and other accommodations; develop supporting analysis and recommendations for authorized decision-makers.

· Coordinate workout and loss mitigation activities with Commercial leadership, Legal and external counsel, including enforcement, bankruptcy or foreclosure matters when applicable.

· Prepare required participant notices and approval packages; document borrower communications, decisions, conditions and deadlines, and monitor execution and performance under approved resolution plans.

**Commercial Operations & Servicing Oversight**

· Lead day-to-day Commercial operations with clear accountability, service standards, quality controls and escalation procedures across the loan lifecycle.

· Oversee transaction closing, funding, loan boarding and post-closing administration, including conditions, documentation, milestone tracking, data transfers and outstanding exceptions.

· Coordinate with internal teams, servicing partners and Capital Markets on participation administration, payment processing, reconciliations, escrows, reserves, borrower notices, payoffs, releases and related servicing matters.

· Ensure accurate implementation and recording of approved modifications, extensions and other post-closing actions, consistent with loan documents, participation agreements, delegated authority and applicable requirements.

**Operational Excellence, Reporting & Scalability**

· Provide timely loan-level and portfolio reporting to management and participating investors, including delinquencies, covenant exceptions, watchlist activity, material credit events and remediation progress.

· Serve as a central coordinator across Commercial, Capital Markets, Finance, Legal, servicing partners, lead lenders and participating credit unions on operational and portfolio matters.

· Develop and standardize procedures, controls, checklists, templates and reporting; identify opportunities for automation, integration and improved data quality to support scalable growth.

· Establish and monitor key performance indicators, including reporting compliance, review completion, exception aging, delinquency trends, watchlist resolution and transaction cycle times.

**Other**· Responsible for effective self/workload management. Demonstrates clear written and verbal communication skills. Promotes collaboration and a positive, professional work environment. Attends all position related meetings to ensure proper communication/planning occurs.

· Performs other related duties as assigned by the Managing Director

· Complies with all company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

· Care for non-public information (NPI) and ensuring that confidentiality of company, borrowers, and partner information is maintained.

· Responsible for contributing to a positive work environment and culture that represents the company values.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

· Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience considered.

· Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in commercial real estate lending, commercial credit administration, loan servicing, asset management, or a related field, with demonstrated experience managing commercial loan portfolios.

· Strong understanding of the end-to-end commercial lending lifecycle, including loan documentation, closing, funding, servicing, portfolio administration, and loan participations.

· Demonstrated expertise in commercial real estate asset management, including financial statement analysis, property performance monitoring, debt service coverage, covenant compliance, collateral valuation, and credit risk assessment.

· Experience identifying and managing problem loans, including delinquencies, covenant defaults, borrower accommodations, forbearances, modifications, workouts, and loss mitigation strategies.

· Strong knowledge of commercial loan servicing practices, including payment administration, escrow and reserve management, collateral protection, and post-closing compliance.

· Demonstrated ability to evaluate portfolio performance, identify emerging credit risks, develop actionable recommendations, and effectively communicate findings to management and other stakeholders.

· Experience establishing and improving operational processes, internal controls, reporting practices, and technology-enabled workflows to support efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

· Strong understanding of commercial lending regulatory requirements, credit policies, risk management practices, and financial institution governance.

· Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate cross-functional activities, and lead complex initiatives with a high degree of accountability and attention to detail.

· Excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage borrowers, lending partners, credit union executives, and internal stakeholders.

· Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently in an entrepreneurial, growth-oriented environment.

Pay: $165,000.00 - $185,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

existing_roles.title: Director of Manufacturing Engineering, Imaging
existing_roles.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE JOB** 
 
As the Director of Manufacturing Engineering, your role encompasses the strategic oversight and tactical management of manufacturing engineering and systems to support both the development of new products and the scaling of high-volume production in Waltham, MA. You are charged with ensuring rigorous manufacturing processes are in place, resulting in the consistent delivery of superior quality products to our customers. Your leadership will also guarantee the fulfillment of manufacturing's capacity commitments while driving advancements in digital tools and methodologies to improve design, analysis, and execution. This role demands an innovative and adaptable approach to solving complex manufacturing challenges in a highly dynamic environment. 
 
**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* **Build & Lead the Manufacturing Engineering Team:** Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of manufacturing engineers and technical staff. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* **Drive Manufacturing Strategy & Technology:** Develop and implement a long-term manufacturing engineering strategy aligned with Anduril Imaging's growth objectives. Drive adoption of automation, advanced manufacturing technologies, and digital manufacturing tools to enhance efficiency and scalability across development and high-volume production.
* **Lead New Product Introduction (NPI):** Partner with R&D and product development teams to ensure seamless transition of new products from design to production. Champion Design for Manufacturability (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles early in the development cycle to de-risk production scaling.
* **Scale Production Capability:** Evaluate, plan, and prioritize supply chain, production, and test optimizations to ensure the value stream can reliably meet production output goals. Develop business cases for vertical integration or supplier diversification where strategic partnerships will accelerate scalability.
* **Drive Continuous Improvement & Complexity Reduction:** Lead initiatives to improve yield, reduce cycle time, and lower cost across the manufacturing value chain. Drive commonality optimization, component and supplier rationalization, and process standardization to simplify production at scale.
* **Resource & Budget Management:** Manage budgets, staffing, and capital equipment planning for the manufacturing engineering organization. Forecast headcount and operational needs to support rapid scaling, including classified production environments.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree or MBA preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing engineering and operations, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing manufacturing engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience owning manufacturing value chains for complex electro-mechanical or imaging hardware — defense, aerospace, or adjacent industries strongly preferred.
* Strong background in make-vs-buy analysis, contract manufacturer management, and supplier development for precision hardware.
* Experience managing NPI and scaling production in high-growth environments with condensed timelines.
* Familiarity with optical system integration and test, precision assembly, or imaging hardware manufacturing.
* Knowledge of automation, advanced manufacturing technologies, and digital manufacturing tools.
* Familiarity with quality systems (ISO 9001/AS9100) and PLM, MES, and ERP systems.
* Hands-on experience physically manufacturing hardware (assembly, soldering, machining, fabrication, etc.).
* Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

 

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
 + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
 + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

existing_roles.title: Director of Product Engineering (NPI
existing_roles.description:
Kauffman Engineering is seeking a highly strategic and hands-on leader to build and scale the product engineering capability across the full lifecycle from customer technical requirements and RFQ support through New Product Introduction (NPI), APQP, PPAP, and launch readiness.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership for Quoting, New Product Launch and other related product and manufacturing engineering activities such as ECN’s and the like. This leadership role ensures engineering execution is disciplined, scalable, and aligned with operational readiness. The Director of Product Engineering plays a critical role in reducing execution risk to NPI programs, improving launch success (Accuracy, Cost, Quality, Speed, Customer Experience), and ensuring the company can support growth without compromising quality, delivery, or margin.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Quoting Engineering

* Ensure technical feasibility, cost assumptions, risks, and manufacturability considerations are incorporated into all quotes.
* Lead a cross-functional team to improve the speed and accuracy of the quoting process through process improvement and technology adoption.
* Ensure accurate engineering input into cost models, BOM assumptions, labor estimates, and tooling requirements.
* Challenge quoting assumptions to identify cost and improvement opportunities in Operations and the Supply Chain.
* Maintain a current view of the capabilities and capacity of each manufacturing site to make informed decisions when allocating quotes and programs.
* Establish a formal feedback loop that brings production and launch performance data back into quoting standards and assumptions.

Product Engineering

* Lead all New Product Introduction (NPI) engineering activities across all plants, including the onboarding of new customers and programs.
* Own NPI on-time delivery (samples, PPAP submissions, and first production run) and program introduction lead time, leading cross-functional teams to build a predictable, fast, and reliable launch process.
* Ensure NPI teams fully execute APQP activities across all phases, including PPAP readiness and launch execution.
* Lead continuous improvement projects that apply a lean, end-to-end approach from quoting through NPI, improving safety, speed to market, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Manage NPI timelines, resource planning (including equipment capacity, tooling, and other resources), and execution to ensure on-time, on-budget launches.
* Review and present NPI status, risks, and readiness to senior management on a regular cadence.
* Drive consistent launch governance, gate reviews, and escalation processes across sites, including confirming that initial production orders are manufacturable.

Process Standardization & Systems Development

* Develop, implement, and maintain standardized engineering processes.
* Reduce reliance on tribal knowledge by establishing repeatable workflows, documentation standards, and control points.
* Improve consistency and quality of engineering outputs across plants and teams.
* Identify and mitigate technical and execution risks early in the product lifecycle.
* Evaluate and adopt better engineering methodologies and tools, and strengthen cross‑functional coordination.

Plant Integration & Cross‑Functional Collaboration

* Act as a key engineering partner to plant leadership to support execution, troubleshooting, and readiness of new program launches.
* Drive alignment between engineering and operations to ensure manufacturability, capacity readiness, and process capability as part of the launch hand-off to the manufacturing sites.
* Support plant teams during launches, ramp‑ups, and significant engineering changes.
* Collaborate with Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and Operations to ensure integrated execution.
* Lead engineering CAPEX planning for new programs and long‑term capacity needs.

Talent Leadership & Capability Building

* Assess current engineering organization structure, skills, and capacity.
* Develop and execute plans to upgrade engineering capability through hiring, development, and role clarity.
* Lead, coach, and develop the engineering team, setting clear expectations and holding team members accountable for results.
* Build a future‑state product engineering organization capable of supporting multiple concurrent launches.
* Promote a culture of accountability, discipline, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Electrical, or equivalent preferred); advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum 7–10 years of engineering experience in manufacturing or industrial environments.
* Demonstrated engineering experience in the design and manufacture of wire harness components in a high-mix, low-volume environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams and managing engineering functions, preferably across multiple sites.
* Proven experience with APQP, PPAP, and launch execution in production environments.
* Strong knowledge of Core Tools (APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA).
* Experience driving engineering standardization and process improvement.
* Understanding of material and labor costing, manufacturability, and cost drivers.
* Project management and cross‑functional leadership experience.
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, and Six Sigma methodologies preferred.
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem‑solving skills.

**Work Environment:**

* This is an Hybrid position at our Reynosa, MX facility.
* Ability and willingness to travel to U.S. and Mexico manufacturing locations (approximately 25–40%) to provide on-site plant support as business needs require.

**Compensation & Benefits**

The anticipated annual salary range for this position is $135k-$155k. Actual compensation decisions are dependent on the minimum requirements outlined in the job description, qualifications, experience, skills, geographic location, external market conditions, as well as internal equity.

Our company benefits provide full-time employees with a wide variety of benefits to meet the needs of our diverse workforce. We offer the following benefits: health, dental, and vision insurance, prescription drug benefits, flexible spending accounts, voluntary life insurance, AD&D insurance and a healthy incentive credit. We also provide company paid life insurance and short-term and long-term disability insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO and 9 paid holidays. Annual Company Performance Bonus Program based on achievement of annual goals.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Kauffman is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse workforce, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all qualified individuals. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

*This employer participates in the E-Verify program.*

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you able to travel to visit and provide support to our Reynosa, Mexico facility?
* Do you have any experience with Arcadia ECAD, Cadonix or Cableteque software? (If yes, or if you have experience with relevant Harness design tools, briefly explain)

Experience:

* Wire Harness Manufacturing: 1 year (Preferred)

Language:

* English and Spanish fluently (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in McAllen, TX 78501

Medical Practice Administration | Muncie Primary Care

Full-Time | On-Site | Monday–Friday

Competitive annual salary, depending on experience and qualifications, with the opportunity for an additional performance-based bonus.

45 Years of Excellence. An Exciting Future Ahead.

Founded in 1981, Muncie Primary Care is a family-owned, independent primary care practice with deep roots in East Central Indiana.

For 45 years, we've built our reputation on exceptional patient care, strong community relationships, and a commitment to independent medicine. Today, the next generation of physician leadership is carrying that legacy forward.

With a newly renovated facility and continued investments in our people, technology, and patient experience, we're excited about what's ahead.

We're proud of what we've built. We're looking for someone who's excited to help us make it even better.

*This Isn't Your Typical Office Manager Position.*

We're looking for an experienced, forward-thinking Director of Operations who can serve as the second-in-command to our physician-owner and CEO, leading the day-to-day operations of our practice while helping us build a stronger, more efficient organization for the future.

This is a true leadership position focused on developing people, improving processes, strengthening accountability, overseeing financial and operational performance, and turning ideas into action.

**What You'll Do**

1. Lead Operations and Financial Performance

* Provide overall leadership and oversight of daily practice operations, ensuring that clinical and administrative departments work together efficiently.
* Identify operational challenges, develop practical solutions, and address issues proactively before they escalate.
* Oversee operational budgets, monitor expenses, review financial performance, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and profitability.
* Work with designated team members responsible for administrative functions, technology, vendor coordination, and other business operations to ensure these responsibilities are managed effectively.
* Establish clear systems for delegation, communication, follow-through, and accountability.
* Ensure appropriate processes are in place for regulatory compliance, organizational policies, and operational risk management.

2. Lead, Develop, and Support Our Team

* Build and maintain strong, positive working relationships with employees across all departments.
* Develop departmental leaders, encourage professional growth, and help employees succeed in their roles.
* Foster a workplace culture built on mutual respect, open communication, teamwork, and accountability.
* Provide coaching, performance feedback, and support with difficult conversations and conflict resolution.
* Address employee concerns and interpersonal challenges fairly, promptly, and professionally.
* Work collaboratively with our Marketing/Human Resources Manager on recruitment, employee development, retention, and performance management.
* Strengthen communication and cooperation between clinical and administrative departments.

3. Improve Systems and Use Data to Drive Decisions

* Develop, monitor, and analyze Key Result Areas (KRAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), scheduling utilization, productivity, and other operational performance measures.
* Identify inefficiencies, evaluate workflows, and implement improvements that enhance patient access, employee satisfaction, and practice performance.
* Build systems that promote consistency, clear responsibilities, effective delegation, and measurable accountability.
* Use spreadsheets, dashboards, financial information, and operational data to identify trends and guide decision-making.
* Evaluate the results of operational changes and make adjustments as needed.
* Help create an organization where problems are identified early and addressed effectively.

4. Help Shape the Future of Our Practice

* Partner directly with the physician-owner and CEO on strategic planning, organizational priorities, and practice improvement initiatives.
* Translate long-term goals into practical action plans, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
* Explore opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technology to reduce administrative burden and improve efficiency.
* Take ownership of projects from initial planning through implementation and evaluation.
* Anticipate challenges, identify opportunities, and bring forward thoughtful solutions and recommendations.
* Help balance the needs of patients, providers, employees, and the business while supporting the long-term success of independent primary care.

**You might be a great candidate for this position if….**

* You're a natural leader who enjoys developing people, building relationships, and helping teams succeed.
* You build trust and respect while maintaining clear expectations and accountability.
* You're proactive, resourceful, and comfortable making decisions, solving problems, and taking ownership of outcomes.
* You communicate effectively, navigate difficult conversations professionally, and foster collaboration across departments.
* You enjoy improving processes, building efficient systems, and finding better ways to get things done.
* You're comfortable using financial information, spreadsheets, and performance metrics to guide decisions.
* You're excited about new technology, including AI and automation, and enjoy working with an engaged owner who values initiative and independent thinking.

**This Position May Not Be the Right Fit If...**

* You prefer a traditional office management role focused on completing daily administrative tasks.
* You're most comfortable waiting for direction rather than taking ownership of challenges.
* You prefer maintaining existing processes rather than finding a better way to do things.
* You find it difficult to address employee performance concerns or navigate uncomfortable conversations.
* You tend to focus on identifying problems without taking responsibility for developing and implementing solutions.
* You aren't comfortable using data, financial information, or technology to evaluate performance and guide decisions.

We recognize that no candidate will bring every skill or have every answer on day one. We're looking for someone with the leadership ability, judgment, curiosity, and initiative to learn, adapt, and grow with our practice.

**Qualifications**

***Required***

* Demonstrated leadership and management experience, including supervising employees, developing teams, and overseeing complex operational workflows.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to build productive working relationships.
* Experience coaching employees, addressing performance concerns, resolving conflicts, and fostering an accountable, team-oriented workplace.
* Proven ability to identify operational problems, implement solutions, and follow projects through to completion.
* Experience managing business operations, delegating responsibilities, and coordinating work across departments.
* Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, initiative, and the ability to make independent decisions.
* Comfort with technology, willingness to learn new tools, and an interest in using data to improve operational performance.

**Strongly Preferred**

* A bachelor's degree in business administration, healthcare administration, management, or a related field.

**Why Muncie Primary Care?**

We're an established, family-owned practice that values our employees, our patients, and our independence. We're proud of our history and equally excited about our future.

As our Director of Operations, you'll have:

* The opportunity to shape the systems, culture, and future direction of an established practice.
* Competitive base salary
* Opportunity for an additional performance-based bonus.
* Monday–Friday work schedule.
* Health insurance.
* Paid time off and paid holidays.
* Retirement benefits, subject to plan eligibility.

**Ready to Help Us Take the Next Step Forward?**

We're not looking for someone who has all the answers.

We're looking for someone who asks great questions, builds strong relationships, takes initiative, enjoys solving problems, and is excited about building something meaningful.

If you're an experienced leader who loves developing people, improving systems, taking ownership, and helping an organization succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: From $80,000.00 per year

* 401(k) matching

**Fresh & Ready Foods** is seeking a strategic and hands-on **Operations Director** to lead our Longview, TX manufacturing facility. Reporting to the Regional Director, the Operations Director will be accountable for achieving safety, quality, service, inventory, and financial objectives while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and employee engagement. ####

* Champion safety, regulatory compliance, and food safety programs, including SQF, HACCP, sanitation, and audit readiness.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce waste, and optimize plant performance.
* Establish and manage KPIs related to safety, quality, labor, yield, inventory, customer service, and on-time delivery.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to support customer growth, new product introductions, and operational initiatives.
* Manage budgets, labor costs, inventory levels, and operational expenses to achieve financial objectives.
* Maintain a visible presence on the production floor, coaching leaders and supporting problem-solving efforts.
* Build succession plans and develop future leaders within the organization.
* Foster a culture focused on operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

####

* Bachelor's degree in Operations, Engineering, Business, Food Science, Supply Chain, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in food manufacturing, beverage manufacturing, CPG, protein processing, bakery, prepared foods, or related manufacturing environments.
* Experience managing large production teams through multiple levels of leadership.
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Six Sigma, TPS, or similar methodologies.
* Proven track record improving safety, quality, productivity, and financial performance.
* Experience with SQF, HACCP, FDA/USDA regulations, sanitation programs, and quality systems.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, labor management, inventory control, and operational reporting.
* Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.

####

The ideal candidate is a visible, people-focused manufacturing leader who enjoys building teams, developing talent, and driving operational results. They possess strong food manufacturing experience, a continuous improvement mindset, and a proven ability to lead large-scale operations while improving safety, quality, service, and profitability. existing_roles.description:
Gotion Inc. is based in Silicon Valley, CA, currently building a Manufacturing facility in Manteno, IL and has R&D centers in Ohio, China, Japan and Europe. We innovate in the next generation electric vehicle and energy storage technologies (lithium batteries and related systems) with the aim to accelerate electrified transportation and achieve sustainable development. Gotion is powered by a leading power battery technology company that provides solutions for vehicles including the world's first mass commercial e-bus route. 
 
Gotion is a career destination - we are not simply attempting to just fill another job, but to pursue a dream of global green energy together! We offer outstanding opportunities to individuals seeking an exciting and challenging working environment. Everyone is highly valued and plays a vital role in the growth of our organization.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Director is responsible for leading and coordinating key operational functions of the manufacturing facility, including **Production Planning, Supply Chain, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), and Infrastructure/Construction Engineering**.

This position plays a critical role in ensuring production readiness, material availability, operational continuity, regulatory compliance, facility development, and cross-functional execution.

The Operations Director will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, and other functional leaders to support safe, efficient, and scalable operations of the Chicago manufacturing facility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Planning & Operations Coordination**

* Lead production planning and scheduling based on demand, capacity, materials, and priorities.
* Develop and manage short- and long-term production plans.
* Coordinate manpower, equipment, and materials to achieve production targets.
* Monitor plan execution and identify delivery risks.
* Drive cross-functional efforts to resolve production and operational constraints.
* Track key KPIs, including production attainment, inventory, material availability, delivery, and efficiency.
* Support S&OP and capacity planning processes.

* **Supply Chain Management**

* Lead plant supply chain operations, including production planning, materials, procurement, inventory, warehousing, and logistics.
* Ensure material availability while maintaining optimal inventory levels.
* Improve inventory turnover and reduce excess and obsolete stock.
* Drive supplier performance and supply continuity.
* Identify supply chain risks and implement contingency plans.
* Manage domestic and international logistics activities.
* Lead continuous improvement in cost, efficiency, and delivery performance.

* **Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS)**

* Lead the plant's EHS programs and team to ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations.
* Promote a strong safety culture and drive workplace safety initiatives.
* Oversee inspections, risk assessments, corrective actions, and emergency preparedness.
* Monitor EHS performance and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to improve safety and compliance.
* Support regulatory audits, inspections, and permitting activities.

* **Infrastructure & Construction Engineering**

* Lead facility engineering, infrastructure, and construction projects supporting plant operations.
* Oversee plant expansion, renovations, and infrastructure improvements.
* Manage contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders.
* Ensure projects meet scope, budget, schedule, quality, and safety requirements.
* Maintain critical facility systems, utilities, and infrastructure readiness.
* Support production line installation, commissioning, and facility startup activities.

* **Operational Excellence & Cross-Functional Management**

* Establish and manage operational processes across planning, supply chain, EHS, and infrastructure.
* Lead operational reviews and drive action item completion.
* Identify and escalate operational risks to plant leadership.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, cost, delivery, inventory, and efficiency.
* Drive KPI-based decision-making and operational visibility.
* Support ERP/MRP and digitalization initiatives.
* Foster collaboration across Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Finance, HR, and IT.

* **Team Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and mentor managers and operational teams.
* Establish organizational structure, goals, and succession plans.
* Recruit, develop, and retain key talent.
* Drive performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Foster a collaborative, safety-focused, high-performance culture.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field required.
* Master's degree or MBA preferred.
* **10+ years of progressive experience** in manufacturing operations, supply chain, production planning, engineering, or related functions.
* **5+ years of leadership experience** managing managers and/or multiple operational functions.
* Strong experience in large-scale manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience in production planning, supply chain management, and plant operations.
* Working knowledge of EHS management and U.S. regulatory requirements.
* Experience supporting facility construction, plant expansion, infrastructure, or manufacturing engineering projects strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of ERP/MRP systems; SAP experience preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in **lithium-ion battery, EV, automotive, energy storage, electronics, or advanced manufacturing**.
* Experience supporting the launch or ramp-up of a new manufacturing facility in the United States.
* Experience managing complex global supply chains.
* Familiarity with high-volume automated manufacturing environments.
* Experience working with international and cross-cultural teams.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, S&OP, inventory optimization, and operational excellence methodologies.
* PMP, APICS/CPIM/CSCP, Six Sigma, or related professional certification is a plus.

**Key Performance Indicators**

Key performance measures may include:

**Production Planning:** Production Plan Attainment | Capacity Utilization | Schedule Adherence

**Supply Chain:** On-Time Delivery | Material Availability | Inventory Turns | Inventory Accuracy | Logistics Cost

**EHS:** Safety Incident Rate | Corrective Action Closure | Regulatory Compliance | Environmental Performance

**Infrastructure:** Project Schedule | Project Budget | Construction Safety | Facility Readiness | Utility Reliability

**Overall Operations:** Cost Reduction | Operational Efficiency | Risk Management | Cross-Functional Execution

**Leadership Scope**

The Operations Director provides leadership and management oversight for:

**Production Planning / PMC**

**Supply Chain & Logistics**

**Warehouse & Inventory**

**Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS)**

**Infrastructure / Construction / Facility Engineering**
